2604.12501.summary_en: This paper studies emergency delivery UAV operation when damaged infrastructure makes reliable command-and-control links critical. It proposes a heterogeneous dual-network framework coupling UAV base-station communication support with delivery UAV path planning, using joint optimization, multi-agent reinforcement learning, and communication-aware A* planning to improve reliability, avoid critical outages, and reduce deployment cost in simulations.
2604.12501.summary_zh: 本文研究灾后应急配送无人机在地面基础设施受损时对可靠指挥控制链路的需求。作者提出异构双网络框架，将悬停无人机基站通信保障网络与配送无人机路径网络耦合，并通过联合优化、多智能体强化学习和通信感知A*规划提升可靠性、避免关键阶段中断并降低部署成本。
2604.12501.title: A Heterogeneous Dual-Network Framework for Emergency Delivery UAVs: Communication Assurance and Path Planning Coordination

2605.05861.summary_en: This paper proposes SANEmerg, an emergent communication framework for semantic-aware agentic AI networking with heterogeneous specialized agents under bandwidth and computation limits. The framework detects user semantic intent, assigns subtasks to agents, and uses bandwidth-adaptable importance filtering plus an MDL-based complexity regularizer to shape signaling. Experiments with an AgentNet prototype report improved task accuracy and reduced bandwidth and computational overhead over prior methods.
2605.05861.summary_zh: 本文提出SANEmerg，用于语义感知AgentNet中异质专业化智能体在带宽和计算受限条件下的涌现通信。该框架检测用户语义意图并分配子任务，同时通过带宽自适应重要性过滤器和基于MDL的复杂度正则化促进有效信令。AgentNet原型和实验显示，该方法提升任务准确率并降低带宽与计算开销。
2605.05861.title: SANEmerg: An Emergent Communication Framework for Semantic-aware Agentic AI Networking

2605.08391.summary_en: The paper studies the information bottleneck in cooperative MARL, where agents must act from partial local observations while relevant team information is distributed across agents. It proposes SACHI, which uses graph transformer convolutions over an inter-agent coordination graph to enrich each agent representation with receiver-sensitive, content-dependent teammate signals before action selection. Across five cooperative tasks and multiple baselines, SACHI matches or outperforms the strongest baselines, with ablations attributing gains to content-dependent message passing.
2605.08391.summary_zh: 本文研究合作式多智能体强化学习中的信息瓶颈，即智能体只能基于局部观测行动，而联合最优决策所需信息分散在团队中。作者提出 SACHI，在智能体协调图上使用图 Transformer 卷积，在动作选择前为每个智能体注入接收方敏感、内容依赖的队友信号。五个合作任务上的实验和消融分析表明，性能提升主要来自内容依赖的消息传递算子。
2605.08391.title: SACHI: Structured Agent Coordination via Holistic Information Integration in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

2605.08613.summary_en: This paper studies emergent communication for agentic AI networking under physical constraints such as bandwidth and computational complexity. It proposes an information-theoretic framework for heterogeneous agents that jointly optimizes decision-making and learned communication signaling using multi-agent, multi-task distributed information bottleneck theory. The paper provides generalization bounds for decentralized inference and reports hardware-prototype validation showing improved generalization over prior solutions.
2605.08613.summary_zh: 本文研究在带宽和计算复杂度等物理约束下的智能体 AI 网络涌现通信。作者提出一个面向异构智能体的信息论框架，基于多智能体、多任务分布式信息瓶颈理论联合优化决策函数与通信信号学习。论文给出了去中心化推理中涌现通信协议的泛化界，并通过真实硬件原型验证其相较已有方法具有更好的泛化性能。
2605.08613.title: Generalization Bounds of Emergent Communications for Agentic AI Networking

2605.09522.summary_en: This paper models co-constructed emotion as emergent communication between two embodied agents. Using the Metropolis-Hastings Naming Game within a Collective Predictive Coding framework over visual, auditory, and simulated interoceptive inputs, it shows that communication improves symbolic category alignment and remains robust under divergent interoceptive dynamics.
2605.09522.summary_zh: 本文将共同构建的情绪建模为两个具身智能体之间的涌现通信。作者在集体预测编码框架中使用Metropolis-Hastings命名游戏，结合视觉、听觉和模拟内感受输入，结果显示通信提升了符号层情绪类别对齐，并且在内感受动态存在系统差异时仍保持稳健。
2605.09522.title: Emergent Communication for Co-constructed Emotion Between Embodied Agents via Collective Predictive Coding

2605.11695.summary_en: This paper studies emergent communication between heterogeneous visual agents with private visual representations and decentralized learning. In the Metropolis-Hastings Captioning Game, agents exchange discrete token sequences and locally accept or reject proposals based on their own visual features. Experiments on MS-COCO show that shared visually informative symbols can emerge without shared perceptual access, while stronger encoder mismatch reduces alignment, specificity, and symmetry.
2605.11695.summary_zh: 本文研究具有私有视觉表征的异质视觉智能体在去中心化学习中的涌现通信。作者提出Metropolis-Hastings Captioning Game，让智能体交换离散token序列，并依据自身视觉特征局部接受或拒绝提议。MS-COCO实验表明，在没有共享感知访问的情况下仍可涌现具有视觉信息的共享符号，但编码器差异越大，对齐、特异性和对称性越弱。
2605.11695.title: Emergent Communication between Heterogeneous Visual Agents through Decentralized Learning

2605.14121.summary_en: This paper studies distributed control for heterogeneous interconnected multi-agent systems that communicate over noisy, delayed, and asynchronous networks. It proposes an encoded corrective double actor-critic framework with a message-passing mechanism that refines and time-shifts reconstructed global state information to correct Q-networks. Experiments across test cases and regret analysis support its effectiveness over baselines.
2605.14121.summary_zh: 本文研究异质互联多智能体控制系统在噪声、延迟和异步通信网络上的分布式策略合成。作者提出编码校正双actor-critic框架，通过消息传递机制刻画时序与信息流，逐步细化并时间对齐重构的全局状态以修正Q网络。多个测试案例和数值遗憾分析表明该方法优于基线。
2605.14121.title: An Encoded Corrective Double Deep Q-Networks for Multi-Agent Control Systems

2605.19418.summary_en: The paper addresses conflict and error propagation in LLM-based multi-agent reasoning systems that rely on naive aggregation or unsigned graph interactions. It proposes SIGMA, a signed graph-informed framework that selects diverse agents, builds confidence-weighted trust, conflict, and neutral edges, performs conflict-aware signed message passing, and aggregates with structural awareness. Experiments across six benchmarks and multiple LLM configurations show improved accuracy and conflict resilience over prior baselines.
2605.19418.summary_zh: 本文研究基于大语言模型的多智能体推理系统中的冲突与错误传播问题，指出朴素聚合和无符号图交互难以处理相互矛盾的信号。作者提出 SIGMA，通过选择相关且多样的智能体，构建带置信权重的信任、冲突和中性关系图，并进行冲突感知的有符号消息传递与结构化聚合。多基准实验表明，该方法在准确性和抗冲突性能上优于已有基线。
2605.19418.title: Conflict-Resilient Multi-Agent Reasoning via Signed Graph Modeling

2605.27532.summary_en: This paper proposes SCALE-COMM for learning stable and policy-relevant communication representations in decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning for partially observant autonomous mobile robots. The method decouples communication learning from policy optimization by training compact latent messages with contrastive alignment across agents and time. Experiments on MARL benchmarks and warehouse coordination show improved representation quality, task performance, stability, sample efficiency, and throughput.
2605.27532.summary_zh: 本文提出 SCALE-COMM，用于在部分可观测自主移动机器人去中心化多智能体强化学习中学习稳定且与策略相关的通信表示。该方法通过训练紧凑潜在消息，并在智能体之间和时间维度上进行对比对齐，将通信学习与策略优化解耦。标准 MARL 基准和仓库协调任务实验表明，该方法提升了表示质量、任务性能、稳定性、样本效率和吞吐量。
2605.27532.title: SCALE-COMM: Shared, Contrastively-Aligned Latent Embeddings for MARL Communication

2605.31005.summary_en: The paper presents a differentiable optimization framework for multi-agent coordination under local, overlapping views. Each agent solves a neural-parameterized convex subproblem, while coordination is performed through ADMM with inter-agent constraints defined by a cellular sheaf, enabling heterogeneous forms of consensus. Evaluations on maze pathfinding, image classification, and Sudoku show that locally limited agents can learn coordinated global solutions, with improved robustness or solve rates in selected settings and more interpretable coordination states than standard message passing.
2605.31005.summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于多智能体协调的可微优化框架，处理由重叠局部视图构成的输入。每个智能体求解由神经编码器参数化的凸子问题，并通过由胞腔层束指定约束的 ADMM 进行协调，从而支持异质的全局共识形式。实验覆盖迷宫寻路、图像分类和数独，表明局部视野不足的智能体能够学习协同产生全局正确输出，并在部分任务上获得更好的鲁棒性或求解率。
2605.31005.title: Learning Multi-Agent Coordination via Sheaf-ADMM

2606.00405.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost, latency, and anchor corruption problems in aggregating specialized LLMs. It proposes a bipartite factor-graph framework where LLM outputs are variable nodes, epistemic consistency checks are check nodes, and structured message passing with asymmetric damping refines output distributions without extra LLM calls. Evaluations on four benchmarks report substantially lower token and API usage while outperforming multi-agent baselines.
2606.00405.summary_zh: 本文研究专用大语言模型聚合中的高成本、高延迟和锚点污染问题。作者提出二部因子图框架，将各LLM输出作为变量节点，将认识一致性检查作为校验节点，并用带非对称阻尼的结构化消息传递在不增加LLM调用的情况下细化输出分布。四个基准上的实验显示，该方法显著降低token和API使用量，同时优于多智能体基线。
2606.00405.title: From Talking Words to Sharing Thoughts: Scalable Multi-LLM Aggregation via Structured Message Passing

2606.01828.summary_en: The paper studies the communication-cost problem in LLM-based multi-agent consensus, where fully connected deliberation scales poorly and fixed sparse topologies lack task adaptivity. It proposes DySCo, a dynamic trust-aware sparse consensus mechanism that selects high-value communication edges using reliability, answer divergence, and task relevance, then aggregates with dynamic trust weights and early stopping. The work analyzes communication complexity and consensus stability and evaluates the method on reasoning and factual QA tasks.
2606.01828.summary_zh: 本文研究基于大语言模型的多智能体共识中的通信成本问题，指出全连接讨论扩展性差，而固定稀疏拓扑难以适应任务状态。作者提出 DySCo，一种动态信任感知的稀疏共识机制，根据智能体可靠性、答案分歧和任务相关性选择高价值通信边，并用动态信任权重聚合答案和提前终止讨论。论文进一步分析通信复杂度与共识稳定性，并在数学推理、逻辑推理和事实问答任务上评估该方法。
2606.01828.title: Dynamic Trust-Aware Sparse Communication Topology for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Consensus

2606.02337.summary_en: This paper tackles constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning, where joint action spaces scale poorly and constraints couple agents beyond reward structure. It proposes CG-CMARL, combining coordination graphs, shared Q-functions for objectives and constraints, Lagrangian duality, and Max-Sum message passing for execution-time coordination. The method comes with convergence and error guarantees and shows stronger Pareto fronts than baselines in cooperative navigation tasks with pairwise constraints.
2606.02337.summary_zh: 本文研究受约束多智能体强化学习中联合动作空间指数增长和约束耦合的问题。作者提出CG-CMARL，将协调图、目标与约束共享Q函数、拉格朗日对偶以及执行时Max-Sum消息传递结合起来。该方法给出收敛与误差界，并在带成对约束的协作导航任务中获得优于基线的帕累托前沿。
2606.02337.title: Coordination Graphs for Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

2606.04580.summary_en: The paper addresses fragmentation of cyber threat signals across social media platforms and the need for automated integration into actionable threat intelligence reports. It presents TIBlender, a role-specialized LLM multi-agent system that monitors X, Reddit, Telegram, and Discord, conducts multi-perspective evidence-backed investigations, and extracts related indicators of compromise. Deployment and evaluations suggest cross-platform monitoring surfaces unique and early threat information and produces more IoCs than single-platform baselines.
2606.04580.summary_zh: 本文研究网络威胁信号分散在多个社交媒体平台上、难以自动整合为可行动威胁情报报告的问题。作者提出 TIBlender，一个由角色专门化大语言模型智能体组成的多智能体系统，用于监控 X、Reddit、Telegram 和 Discord，进行多视角证据链分析并提取相关 IoC。部署和评估表明，跨平台监控能够发现独特且更早的威胁信息，并比单平台基线产生更多 IoC。
2606.04580.title: TIBlender: Early-Warning Threat Intelligence from Cross-Platform Social Media Evidence

2606.06380.summary_en: This paper proposes emergent language in multi-agent reinforcement learning as a generative methodology for studying consciousness-relevant structures without relying on human language priors. Agents begin with minimal language and self-concept assumptions and develop communication under task pressure. A proof-of-concept environment shows self-referential communication and an echo-mismatch detection circuit emerging from environmental affordances rather than being directly imposed by architecture or task structure.
2606.06380.summary_zh: 本文提出将多智能体强化学习中的涌现语言作为研究意识相关结构的生成式方法，以避免依赖人类语言先验。智能体从无语言、无自我概念和极少人类文本暴露的设定出发，在任务压力下发展通信。概念验证实验显示，自指通信和回声不匹配检测回路可由环境可供性涌现，而非由架构或任务结构直接规定。
2606.06380.title: Emergent Language as an Approach to Conscious AI

2606.08030.summary_en: This paper examines voting protocols as coordination mechanisms in a role-constrained multi-agent tutoring system. Four pedagogical agents propose interventions, and simple, ranked, cumulative, and approval voting are compared across simulated tutoring environments on SciQ and HumanEval. The study finds that deliberation and protocol choice frequently alter the winning response and produce distinct coordination behaviors among specialized agents.
2606.08030.summary_zh: 本文研究投票协议作为角色受限多智能体辅导系统中的协调机制。四个教学角色智能体分别提出干预方案，作者在SciQ和HumanEval模拟环境中比较简单投票、排序投票、累积投票和认可投票。结果表明，智能体协商和投票规则会显著影响最终回应，并导致角色专业化智能体之间不同的协调模式。
2606.08030.title: Voting Protocols as Coordination Mechanisms for Role-Constrained Multi-Agent Tutoring Systems

2606.10582.summary_en: This paper studies zero-shot mutual intelligibility in emergent communication between independently trained populations. Using emergent sketching as a visually grounded modality, it finds that increasing training population size improves cross-community communication by increasing in-group variation while reducing cross-group variation through perceptual grounding.
2606.10582.summary_zh: 本文研究独立训练群体之间涌现通信的零样本相互可理解性。作者以涌现素描作为视觉扎根通信模态，发现扩大训练群体规模可提升跨群体通信能力，其机制是在增加群体内变异的同时，通过知觉扎根降低群体间差异。
2606.10582.title: Drawing with Strangers: Population Scaling Drives Zero-Shot Mutual Intelligibility in Emergent Sketching

2606.12918.summary_en: The paper addresses safety and security risks in hierarchical multi-agent systems, especially coordinated compromise, privilege escalation, and cross-agent collusion. It proposes MAStrike, a closed-loop collusive red-teaming framework that uses agent-level Shapley value analysis to identify vulnerable coalitions and generate coordinated role-aware adversarial manipulations. Experiments on a new benchmark across multiple domains and frontier-model MAS show that MAStrike outperforms heuristic baselines and reveals interaction vulnerabilities missed by prior methods.
2606.12918.summary_zh: 本文研究层级式多智能体系统中的安全与安全性风险，重点关注协同攻陷、权限提升和跨智能体串通。作者提出 MAStrike，这是一种闭环串通式红队框架，利用智能体级 Shapley 值分析识别脆弱智能体联盟，并生成角色感知的协同对抗操纵。实验表明，该方法在新构建的多领域基准上优于启发式基线，并揭示了以往方法忽略的高阶交互漏洞。
2606.12918.title: MAStrike: Shapley-Guided Collusive Red-Teaming on Multi-Agent Systems

2606.17246.summary_en: The paper introduces GeoDisaster, a benchmark for operational geospatial disaster reasoning requiring tool-grounded spatial reasoning and evidence-backed decisions. It combines heterogeneous Earth-observation and GIS evidence across multiple disaster task families and proposes an orchestrated multi-agent framework with role-specialized agents, explicit execution contracts, and Role-Contract Expectation Alignment for training. Experiments indicate that the benchmark challenges existing systems and that RCEA improves tool use, evidence grounding, state consistency, and decision generation.
2606.17246.summary_zh: 本文提出 GeoDisaster，一个面向业务化地理空间灾害推理的基准，要求系统进行工具支撑的空间推理和证据支持的决策。该基准整合多种地球观测与 GIS 证据，并覆盖多个灾害任务族；作者还提出由角色专门化智能体、显式执行契约和角色-契约期望对齐组成的编排式多智能体框架。实验表明，该基准对现有系统具有挑战性，而 RCEA 能改善工具使用、证据 grounding、状态一致性和决策生成。
2606.17246.title: GeoDisaster: Benchmarking Orchestrated Agents for Operational Disaster Geo-Intelligence

2606.18668.summary_en: This paper addresses reliability in centralized large-scale multi-agent systems where coordinators delegate requests to lightweight domain-specialized sub-agents. It proposes EARS, a framework that treats sub-agent abstention as an inter-agent communication protocol by returning structured failure states and rationales to the coordinator. In a production e-commerce assistant setting, the approach improves response pass rate, supporting the claim that explanatory abstention can improve MAS reliability.
2606.18668.summary_zh: 本文关注集中式大规模多智能体系统的可靠性，其中协调器将请求分派给轻量级、领域专用的子智能体。作者提出 EARS，将子智能体的拒答重新表述为一种智能体间通信协议，使其向协调器返回结构化失败状态和理由。论文在生产级电商助手场景中显示该方法提升了响应通过率，支持了解释性拒答能够增强多智能体系统可靠性的主张。
2606.18668.title: EARS: Explanatory Abstention for Reliable Sub-Agent Modeling in Large-scale Multi-Agent Systems

2606.19135.summary_en: This study develops a technical taxonomy for classifying LLM agent communication protocols amid a fragmented and interoperability-challenged protocol landscape. Using an iterative taxonomy method over nine actively maintained open-source protocols, it identifies five dimensions: counterparty, payload, interaction state, discovery mechanism, and schema flexibility. The analysis finds recurring architectural patterns and argues that the field may evolve toward a federated, layered protocol stack rather than a single universal protocol.
2606.19135.summary_zh: 本文针对 LLM 智能体通信协议碎片化和互操作性不足的问题，提出一种技术分类法。作者通过迭代分类方法分析九个活跃维护且有采用迹象的开源协议，形成了交易对象、载荷、交互状态、发现机制和模式灵活性五个维度。研究发现若干重复出现的架构模式，并认为该领域更可能走向联邦式、分层协议栈，而非单一通用协议。
2606.19135.title: A Technical Taxonomy of LLM Agent Communication Protocols

2606.19632.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of formal guarantees for learned multi-agent communication policies in safety-critical robotic settings. It presents a pipeline that extracts domain features, distills neural communication policies into decision trees, translates them into probabilistic model-checking specifications, and verifies temporal-logic properties compositionally. Evaluation on multi-drone coordination policies reports high policy-distillation fidelity, verified safety properties, and empirical transfer of those properties back to the original neural policies.
2606.19632.summary_zh: 本文研究安全关键机器人场景中学习型多智能体通信策略缺乏形式化保证的问题。论文提出一条流程，包括领域特征提取、将神经通信策略蒸馏为决策树、转换为概率模型检查规范，并组合式验证时序逻辑性质。在多无人机协调策略上的评估显示，该方法具有较高策略蒸馏保真度，可验证安全性质，并在经验上表明这些性质可转移回原始神经策略。
2606.19632.title: Formal Verification of Learned Multi-Agent Communication Policies via Decision Tree Distillation

2606.19795.summary_en: The paper surveys LLM-based agentic electronic design automation from the perspective of handoff validity across stages, tools, sessions, and organizational boundaries. It reviews 82 systems and classifies them into stage-bound, flow-bound, and organization-bound categories, analyzing handoff contracts, objects, coordination mechanisms, and unresolved issues. The survey motivates a five-layer EDA agent communication protocol covering discovery, messaging, tool invocation, orchestration, and security/IP concerns.
2606.19795.summary_zh: 本文从交接有效性的角度综述基于大语言模型的智能体电子设计自动化，关注设计阶段、工具、会话和组织边界之间的对象传递。作者回顾 82 个系统，并将其划分为阶段绑定、流程绑定和组织绑定三类，分析交接契约、交接对象、协调机制和开放问题。论文进一步提出五层 EDA 智能体通信协议，覆盖智能体发现、消息、工具调用、工作流编排以及安全和知识产权协议。
2606.19795.title: Agentic Electronic Design Automation: A Handoff Perspective

2606.19911.summary_en: This paper proposes population-level knowledge sharing for heterogeneous LLM agent ecosystems through retrieval of agent-generated trajectories. It introduces Multi-Agent Transactive Memory, where producer agents store procedural trajectories in a shared repository and consumer agents retrieve them for later tasks. Experiments in interactive environments show improved downstream task performance and fewer interaction steps without requiring coordination or joint training.
2606.19911.summary_zh: 本文提出面向异质LLM智能体生态的群体级知识共享方法，通过检索智能体生成的轨迹复用过程性知识。论文提出Multi-Agent Transactive Memory，使生产者智能体将轨迹存入共享库，消费者智能体在后续任务中检索使用。交互式环境实验表明，该方法无需协调或联合训练即可提升下游任务表现并减少交互步数。
2606.19911.title: Multi-Agent Transactive Memory

2606.20485.summary_en: This paper develops a theoretical framework for multi-agent and many-body systems with feedback between agent actions and collective observations. It models agents through power and response functions, deriving macroscopic quantities such as entropy, order, fragility, and mobility for heterogeneous populations. The paper argues that optimal order balances productivity, stability, and adaptability, and that synchronization can increase output while raising fragility and reducing mobility.
2606.20485.summary_zh: 本文提出一个理论框架，用于分析智能体行动与集体观测之间存在反馈的多智能体和多体系统。论文以权力和响应函数刻画异质智能体，并推导熵、秩序、脆弱性和流动性等宏观性质。研究认为，最优秩序需要在生产力、稳定性和适应性之间平衡，同步增强可能提高集体输出但也会增加系统脆弱性并降低流动性。
2606.20485.title: Optimal Order of Multi-Agent and General Many-Body Systems

2606.20962.summary_en: This paper studies communication and coordination in heterogeneous robot teams where agents have different states, actions, and observations. It extends Heterogeneous Policy Networks using heterogeneous graph-attention networks to learn collaborative policies and efficient binarized messaging. Experiments report state-of-the-art coordination and communication performance across domains, with large bandwidth reductions relative to baselines.
2606.20962.summary_zh: 本文研究由状态、动作和观测空间不同的智能体组成的异构机器人团队中的通信与协调。作者扩展 Heterogeneous Policy Networks，利用异构图注意力网络学习协作策略和高效二值化消息。实验显示该方法在多个领域取得先进的协调与通信性能，并相较基线显著降低通信带宽需求。
2606.20962.title: Heterogeneous Policy Networks for Composite Robot Team Communication and Coordination

2606.21202.summary_en: This paper studies how heterogeneous communication protocols affect collective consensus in Neural Cellular Automata. It introduces language sub-populations whose messages are translated with tunable linguistic distance and evaluates density classification on ring and grid settings. The results show that linguistic distance slows consensus, causes mild inter-group divergence, and that training under diverse protocols improves robustness to mismatch.
2606.21202.summary_zh: 本文研究神经元胞自动机中异质通信协议如何影响集体共识。作者引入具有不同“语言”的子群体，并用可调语言距离的翻译机制处理彼此消息，在环形和二维网格密度分类任务中评估。结果显示语言距离会减缓共识、造成轻度群体分化，而在多样协议下训练的集体对协议不匹配更鲁棒。
2606.21202.title: Communication Heterogeneity and Collective Consensus in Neural Cellular Automata

2606.23011.summary_en: This paper proposes a data-driven decentralized framework for Nash equilibrium seeking in multi-agent systems with unknown linear dynamics, disturbances, equality constraints, and partial-decision information. The method combines an equilibrium model, distributed communication, disturbance rejection, and data-driven stabilization, reformulating the task as cooperative output regulation solved through semi-definite programs from noisy data. It provides stability and convergence guarantees and extends the approach to certain nonlinear systems, with simulations validating robustness.
2606.23011.summary_zh: 本文提出一种数据驱动的分散式框架，用于在未知线性动态、外部扰动、等式约束和部分决策信息条件下实现多智能体纳什均衡寻求。该方法结合均衡模型、分布式通信、扰动抑制和数据驱动稳定化，将问题重构为合作输出调节，并通过带噪数据上的半定规划合成控制器。论文给出闭环稳定性和渐近收敛保证，并扩展到一类非线性系统，仿真验证了方法的鲁棒性。
2606.23011.title: Robust Data-Driven Nash Equilibrium Seeking under Partial-Decision Information

2606.23664.summary_en: This paper studies whether prompt optimization can improve multi-agent LLM systems, where agents have system prompts and workflow positions governing coordination and aggregation. It benchmarks prompt optimizers across tasks, workflows, communication protocols, and team sizes, addressing the expanded search space relative to single-agent prompt optimization. The work reports that prompt optimization can yield meaningful gains but that its effectiveness depends strongly on system configuration.
2606.23664.summary_zh: 本文研究提示词优化是否能够提升多智能体 LLM 系统，其中各智能体由系统提示词定义角色行为，并处于影响协调和聚合的工作流位置。作者在不同任务、工作流、通信协议和团队规模下评测提示词优化器，以应对相较单智能体更大的搜索空间。论文表明提示词优化具有带来显著收益的潜力，但其效果高度依赖系统配置。
2606.23664.title: MAS-PromptBench: When Does Prompt Optimization Improve Multi-Agent LLM Systems?

2606.24937.summary_en: This book-length reference surveys the full stack for building autonomous agentic AI systems, from LLM foundations and alignment methods to production deployment. Its agentic AI coverage includes retrieval, memory, harness design, loop engineering, tool use, skills, and evaluation. It also covers inter-agent coordination, including communication protocols and multi-agent architectures such as centralized, decentralized, and hierarchical topologies.
2606.24937.summary_zh: 本文是一部面向构建自主智能体 AI 系统的综合实践参考，覆盖从 LLM 基础、对齐方法到生产部署的完整技术栈。其智能体部分讨论检索、记忆、智能体框架设计、循环工程、工具使用、技能和评估。论文还深入覆盖智能体间协调，包括通信协议以及集中式、去中心化和层次化多智能体架构。
2606.24937.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI: From Foundations to Systems

2606.25514.summary_en: This paper addresses complex software issue resolution with ambiguous descriptions, where long-horizon coding agents can suffer from context degradation and inefficient workflows. It proposes icat-agent, a decentralized multi-agent scaffold using synchronous event-based message passing and an issue-quality check to choose between parallel patching and preliminary exploration. Evaluations on SWE-bench variants report stronger issue resolution than several baselines using the same underlying models, with lower cost than a multi-agent Claude Code baseline.
2606.25514.summary_zh: 本文研究复杂软件问题修复，特别是描述模糊时长流程编码智能体容易出现上下文退化和低效工作流的问题。论文提出icat-agent，一种去中心化多智能体脚手架，使用同步事件式消息传递，并通过问题质量检查在并行修复与预探索之间切换。在SWE-bench相关评测中，该方法在相同底层模型下优于多个基线，并较多智能体Claude Code基线降低成本。
2606.25514.title: Unlocking Model Potentials Through Adaptive Multi-Agent Scaffolding for Efficient Issue Resolution

2606.25599.summary_en: This paper addresses tie-line power shaping in industrial microgrids through coordination of heterogeneous resources across multiple timescales. It proposes SHAC, a sequential heterogeneous-agent coordination framework with role-specific observations, rewards, critics, action constraints, and multi-timescale actor-critic training. Numerical studies using real renewable generation and market data report improved economic and grid-friendly operation while maintaining real-time feasibility and safety constraints.
2606.25599.summary_zh: 本文研究工业微电网中通过多时间尺度异构资源协调实现联络线功率整形的问题。作者提出 SHAC 顺序异构智能体协调框架，包含跨角色观测、角色特定奖励和评论器、动作约束以及多时间尺度 actor-critic 训练。基于真实可再生能源和电力市场数据的数值研究显示，该方法在满足实时性与安全约束的同时改善了经济性和电网友好性。
2606.25599.title: Reference-Free Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Grid-Friendly Tie-Line Power Shaping in Industrial Microgrids

2606.28187.summary_en: This paper tackles miscoordination and weak credit assignment in LLM-based multi-agent systems. It proposes Gradient-Based Connections, which represents a multi-agent system as a computational graph and assigns token-level gradient-based connection weights to trace how each agent output affects downstream agents. Experiments report improved multi-agent performance and attribution quality, with AgentChord providing an efficient prefix-gradient implementation for targeted prompt optimization.
2606.28187.summary_zh: 本文解决基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中的协调失误和细粒度信用分配不足问题。论文提出Gradient-Based Connections，将多智能体系统建模为计算图，并用词元级梯度连接权重追踪各智能体输出对下游智能体的影响。实验显示该方法提升了多智能体性能和归因质量，AgentChord则通过前缀梯度计算实现高效的定向提示优化。
2606.28187.title: GBC: Gradient-Based Connections for Optimizing Multi-Agent Systems

2606.29354.summary_en: The paper addresses the inefficiency of long natural-language chain-of-thought reasoning in LLMs by introducing compact symbolic communication among multiple agents. It proposes CLSR, where agents invent, evolve, and share reusable Language Symbolism Frameworks with symbols, usage rules, and message-passing contracts, while a router selects or composes them at test time for each query. Across reasoning benchmarks, the method claims lower generated-token latency than standard CoT while maintaining accuracy, and frames symbolic protocols as reusable communication mechanisms.
2606.29354.summary_zh: 本文针对大语言模型长自然语言思维链推理效率低的问题，提出多智能体之间的紧凑符号通信机制。作者提出 CLSR，使多个智能体自主发明、演化并共享包含符号、使用规则和消息传递契约的语言符号框架，同时由路由器在测试时按查询选择或组合这些框架。实验声称该方法相较标准 CoT 显著减少生成 token 延迟并保持准确性，将符号协议视为可复用的通信机制。
2606.29354.title: When LLMs Develop Languages: Symbolic Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning

2606.29981.summary_en: This paper argues that cybersecurity research automation requires a distinct AI scientist object because its evidence, environments, and evaluation differ from more stable scientific domains. It proposes a modular, role-specialized multi-agent architecture for problem framing, threat modeling, tool generation, experimentation, governance, and reporting, positioning it as an agenda for future systems and benchmarks.
2606.29981.summary_zh: 本文认为，网络安全研究自动化需要一种不同于稳定科学领域的AI科学家对象，因为其研究证据、环境和评估方式具有事件性、交互性和非平稳性。作者提出一个模块化、角色专门化的多智能体架构，用于问题定义、威胁建模、工具生成、受控实验、治理和报告，并将其作为后续系统与基准的研究议程。
2606.29981.title: Hephaestus: Toward a Cybersecurity AI Scientist

2606.31347.summary_en: The paper studies decentralized smart charging for large electric-vehicle fleets, where implicit coordination is needed to minimize user costs and avoid grid overloads. It compares independent multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches, specifically contextual combinatorial bandits and policy-gradient algorithms, in a realistic simulation with local agent observations and dynamic pricing. The evaluation varies congestion, heterogeneous agent groups, and mixed strategies to assess decentralized charging performance.
2606.31347.summary_zh: 本文研究大规模电动汽车车队的去中心化智能充电问题，其中车辆之间需要隐式协调以降低用户成本并避免电网过载。作者比较了两类独立多智能体强化学习方法，即上下文组合 bandit 和策略梯度算法，并在包含本地观测与动态电价的真实感仿真环境中评估。实验考察了不同拥塞水平、异质智能体组和混合策略配置下的充电优化表现。
2606.31347.title: Smart charging of large fleets of Electric Vehicles: Independent Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning approaches

2606.31498.summary_en: The paper examines whether current agent interoperability protocols can support governed communities of heterogeneous agents rather than only task coordination. It performs a systematic gap analysis of MCP, A2A, ACP, ANP, and ERC-8004 against governance requirements including membership, deliberation, voting, dissent preservation, escalation, and audit/replay. The analysis finds major missing primitives, especially for voting and dissent preservation, and argues that governance requires an architectural layer above existing interoperability standards.
2606.31498.summary_zh: 本文考察现有智能体互操作协议是否能够支持异质智能体的治理型共同体，而不仅是任务协调。作者根据成员资格、审议、投票、异议保留、人工升级和审计/回放等治理需求，对 MCP、A2A、ACP、ANP 和 ERC-8004 进行系统缺口分析。结果显示，投票和异议保留等关键原语普遍缺失，说明智能体共同体治理需要位于现有互操作标准之上的新架构层。
2606.31498.title: Governance Gaps in Agent Interoperability Protocols: What MCP, A2A, and ACP Cannot Express

2607.01600.summary_en: This paper introduces BOUNDARY_SYNC, a protocol for measuring whether communication among LLM agents causes representational coupling or output convergence. It defines the Coupling Amplification Factor and evaluates text and image communication in controlled experiments. The results claim that inter-agent communication can induce measurable homogenization, with effects depending on modality, group size, model, and prompt context.
2607.01600.summary_zh: 本文提出 BOUNDARY_SYNC，用于测量 LLM 智能体之间的通信是否导致表征耦合或输出收敛。作者定义了耦合放大因子，并在受控实验中评估文本和图像通信。结果表明，智能体间通信能够引发可测量的同质化，其影响受模态、群体规模、模型和提示上下文等因素调节。
2607.01600.title: BOUNDARY_SYNC: Measuring Communication-Induced Representational Coupling in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

2607.01755.summary_en: This paper studies decentralized nonsmooth nonconvex optimization with compressed inter-agent communication. It proposes a unified framework covering decentralized stochastic subgradient-type methods with unbiased compression and contractive compression with error compensation, then establishes global convergence via differential-inclusion analysis. The work also develops several compression-based methods and presents preliminary experiments illustrating communication-accuracy trade-offs.
2607.01755.summary_zh: 本文研究在智能体间通信被压缩时的去中心化非光滑非凸优化问题。作者提出一个统一框架，涵盖带无偏压缩和带误差补偿收缩压缩的去中心化随机次梯度类方法，并通过微分包含分析建立全局收敛性。论文还提出若干基于压缩的新方法，并用初步数值实验展示通信与精度之间的权衡。
2607.01755.title: Decentralized Stochastic Subgradient-type Methods with Communication Compression for Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization

2607.03473.summary_en: This paper targets bandwidth-efficient communication in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning under partial observability. It proposes MUTE, which frames communication reduction as value-guided machine unlearning by estimating counterfactual message value and removing low-value transmissions while preserving joint-policy return. The authors provide a theoretical bound on performance degradation and report large bandwidth reductions with performance comparable to strong baselines.
2607.03473.summary_zh: 本文关注部分可观测协作多智能体强化学习中的带宽高效通信。作者提出 MUTE，将通信削减建模为价值引导的机器遗忘问题，通过估计反事实消息价值并移除低价值消息，同时保持联合策略回报。论文给出了稀疏化导致性能差距的理论上界，并报告在大幅降低带宽的同时保持了与强基线相当的性能。
2607.03473.title: MUTE: Return-Preserving Communication Unlearning for Efficient Multi-Agent Coordination

2607.05318.summary_en: This paper introduces PiSAs, a benchmark for contextual-integrity privacy risks in shared multi-user agentic systems. It measures inappropriate information leakage across outputs, inter-agent communication, shared memory, and agents using dual annotations for task appropriateness and authorized user access. The authors find that system design can improve compliance, but LLM judgment errors remain a bottleneck for filtering and restricting information transmission.
2607.05318.summary_zh: 本文提出 PiSAs，一个用于评估共享多用户智能体系统中情境完整性隐私风险的基准。该基准通过任务适当性和授权用户访问权限的双重标注，衡量输出、智能体间通信、共享记忆和智能体组件中的不当信息泄漏。作者发现系统设计可以改善合规性，但 LLM 判断错误仍然限制了内容过滤和信息传输权限控制。
2607.05318.title: PiSAs: Benchmarking Contextual Integrity in Multi-User Agentic Systems

2607.07729.summary_en: This chapter presents a multi-agent framework for coordinating foundation models in cooperative reasoning systems. Solver models generate drafts, a critic agent supports critique and revision, and an aggregator synthesizes consensus, with scoring across semantic, numerical, and procedural dimensions. Ablations compare individual, homogeneous, redundant homogeneous, and heterogeneous configurations, claiming that model heterogeneity is the main driver of improved step-wise reasoning quality and reduced variance.
2607.07729.summary_zh: 本文章提出一种用于协调基础模型进行协作推理的多智能体框架。多个求解器生成草稿，批评智能体进行结构化评审与修订，聚合智能体综合形成共识，并通过语义、数值和过程维度进行评分。消融研究比较个体、同质、冗余同质和异构配置，认为模型异质性是提升逐步推理质量并降低方差的关键因素。
2607.07729.title: Collective Intelligence with Foundation Models

2607.09740.summary_en: This paper addresses scene-level lane-change intention and trajectory prediction for multiple interacting vehicles, where single-target methods miss interaction structure and multi-agent forecasts often omit maneuver semantics. It proposes a dynamic scene graph attention framework with temporal graph-attention message passing, intention-guided decoding, and a scene-level consistency objective. Experiments on NGSIM and highD show improved intention accuracy, trajectory RMSE, collision rates, and joint displacement errors over baselines.
2607.09740.summary_zh: 本文研究多交互车辆的场景级换道意图与轨迹预测问题，指出单目标方法难以刻画交互，而多智能体预测常缺少明确机动语义。作者提出动态场景图注意力框架，通过时序图注意力消息传递、意图引导解码和场景一致性目标联合预测每辆车的意图与轨迹。实验表明该方法在NGSIM和highD数据集上提升了意图预测、轨迹误差、碰撞率和联合位移误差表现。
2607.09740.title: A Dynamic Scene Interaction Reasoning Framework for Scene-level Lane-Change Intention and Trajectory Prediction of Multiple Interacting Vehicles

2607.10836.summary_en: This paper proposes GRADE, a hierarchical multi-agent reasoning system designed to reduce the cost of multi-agent ensembling. It uses learned gates to control agent selection, hierarchy depth, inter-agent communication, and branch pruning, trained with a collaborative variant of GRPO and supported by a hot-swappable expert registry. Experiments across reasoning benchmarks report improved accuracy-compute trade-offs, with ablations identifying hierarchy and masked cross-attention as major contributors.
2607.10836.summary_zh: 本文提出 GRADE，一种旨在降低多智能体集成成本的层次化多智能体推理系统。该系统使用学习到的门控机制控制智能体选择、层级深度、智能体间通信和分支剪枝，并通过协作式 GRPO 训练，同时支持专家模型热替换。多个推理基准实验显示其改善了精度与计算成本的权衡，消融结果表明层级结构和掩码交叉注意力是主要贡献因素。
2607.10836.title: Route, Communicate, and Reason: Gated Routing and Adaptive Depth for Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning

2607.11226.summary_en: The paper addresses the trade-off between creativity and safety in tool-using LLM agents by separating roles across heterogeneous agent cohorts. It proposes a Disrupter, Validator, and Broker architecture, with failures compiled via MCTS into reusable signed constraint patches called Scars, and communication allocation scores limiting outbound bandwidth. In a spatial-semantic sandbox, the cohort reportedly reaches remote targets while preventing executed breaches and reducing token costs through cached constraints and bandwidth control.
2607.11226.summary_zh: 本文研究工具型大语言模型智能体中创造性与安全性之间的权衡，并通过异质智能体队列进行角色分工。作者提出由 Disrupter、Validator 和 Broker 组成的架构，将失败通过 MCTS 编译为可复用的签名约束补丁 Scars，并用通信分配分数限制外发带宽。在空间语义沙盒中，该队列能够到达远程目标，同时阻止已执行的安全违规并降低 token 成本。
2607.11226.title: Heterogeneous Agent Cohorts for Safe Open-Ended Exploration with Runtime Constraint Memory

2607.11503.summary_en: This paper addresses long-form article generation by replacing fixed prompt-entangled multi-agent pipelines with an inspectable loop of named declarative skills. GEIS composes writing, evidence collection, evaluation, and skill-improvement modules, and evaluations on Wikipedia Featured Article topics show improved PDF quality scores over the default writer and stronger comparable writing dimensions than STORM.
2607.11503.summary_zh: 本文针对长篇文章生成中长上下文、长指令和长输出并存的困难，提出用可检查的命名声明式技能循环替代固定且与提示纠缠的多智能体流程。GEIS组合写作、证据收集、评估和技能改进模块，在维基百科特色文章主题上的评测显示其PDF质量评分高于默认写作者，并在可比写作维度上优于STORM。
2607.11503.title: GEIS: A Generation-Evaluation-Improvement Loop of Agent Skills for Long-Form Article Generation

2607.12077.summary_en: This paper studies whether communication routing in multi-agent language-model populations causally affects consensus or fragmentation. Using controlled naming games with open-weight models and analyses of emitted labels plus first-token preference distributions, it shows that similarity-based routing can sustain cliques, while rematching or connecting disagreeing groups can improve coordination only under certain memory conditions; routing also affects answer propagation on benchmarks without reliably improving accuracy.
2607.12077.summary_zh: 本文研究多智能体语言模型群体中的通信路由是否会因果性地影响共识形成或群体分裂。作者在受控命名游戏中分析开放权重模型的输出标签和首词偏好分布，发现基于相似性的路由会维持派系，而随机重配或连接分歧群体只在特定记忆条件下改善协调；路由还会改变基准任务中正确与错误答案的传播，但不稳定提升准确率。
2607.12077.title: Graph Feedback Controls Consensus and Clique Formation in Open-Weight Language-Model Populations

2607.12406.summary_en: This survey argues that isolation should be treated as a first-class safety principle for LLM-agent systems. It organizes failures and defenses around five boundaries: user-agent, agent-tool, agent-execution, agent-agent, and system-environment, explaining how prompt injection, tool misuse, and memory poisoning can propagate through workflows. The paper outlines challenges and future directions for isolation-by-construction in agent systems.
2607.12406.summary_zh: 本文综述认为，应将隔离作为 LLM 智能体系统安全的一等原则。作者围绕用户-智能体、智能体-工具、智能体-执行、智能体-智能体和系统-环境五类边界组织故障与防御，解释提示注入、工具误用和记忆投毒等问题如何在工作流中传播。论文进一步总结开放挑战，并提出未来面向构造式隔离的研究方向。
2607.12406.title: Isolation as a First-Class Principle for LLM-Agent System Safety: Concepts, Taxonomy, Challenges and Future Directions

2607.13524.summary_en: The paper studies multi-agent active 3D reconstruction, where agents must select informative viewpoints under sensing budgets while avoiding redundant observations and clustering. It proposes COLMAR, a cooperative view policy learning framework with shared policy optimization over map-centric observations, reconstruction-aware rewards, parameter-sharing PPO, and independent per-agent deployment conditioned on a fused team map. Experiments on 3D reconstruction benchmarks report improved reconstruction accuracy and coverage over heuristic and non-cooperative baselines without inter-agent message passing at decision time.
2607.13524.summary_zh: 本文研究多智能体主动三维重建中的视角选择问题，要求在有限感知预算下减少冗余观测和空间聚集。作者提出 COLMAR，一种合作式视角策略学习框架，基于地图中心观测进行共享策略优化，使用重建感知目标和参数共享 PPO，并在部署时让各智能体基于融合团队地图独立选择动作。实验显示，该方法相较启发式和非合作基线提高了重建精度与覆盖率，且决策时不依赖智能体间消息传递。
2607.13524.title: COLMAR: Cooperative View Policy Learning for Multi-Agent Active 3D Reconstruction

2607.16133.summary_en: This paper asks when LLM-based multi-agent systems outperform single-agent systems. It models the difference through an information bottleneck: single agents keep a full shared reasoning trace, while multi-agent systems communicate through bounded relay messages, creating a compression trade-off. The authors argue and experimentally support that multi-agent gains arise when context reduction helps more than relay information loss, especially for weaker models and near-sufficient relays.
2607.16133.summary_zh: 本文研究基于 LLM 的多智能体系统何时优于单智能体系统。作者从信息瓶颈角度建模二者差异：单智能体保留完整共享推理轨迹，而多智能体通过有界中继消息连接局部上下文，从而形成压缩与信息损失的权衡。论文认为并通过实验支持，当上下文缩减带来的收益超过中继信息损失时，多智能体更有优势，尤其是在较弱模型和中继信息接近充分的情况下。
2607.16133.title: When Do Multi-Agent Systems Help? An Information Bottleneck Perspective

2607.17914.summary_en: This paper addresses robust multi-agent coordination when inter-agent communication is intermittently lost. It extends MARO with value-aware prediction, weighting a missing-state predictor’s loss by advantage estimates so the model focuses on high-return dynamics rather than uniformly reconstructing all transitions. Experiments in Multi-Agent Particle Environment tasks show better robustness under low communication reliability, particularly in high-attrition scenarios.
2607.17914.summary_zh: 本文研究智能体间通信间歇性丢失时的鲁棒多智能体协调问题。作者提出 Value-Aware MARO，用优势估计动态加权缺失共享状态预测器的损失，使模型聚焦于高回报动态，而不是平均重构所有转移。多智能体粒子环境实验表明，该方法在通信可靠性下降时更稳健，尤其在高通信损耗场景中避免了标准预测器的性能崩溃。
2607.17914.title: Value-Aware Prediction for Robust Multi-Agent Coordination Under Communication Loss

2607.17922.summary_en: This paper studies loss of plasticity in shared-parameter multi-agent reinforcement learning for UAV-assisted emergency communication networks under non-stationarity. It proposes PRIME, which extends bidirectional Silent Neuron analysis by aggregating team-level activation and gradient statistics and reinitializing only neurons that are both activation-dormant and gradient-silent. Experiments in a phase-switching UAV simulator show improved returns and lower dormant-neuron fractions, with ablations supporting the role of gradient signals and team-level aggregation.
2607.17922.summary_zh: 本文研究非平稳条件下无人机辅助应急通信网络中共享参数多智能体强化学习的可塑性丧失问题。作者提出PRIME，将双向Silent Neuron分析扩展到合作多智能体强化学习，通过团队级激活和梯度统计，仅重置同时激活沉默且梯度沉默的神经元。相位切换无人机模拟器实验显示，该方法提升回报并降低沉默神经元比例，消融实验支持梯度信号和团队级聚合的重要性。
2607.17922.title: PRIME: Plasticity Recovery in Multi-Agent Environments for UAV-Assisted Emergency Communication Networks

2607.17924.summary_en: The paper analyzes cooperative multi-agent policy optimization and asks how neighboring agents should be aggregated in PPO-style MARL objectives. It formalizes aggregation in the advantage and in the likelihood ratio using support matrices, proving that the expected objective depends on them only through their matrix product while variance behaves differently across the two axes. The resulting principle is to aggregate neighboring rewards in the advantage up to the coupling neighborhood while keeping likelihood ratios per-agent.
2607.17924.summary_zh: 本文分析合作式多智能体策略优化，关注 PPO 类 MARL 目标中应如何聚合邻近智能体。作者用支持矩阵形式化优势函数和似然比中的聚合，并证明期望目标仅通过二者的矩阵乘积起作用，但两个方向的方差性质不同。由此得到的设计原则是，在优势项中按耦合邻域聚合邻居奖励，而似然比应保持逐智能体形式。
2607.17924.title: Aggregate in the Advantage, Not the Ratio: A Canonical-Form Analysis of Cooperative Multi-Agent Policy Optimization

2607.18102.summary_en: This paper addresses financial question answering over SEC filings, where retrieval can fail because model-generated queries and semantic reranking are misaligned with corpus structure and evidence standards. It proposes FinSAgent, a corpus-aligned multi-agent RAG framework using role-specialized agents tied to 10-K item structure, database-aware query decomposition, and feature-gated reranking. Experiments on offline benchmarks and an online user-rating study report improved retrieval coverage and answer correctness over single-agent and multi-agent baselines.
2607.18102.summary_zh: 本文研究SEC文件问答中的证据检索问题，指出模型生成查询和语义重排序可能与语料结构及证据标准不匹配。论文提出FinSAgent，一种语料对齐的多智能体RAG框架，包含锚定10-K条目结构的角色专门化智能体、数据库感知查询分解和特征门控重排序。离线基准和在线用户评分实验表明，该方法相较单智能体和多智能体基线提高了检索覆盖率和答案正确性。
2607.18102.title: FinSAgent: Corpus-Aligned Multi-Agent RAG Framework for Evidence-Grounded SEC Filing Question Answering

2607.18138.summary_en: This paper investigates how AI-native 6G networks could support emerging AI agent communication requirements. It evaluates current and proposed 6G architectures and protocol specifications against the Service-Oriented Virtualization-Based Architecture framework, focusing on interoperability and infrastructure gaps. The paper identifies mismatches between 6G standards and agent communication demands and outlines research directions for native network support of agent communications.
2607.18138.summary_zh: 本文研究AI原生6G网络如何支持新兴AI智能体通信需求。论文以服务导向虚拟化架构SOVA为参照，评估现有和拟议的6G架构与协议规范，重点关注互操作性和基础设施缺口。研究指出6G标准与智能体通信需求之间的差距，并提出未来网络原生支持智能体通信的研发方向。
2607.18138.title: AI Agent Communications in AI-Native 6G Network: Status, Challenges and Opportunities

2607.18847.summary_en: The paper addresses data leakage and tool misuse in agentic applications caused by instruction/data boundary failures and prompt injection, especially across heterogeneous multi-agent workflows. It proposes a pre-deployment pipeline that scans prompt templates, tool interfaces, and invocation code, applies targeted hardening such as schema tightening and tool gating, and validates changes with adversarial and benign inputs. Evaluations on real-world agentic applications and AgentDojo show recurring leakage patterns can be patched without disrupting intended behavior, with reported leakage reductions under tested attacks.
2607.18847.summary_zh: 本文研究智能体应用中的数据泄漏与工具滥用问题，尤其是多代码库和异质智能体工作流中由指令/数据边界失效和提示注入导致的风险。作者提出一种部署前流水线，用于扫描提示模板、工具接口和调用代码，实施模式收紧、边界清洗、工具白名单和最小权限检查等加固措施，并通过对抗与良性输入验证。实验显示，该流水线能识别并修复反复出现的泄漏模式，同时保持应用预期功能。
2607.18847.title: Data Leakage Prevention in Agentic Applications via Preemptive Hardening

2607.19117.summary_en: This paper studies whether single-agent actor-critic methods for parameterized action reinforcement learning benefit from shared-experience multi-agent extensions. It proposes MAGAC, MASAC, and MATQC, where independent agents share a replay buffer while retaining separate policies and value networks, and compares them with single-agent counterparts across multiple agent counts. The results indicate consistent gains for Greedy Actor-Critic, more modest gains for SAC and TQC variants, and a scalability trade-off as additional agents increase computation with limited extra benefit beyond five agents.
2607.19117.summary_zh: 本文研究参数化动作强化学习中的单智能体演员-评论家方法是否能从共享经验的多智能体扩展中受益。论文提出MAGAC、MASAC和MATQC，使多个独立智能体共享回放缓冲区但保留各自的策略和值网络，并在不同智能体数量下与单智能体方法比较。结果表明，多智能体框架稳定提升Greedy Actor-Critic，但对SAC和TQC变体提升较有限，且超过五个智能体后额外收益有限而计算成本明显上升。
2607.19117.title: Comparative Study of Multi-Agent Actor-Critic Algorithms in Parameterized Action Reinforcement Learning

2607.19212.summary_en: This paper introduces an interactive music system in which quantum musical agents communicate by teleporting quantum states. It encodes melodic and rhythmic behavior as quantum states, combines up to three agents in a circuit, and treats noise and decoherence as expressive features rather than only errors. Demonstrations using melodic correlation, pitch-set distance, and state fidelity suggest a continuum between imitation and divergence in agent reinterpretation of teleported states.
2607.19212.summary_zh: 本文提出一种交互式音乐系统，其中量子音乐智能体通过量子态传输进行通信。系统将旋律和节奏行为编码为量子态，在单个量子电路中组合最多三个智能体，并将噪声和退相干视为表达性特征而非单纯缺陷。基于旋律相关性、音高集合距离和态保真度的演示表明，智能体对传输态的再解释呈现从模仿到发散的连续谱。
2607.19212.title: Teleportation Game: Quantum Teleportation in Multi-Agent Systems for Interactive Music

2607.19809.summary_en: This paper proposes Dreamer-CPC, a decentralized model-based multi-agent reinforcement learning method for communication under partial observability. It integrates Collective Predictive Coding message learning into DreamerV3 world models so agents exchange messages inferred from latent states that encode past observations and actions. Experiments in two environments show that world-model-grounded messages outperform current-observation message baselines and no-communication baselines, especially when task-relevant observations are temporarily unavailable.
2607.19809.summary_zh: 本文提出 Dreamer-CPC，一种面向部分可观测环境中通信的去中心化模型式多智能体强化学习方法。该方法将 Collective Predictive Coding 的消息学习整合进 DreamerV3 世界模型，使智能体基于包含历史观测和动作的潜在状态推断并交换消息。实验表明，基于世界模型的通信优于仅基于当前观测的消息方法和无通信基线，尤其适用于任务相关观测暂时缺失的场景。
2607.19809.title: Dreamer-CPC: Message Learning with World Models for Decentralized Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning

2607.21606.summary_en: TILT addresses compositional failures in text-to-image diffusion models at test time. It introduces a training-free reward-alignment framework that defines a model-intrinsic reward favoring samples where all prompt concepts are jointly present, yielding a KL-constrained tilted target distribution and corresponding guidance strategies. Experiments on T2ICompBench show improved compositional alignment while preserving image quality relative to prior baselines.
2607.21606.summary_zh: TILT 研究文本到图像扩散模型在复杂组合提示下的生成失配问题。该方法提出一种无需训练的测试时奖励对齐框架，使用模型内在奖励鼓励样本同时包含所有概念，并推导出 KL 约束的倾斜目标分布及相应引导策略。基于 T2ICompBench 的实验表明，该方法相较既有基线提升了组合对齐能力，同时保持图像质量。
2607.21606.title: TILT: Improving Compositional Generation in Diffusion Models with a Model-Intrinsic Reward

2607.21655.summary_en: This survey reviews progress reward modeling for robotic learning, motivated by the limitations of terminal success signals in dynamic environments with large behavior spaces. It organizes the literature around model interfaces, internal methods for progress estimation and reward generation, and the data and benchmarks used for supervision and evaluation. The paper offers a unified framework, summarizes current limitations, and outlines future research directions for progress-aware robotic learning.
2607.21655.summary_zh: 本文综述机器人学习中的进展奖励建模，出发点是动态环境和大行为空间中终端成功信号无法说明行为是否正在推进任务。作者从进展模型接口、进展估计与奖励生成方法，以及用于监督和评估的数据与基准三个方面组织现有研究。论文提出统一框架，总结当前方法局限，并讨论面向进展感知机器人学习的未来方向。
2607.21655.title: Progress Reward Modeling for Robotic Learning: A Comprehensive Survey

2607.21694.summary_en: This paper introduces Oxygen-TryOn, a fashion-native foundation model for virtual try-on across diverse item categories and multi-item scenarios. Instead of mask-based inpainting, it formulates try-on as a multi-reference, understanding-driven generation task supported by a dedicated data engine and a three-stage training recipe of continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning. Evaluations claim state-of-the-art or leading consistency and realism across public and in-house benchmarks for single-item and multi-item try-on.
2607.21694.summary_zh: 本文提出Oxygen-TryOn，一个面向多类时尚单品和多物品场景的虚拟试穿基础模型。该方法不采用基于掩码的修复，而是将试穿表述为多参考、理解驱动的生成任务，并结合专用数据引擎以及继续预训练、监督微调和强化学习三阶段训练。评估声称其在公开和内部基准上的单品及多品试穿一致性与真实感达到领先水平。
2607.21694.title: Oxygen-TryOn: Fashion-Native Foundation Model for Any-item Virtual Try-On

2607.21873.summary_en: This systematic review examines how multi-agent systems can support digital twins for predictive maintenance in distributed, resource-constrained industrial settings. It analyzes more than 547 papers to build a taxonomy of hybrid architectures, identify bottlenecks, and formulate open questions around embedded AI, lightweight coordination protocols, and hierarchical orchestration. The review claims that existing systems still lack an integrated embedded-distributed hierarchical solution meeting Industry 5.0 requirements.
2607.21873.summary_zh: 该系统综述研究多智能体系统如何支持分布式、资源受限工业环境中的数字孪生预测性维护。论文分析了547篇以上文献，建立混合架构分类，识别技术瓶颈，并提出嵌入式AI、轻量级协调协议和层级编排方面的开放问题。其主要结论是，现有系统尚未形成同时满足工业5.0需求的嵌入式、分布式、层级化一体方案。
2607.21873.title: Multi-Agent System-driven Digital Twins for predictive maintenance: architectures, technologies and open research challenges

2607.21936.summary_en: This paper addresses historical document restoration, especially the recovery of named entities that require external knowledge beyond local masked-language context. It proposes ARI, a retrieval-augmented large language model framework that combines pretrained LLM knowledge with explicitly retrieved historical context. Experiments on Korean historical documents and expert evaluations indicate improved restoration of both general characters and named entities and support its practical utility for domain experts.
2607.21936.summary_zh: 本文研究历史文献修复问题，重点关注需要外部历史知识才能恢复的命名实体。作者提出ARI，一个检索增强大型语言模型框架，将预训练LLM的隐含知识与显式检索到的历史上下文结合。韩国历史文献实验和专家评估表明，该方法提升了一般字符和命名实体修复效果，并具有辅助领域专家分析史料的实用价值。
2607.21936.title: Leveraging External Knowledge for Historical Document Restoration via Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models

2607.21946.summary_en: This technical report presents a system for visual physics question answering in which key information may reside in figures. The method first converts visual figure content into solver-readable text, then orchestrates three heterogeneous solvers through multi-agent debate for reasoning and answer selection. The analysis claims that most orchestration gain comes from reliable answer selection rather than extended debate, and reports improved challenge performance over a single-agent baseline.
2607.21946.summary_zh: 该技术报告提出一种用于视觉物理题问答的系统，其中关键信息可能位于图像中。方法首先将图中内容转写为求解器可读文本，然后通过多智能体辩论编排三个异质求解器进行推理和答案选择。分析认为，编排收益主要来自可靠答案选择而非额外辩论，并报告其相较单智能体基线提升了挑战赛表现。
2607.21946.title: Multi-Agent Debate and Visual Information Extraction for SeePhys Pro: A 1st-Place Technical Report from ICML 2026 AI4Math Track 3 Challenge

2607.22098.summary_en: This paper studies hallucination detection in large reasoning models by using their generated reasoning traces while addressing noise from irrelevant and repetitive steps. It proposes REDE, a denoising framework that uses final-answer attention as automatic supervision to shape step-level representations and filter noisy reasoning steps. Experiments across reasoning benchmarks show that applying REDE to filtered trajectories improves hallucination detection over competitive baselines.
2607.22098.summary_zh: 本文研究如何利用大型推理模型生成的推理轨迹进行幻觉检测，同时处理无关步骤和重复步骤带来的噪声。作者提出REDE，一种以最终答案注意力作为自动监督信号的去噪框架，用于塑造步骤级表示并过滤噪声推理步骤。多个推理基准实验显示，将REDE应用于过滤后的轨迹可提升幻觉检测性能。
2607.22098.title: Reasoning Denoiser: Denoising Reasoning Traces for Hallucination Detection in Large Reasoning Models

2607.22148.summary_en: This paper proposes dRAE, a discrete representation autoencoder using Hyper-Spherical Quantization to discretize high-dimensional visual representations for compatibility with language-model-style tokenization. It argues that Euclidean codebook objectives are mismatched with anisotropic representation geometry, causing collapse and poor scalability, and instead uses angular routing to separate semantic content from feature magnitude. Experiments report high-fidelity reconstruction, semantic preservation, full codebook utilization, and improved scaling to large vocabularies.
2607.22148.summary_zh: 本文提出dRAE，一种使用超球面量化的离散表示自编码器，用于将高维视觉表示离散化以弥合其与语言模型式token化之间的差距。作者认为欧氏码本目标与各向异性表示空间几何不匹配，会导致码本坍塌和可扩展性问题，因此采用角度路由将语义内容与特征幅度解耦。实验显示该方法实现高保真重建、语义保持、完整码本利用率，并能扩展到大规模词表。
2607.22148.title: dRAE: Representation Autoencoder with Hyper-Spherical Codes

2607.22561.summary_en: This paper proposes program distillation as a scalable alternative to LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. The PAJAMA system synthesizes committees of programmatic judges, aggregates their decisions, and selectively escalates low-confidence cases to an LLM, aiming to reduce latency, cost, and opacity. Experiments across datasets and model families claim that programmatic judges can match a medium-size LLM judge, improve accuracy-throughput trade-offs, and provide inexpensive reward signals.
2607.22561.summary_zh: 本文提出程序蒸馏，作为LLM-as-a-judge自动评估范式的可扩展替代方案。PAJAMA系统合成程序化评审器委员会，聚合其判断，并在低置信度情况下选择性升级到LLM，以降低延迟、成本和不透明性。跨数据集和模型族实验声称，程序评审器可匹配中等规模LLM评审器，改善准确率与吞吐量权衡，并提供低成本奖励信号。
2607.22561.title: Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation

2607.22639.summary_en: TRACE addresses weaknesses in parametric tool retrieval for enterprise LLMs, where prior training can damage tool knowledge and beam-search decoding is too slow for deployment. It proposes a two-stage curriculum that first seeds tool knowledge and then trains the model to emit reasoning traces before JSON tool-token lists using rule-based and retrieval-relevant data. Experiments on large enterprise tool catalogs show preserved or improved tool understanding and stronger recall than embedding baselines with single-beam greedy decoding.
2607.22639.summary_zh: TRACE 研究企业 LLM 中参数化工具检索的问题，指出既有方法会破坏工具知识且束搜索解码难以满足实时部署。该方法采用两阶段课程学习，先注入工具知识，再训练模型在输出 JSON 工具 token 列表前生成推理轨迹，并利用业务规则和检索相关数据。实验表明，TRACE 在大型企业工具目录上保持并提升工具理解能力，同时以单束贪心解码取得优于嵌入基线的召回表现。
2607.22639.title: TRACE: Business Rule-Grounded Reasoning Curriculum for Knowledge-Preserving Parametric Tool Retrieval in Enterprise LLMs

2607.22682.summary_en: This paper introduces a vocabulary for describing and comparing automated research systems composed of one or more agents. The vocabulary specifies agents, operations, invocation rights, communication, visibility, action selection, initialization, outputs, and evaluation, treating repeated stochastic runs as distributions over trajectories. It reframes design choices such as communication timing, capability allocation, memory, and evaluation quality as testable system components.
2607.22682.summary_zh: 本文提出一套词汇表，用于描述和比较由一个或多个智能体组成的自动化研究系统。该词汇表涵盖智能体、操作、调用权限、通信方式、信息可见性、动作选择、初始化、输出和评估，并将随机重复运行视为轨迹分布。它把通信时机、能力分配、跨运行记忆和评估质量等结构设计问题转化为可检验的系统选择。
2607.22682.title: A Vocabulary for Multi-Agent Automated Research Systems

2607.22758.summary_en: This paper analyzes communication topology risks in clinical multi-agent language model networks, challenging assumptions that scale-free or small-world structures are optimal for semantic communication. It maps uncertainty trajectories into a clinical embedding space and studies graph structures through variance, entropy, cosine similarity, and spectral properties. The paper claims that clustered or hub-centric topologies can amplify semantic drift and hallucinations, and proposes dynamic spectral monitoring with algebraic-connectivity constraints to improve global state diffusion.
2607.22758.summary_zh: 本文分析临床多智能体语言模型网络中的通信拓扑风险，质疑尺度无关和小世界结构对语义通信最优的常见假设。论文将通信不确定性轨迹映射到临床嵌入空间，并通过方差、熵、余弦相似度和谱性质研究图结构影响。论文主张，高聚类或枢纽中心拓扑会放大语义漂移和幻觉，并提出基于代数连通度约束的动态谱监测以促进全局状态扩散。
2607.22758.title: Spectral Dynamics of Semantic Drift in Clinical Multi-Agent Language Model Networks

2607.22798.summary_en: This paper argues that computer-use agents should act on program state rather than relying mainly on screenshots. It introduces StateAct, a code-first multi-agent harness in which a main agent manipulates program state, a GUI subagent handles screenshot-and-click subgoals, independent verification checks final artifacts, and fresh subagents manage long-horizon context. On OSWorld 2.0, StateAct improves binary and partial success over a screenshot-driven baseline at lower cost, while showing that code-only access is insufficient for some tasks.
2607.22798.summary_zh: 本文认为计算机使用智能体应优先基于程序状态行动，而不是主要依赖截图感知。作者提出StateAct，一个代码优先的多智能体框架，其中主智能体操作程序状态，GUI子智能体处理少量截图点击子目标，独立完成门验证最终产物，并通过新子智能体维持长程任务上下文。OSWorld 2.0结果显示，StateAct以更低成本提升二元成功率和部分成功率，同时表明纯代码访问仍不足以覆盖所有任务。
2607.22798.title: StateAct: Program State, before Pixels, for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents

2607.23242.summary_en: IndicTalk addresses the scarcity of high-quality multilingual and code-mixed dialogue resources for Indic languages. It introduces a large persona-based corpus of event-grounded multi-turn conversations across 18 language varieties and 9 Indic languages, generated through an automated pipeline combining news grounding, persona-conditioned multilingual LLM dialogue generation, and quality validation. Linguistic, automatic, and human evaluations indicate that the corpus contains fluent, coherent, and naturally code-mixed conversations across script variants.
2607.23242.summary_zh: IndicTalk 针对印度语言中高质量多语种和代码混合对话资源稀缺的问题。该工作提出一个基于人格设定的大规模语料库，覆盖 9 种印度语言的 18 个语言变体，并通过新闻 grounding、人格条件化多语 LLM 对话生成和自动质量验证构建事件驱动多轮对话。语言学评估、自动评估和人工评估表明，该语料在不同书写形式下具有流畅、连贯且自然的代码混合特征。
2607.23242.title: IndicTalk: A Large-Scale Persona-Based Multilingual Conversational Corpus for Indic Languages

2607.23336.summary_en: This paper proposes a research agenda for governing societies of AI agents in the built environment, arguing that buildings, streets, and cities should be modeled as systems of negotiating agents rather than passive settings for single tools. It organizes the agenda around mechanism design for retrofit, physics-informed verification in building operations, and antifragile coordination for urban infrastructure under shocks. The paper develops conceptual foundations, a detailed governance event, and open problems for data, computation, disciplinary integration, and governance.
2607.23336.summary_zh: 本文提出面向建成环境中AI智能体社会的治理研究议程，认为建筑、街道和城市应被建模为协商智能体系统，而不是单个工具作用的被动环境。论文围绕改造中的机制设计、建筑运行中的物理约束验证以及冲击下城市基础设施的反脆弱协调组织议题。研究给出概念基础、一个具体治理事件和若干关于数据、计算、学科整合与治理的开放问题。
2607.23336.title: Constitutional governance for societies of AI agents in the built environment: a research agenda

2607.23370.summary_en: This paper addresses sub-daily Bitcoin price direction prediction under non-stationary market regimes and social sentiment effects. It proposes Regime-Aware Multi-Modal Learning, which detects stable versus volatile regimes using rolling volatility and adaptively gates sentiment and price embeddings. Evaluation on hourly Bitcoin and Reddit sentiment data shows improved macro-F1 and calibration over price-only, sentiment-only, and static-fusion baselines, with ablations supporting the role of adaptive regime-conditioned fusion.
2607.23370.summary_zh: 该论文研究非平稳市场状态和社交情绪影响下的亚日级比特币价格方向预测。作者提出 Regime-Aware Multi-Modal Learning，通过滚动波动率划分稳定与波动状态，并用可学习门控自适应融合情绪嵌入和价格嵌入。基于小时级比特币数据和 Reddit 情绪数据的实验显示，该方法相比单模态和静态融合基线具有更好的宏 F1 与校准表现，消融实验也支持状态条件化自适应融合的重要性。
2607.23370.title: Bitcoin Price Direction Prediction via Regime-Aware Multi-Modal Fusion of Social Sentiment and Technical Features

2607.23373.summary_en: UltraViT addresses the latency bottleneck of vision encoders in large vision-language models on edge devices. It proposes an on-device latency-optimized pyramidal encoder that integrates heterogeneous spatial mixers, along with a two-stage generative pretraining strategy using dense distillation and supervision from a frozen LLM. Experiments show improved efficient LVLM encoding performance and faster on-device operation relative to encoder-centric baselines.
2607.23373.summary_zh: UltraViT 针对大型视觉语言模型在边缘设备上部署时视觉编码器带来的延迟瓶颈。该方法设计了面向真实端侧延迟优化的金字塔式视觉编码器，整合异构空间混合模块，并提出包含密集蒸馏和冻结 LLM 生成式监督的两阶段预训练策略。实验表明，该设计在高效 LVLM 编码方面优于现有以编码器为中心的基线，并实现更快的端侧运行速度。
2607.23373.title: UltraViT: Latency-Optimized On-device Vision Encoder for Large Vision-Language Models

2607.23402.summary_en: This paper characterizes warp divergence behavior across NVIDIA GPU generations from Pascal through Blackwell. Using microbenchmarks, hardware counters, and SASS analysis, it separates stable performance behavior from changes in compiler-emitted reconvergence mechanisms. The study finds a stable linear serialization cost model for divergent paths across generations, while documenting substantial evolution in control-flow ISA and reconvergence machinery.
2607.23402.summary_zh: 该论文刻画了从 Pascal 到 Blackwell 的 NVIDIA GPU 中 warp 分歧行为。作者结合周期级微基准、硬件计数器和编译器生成 SASS 的静态分析，区分稳定的性能规律与重汇合机制的架构变化。研究发现分歧路径的序列化成本在各代 GPU 上保持线性且可预测，但控制流 ISA 和重汇合机制发生了显著演化。
2607.23402.title: Characterizing Warp Divergence from Pascal to Blackwell

2607.23518.summary_en: This paper introduces Chamaileon for protein binder design across multiple targets and states, moving beyond single-target, single-state assumptions. It formulates the task as cross-context binding landscape modeling and uses In-Context Complex Co-Design for context-aware sequence-structure co-modeling, with Mixture-of-Paths Sampling to optimize a single sequence across contexts. Evaluation on the CROSS benchmark suggests that Chamaileon generates sequences adaptable to diverse conformational landscapes and multi-target requirements.
2607.23518.summary_zh: 本文提出Chamaileon，用于跨多目标和多状态的蛋白质结合体设计，突破现有方法常见的单目标、单状态假设。作者将任务表述为跨上下文结合景观建模，并采用In-Context Complex Co-Design进行上下文感知的序列-结构协同建模，同时用Mixture-of-Paths Sampling在多个上下文中优化单一序列。CROSS基准评估表明，该方法能够生成适应多样构象景观和多目标需求的序列。
2607.23518.title: Chamaileon: Cross-Context Binder Design with Contextualized Modeling and Mixed Sampling

2607.23588.summary_en: This paper introduces JarvisHub, a canvas-native harness for long-horizon multimodal creative agents. It treats the editable canvas as external memory, action space, and shared project state, representing artifacts, dependencies, versions, tool actions, and feedback as typed nodes and links to support inspectable planning, generation, revision, and human intervention.
2607.23588.summary_zh: 本文提出JarvisHub，一个面向长时程多模态创作智能体的画布原生harness。它将可编辑画布同时作为外部记忆、动作空间和共享项目状态，用类型化节点与链接表示作品、依赖、版本、工具动作和反馈，从而支持可检查的规划、生成、修改与人工干预。
2607.23588.title: JarvisHub: An Open Harness for Canvas-Native Multimodal Creative Agents

2607.23678.summary_en: This paper addresses resource allocation in graph-based multi-agent LLM systems, where static execution can waste computation on irrelevant components. It introduces Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration, which estimates agent importance using goal relevance, graph topology, and resource constraints to prioritize execution across heterogeneous agents. Experiments across multi-agent workloads claim improved task effectiveness with reduced computation, latency, and token consumption.
2607.23678.summary_zh: 本文研究图结构多智能体 LLM 系统中的资源分配问题，因为静态执行可能在无关组件上浪费计算。作者提出 Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration，通过目标相关性、图拓扑和资源约束估计智能体重要性，并在异构智能体之间分配执行优先级。多智能体工作负载实验表明，该方法在减少计算、延迟和 token 消耗的同时提升了任务效果。
2607.23678.title: Focus Is All You Need: Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration for Multi-Agent Graph Systems

2607.23687.summary_en: GNM Head addresses the limited anatomical scope and geometric fidelity of publicly available parametric human-head models. It introduces a generative anthropometric model covering the head, face, neck, eyeballs, teeth, and tongue, built from high-resolution 3D scans and anatomy-specific artist-made samples with specialized ocular and intra-oral submodels. The report claims state-of-the-art fitting performance on target 3D face scans and releases the framework publicly.
2607.23687.summary_zh: GNM Head 针对现有公开参数化人头模型解剖范围有限、几何质量不足的问题。该工作提出覆盖头部、面部、颈部、眼球、牙齿和舌头的生成式人体测量模型，并结合高分辨率三维扫描与解剖特定艺术样本构建眼部和口腔子模型。报告称该模型在目标三维人脸扫描拟合上达到领先表现，并公开完整框架。
2607.23687.title: GNM Head: A Generative aNthropometric Model of the human head

2607.23806.summary_en: This paper argues for augmenting frozen language models with a persistent memory of independently verified solutions, enabling deterministic zero-token reuse for previously solved problem families. The system stores only verified solutions and retrieves them for new instances, separating execution-bound capability from parameter scaling and contrasting exact addressing with approximate similarity retrieval. The reported results claim perfect reuse on selected fresh instances, consistency-gated open-ended reasoning acceptances, low-latency retrieval, and a large movable working-context store, while acknowledging that frontier models remain stronger at raw from-scratch reasoning.
2607.23806.summary_zh: 本文主张在冻结语言模型旁加入持久化的已验证解记忆，使已解决问题族的新实例能够以零生成token、确定性方式复用答案。该系统仅存储通过独立验证的解，并在新实例上检索复用，从而将执行受限能力与参数扩展解耦，同时比较精确寻址和近似相似检索。报告结果声称在所选新实例上实现完美复用、通过一致性门控的开放式推理接受、低延迟检索和大规模可移动工作上下文存储，同时承认前沿模型在从零推理能力上仍更强。
2607.23806.title: A Frozen 12B Beats Frontier Models on Verified Work: 100% Accuracy, 0 Tokens, Bit-Exact, Forever

2607.23822.summary_en: DriveDNA addresses the challenge of identifying stable driver-specific driving style from naturalistic data confounded by vehicles, routes, and conditions. It introduces a large-scale multimodal dataset and benchmark with human-controlled driving, forward video, behavioral annotations, and rule-generated maneuver events, evaluated through driver re-identification, personalized prediction, and condition-matched comparison. Baseline evaluations show learned representations outperform classical descriptors but also reveal route leakage in video-only models, highlighting the need to test robustness against contextual shortcuts.
2607.23822.summary_zh: DriveDNA 研究如何在受车辆、路线和环境条件混杂影响的自然驾驶数据中识别稳定的驾驶员特定风格。该工作提出大规模多模态数据集和基准，包含人工驾驶数据、前向视频、行为标注和规则生成的机动事件，并通过驾驶员重识别、个性化行为预测和条件匹配比较进行评估。基线结果显示学习表示优于传统描述符，但视频模型存在严重路线泄漏，说明可靠评估需要检验对上下文捷径的鲁棒性。
2607.23822.title: DriveDNA: A Large-Scale Multimodal Naturalistic Driving Dataset and Benchmark for Driving Style Identification

2607.23855.summary_en: This paper presents OmniVAE, a jointly trained audio-video variational autoencoder for synchronized multimodal generation. It addresses the lack of cross-modal alignment in separately trained audio and video VAEs by using segment-level audio-video contrastive learning and distillation from pretrained modality-specific semantic encoders. Experiments show that the aligned latent spaces improve downstream text-to-audio-video generation quality and cross-modal synchronization.
2607.23855.summary_zh: 本文提出OmniVAE，一种联合训练的音频-视频变分自编码器，用于同步多模态生成。针对分别训练音频和视频VAE导致潜空间缺乏跨模态对齐的问题，作者引入片段级音视频对比学习，并从预训练的单模态语义编码器蒸馏特征。实验表明，对齐后的潜空间提升了下游文本到音频视频生成的质量和跨模态同步精度。
2607.23855.title: OmniVAE: An Audio-Video VAE with Cross-Modal Alignment for Joint Generation

2607.23909.summary_en: This paper introduces WorldDiT, a unified diffusion transformer architecture for robotic action generation and visual world modeling. During training, the model jointly generates continuous action chunks and predicts normalized RGB patch targets from future camera frames, avoiding reliance on a large pretrained VLM action backbone. Results across LIBERO simulation suites place WorldDiT on the reported Pareto frontier for model size and mean success, positioning it as a sub-billion-parameter baseline for scaling studies.
2607.23909.summary_zh: 本文提出WorldDiT，一个用于机器人动作生成和视觉世界建模的统一扩散Transformer架构。训练时，模型同时生成连续动作片段，并从未来相机帧预测归一化RGB图像块目标，从而不依赖大型预训练VLM作为动作主干。LIBERO仿真套件结果显示，WorldDiT在模型规模与平均成功率方面位于已报告的帕累托前沿，可作为十亿参数以下机器人策略扩展研究基线。
2607.23909.title: WorldDiT: A Unified Diffusion Architecture for World and Action Modeling

2607.24027.summary_en: This paper introduces Sol-Attn, a training-free sparse attention method for accelerating diffusion-transformer image and video generation. The method performs on-the-fly block thresholding within an online-softmax pass, avoiding costly proxy-map materialization while reusing proxy scores from unselected blocks to approximate their contribution. Experiments report improved quality-efficiency trade-offs and end-to-end speedups for video generation and editing while preserving visual quality.
2607.24027.summary_zh: 本文提出Sol-Attn，一种用于加速扩散Transformer图像和视频生成的免训练稀疏注意力方法。该方法在在线softmax过程中进行即时块阈值筛选，避免昂贵的代理分数图物化，并复用未选中块的代理分数来近似其贡献。实验显示，该方法改善了质量与效率权衡，并在保持视觉质量的同时提升视频生成和编辑速度。
2607.24027.title: Sol-Attn: Accelerating Video Generation Inference via On-the-Fly Attention Sparsification

2607.24063.summary_en: This paper argues that factuality evaluation should account for the compute cost required to obtain factual answers, especially when strong models cluster near leaderboard ceilings. It introduces MAS-HQ, a resource-aware protocol that wraps factuality detectors, normalizes for cost, and compares systems competitively using a Q-Score. Across summarization and open-domain QA, the paper claims that competitive evaluation reveals more resource-efficient policies than static factuality leaderboards.
2607.24063.summary_zh: 本文主张事实性评估应纳入获得事实答案所需的计算成本，尤其是在强模型得分接近排行榜上限时。论文提出MAS-HQ，一种资源感知评估协议，可封装任意事实性检测器、按成本归一化，并通过Q-Score进行竞争式系统比较。在摘要和开放域问答任务中，论文认为该协议比静态事实性排行榜更能揭示资源效率高的策略。
2607.24063.title: The Cost of Knowing: A Resource-Aware Protocol for Benchmarking Hallucination Beyond Static Leaderboards

2607.24241.summary_en: FilmBench addresses limitations in video generation benchmarks that rely on generic prompts and coarse metrics rather than professional cinematic criteria. It introduces a T2V and R2V benchmark built from award-winning film clips, multi-shot prompts, a three-level cinematic taxonomy, and an expert-grade automatic evaluation agent with FilmOps operators. Evaluation of leading models shows high agreement with human rankings and reveals lower film-grade scores than web-style benchmarks, especially for dynamic aesthetics and multi-shot generation.
2607.24241.summary_zh: FilmBench 针对现有视频生成基准依赖通用提示和粗粒度指标、难以评估专业电影语言的问题。该工作提出面向文本到视频和参考到视频的基准，基于获奖电影片段构建多镜头提示，并使用三层电影化评估体系和专家级自动评估代理及 FilmOps 算子。对多个主流模型的评测显示其与人工排序高度一致，同时揭示模型在动态美学和多镜头生成上仍存在明显短板。
2607.24241.title: FilmBench: A Film-Grade Benchmark for Cinematic Video Generation

2607.24280.summary_en: The paper addresses distillation for agentic search when proprietary teacher logits are unavailable and raw trajectory imitation transfers superficial style. It proposes Multi-Agent Protocol Distillation, where an offline multi-agent system decomposes queries, retrieves and repairs evidence, and converts exploration traces into a structured JSON protocol used as privileged training guidance alongside reinforcement learning. Evaluations across QA benchmarks claim improved success rates over competing distillation and RL methods, with better robustness to teacher variation and reduced style drift.
2607.24280.summary_zh: 本文研究智能体搜索中的知识蒸馏问题，指出专有教师模型 logits 不可用且原始自然语言轨迹模仿容易迁移表层风格。作者提出 Multi-Agent Protocol Distillation，由离线多智能体系统分解查询、检索与修复证据，并将探索轨迹转换为结构化 JSON 协议，作为学生策略特权分支的训练指导并结合强化学习。多个问答基准上的评估声称，该方法优于竞争性蒸馏和强化学习方法，并能缓解教师差异、风格漂移和冗长退化。
2607.24280.title: From Proprietary to Open-Source: Bridging the Distribution Gap via Multi-Agent Protocol Distillation in Agentic Search

2607.24416.summary_en: The paper proposes a decentralized consensus-based multi-agent learning framework in which expertise emerges through peer validation rather than centralized reward or ground truth. Agents update beliefs through weighted social consensus, infer competence from peer consistency, and dynamically rotate subject-matter expert status by competence rank. Large-scale simulations across graph structures, agent counts, belief dimensions, and sensitivity settings show robust SME rotation at lower complexity and increasing expert concentration under high-dimensional belief spaces.
2607.24416.summary_zh: 本文提出一种去中心化的共识式多智能体学习框架，使专业性通过同伴验证而非中心化奖励或真实标签产生。智能体通过加权社会共识更新信念，根据同伴一致性推断能力，并按能力排名动态分配主题专家身份。大规模仿真表明，在较低复杂度下专家轮换具有鲁棒性，而在高维信念空间中专业性会逐渐集中到少数甚至单个智能体。
2607.24416.title: Decentralised Consensus Learning Networks: SME Rotation Without Centralised Reward

2607.24482.summary_en: This paper studies runtime coordination for multi-UAV remote sensing missions where centralized coordination can fail under link loss, platform failure, or degraded data quality. It introduces SwarmLink, a peer-to-peer inter-agent communication infrastructure that can extend existing aerial frameworks without modifying their core systems. In a photovoltaic inspection case study, it uses distributed auctions to unify target allocation, failure recovery, and data-quality-triggered reassignment without ground-station involvement.
2607.24482.summary_zh: 本文研究多无人机遥感任务中的运行时协调问题，尤其是集中式协调在链路丢失、平台故障或数据质量下降时的脆弱性。论文提出SwarmLink，一种点对点智能体间通信基础设施，可在不修改核心系统的情况下扩展现有空中机器人框架。在光伏巡检案例中，该方法通过分布式拍卖统一实现目标分配、故障恢复和因数据质量触发的重新分配，无需地面站参与。
2607.24482.title: Distributed Coordination for Resilient Multi-UAV Remote Sensing: A Photovoltaic Inspection Case Study

2607.24516.summary_en: This paper presents DecoupleMix, a systematic framework for optimizing vision-language model pretraining data mixtures. It separates inter-class capability ratios from intra-class dataset allocation, using iterative search for the former and constrained convex optimization with quality, difficulty, and diversity criteria for the latter. Experiments report consistent gains over heuristic mixtures, transfer of small-scale optimal ratios to larger scales, and competitive VLM performance with fewer multimodal tokens than some strong open-source models.
2607.24516.summary_zh: 本文提出DecoupleMix，一个用于优化视觉语言模型预训练数据混合配方的系统框架。该方法将跨能力类别比例与类别内数据集分配解耦，前者使用单变量迭代搜索，后者基于质量、难度和多样性标准进行约束凸优化。实验显示该框架优于启发式混合，小规模发现的最优比例可迁移到更大规模，并以较少多模态token获得有竞争力的VLM性能。
2607.24516.title: DecoupleMix: Decoupled Ratio Search and Convex Allocation for Scalable VLM Data Recipes

2607.24651.summary_en: This paper studies evidence attribution in visual document understanding, focusing on failures caused by coordinate-based evidence interfaces. It compares coordinate output with a language-based quote-and-retrieve interface and then uses the latter as a training scaffold with a GRPO recipe that avoids region-level labels. Results show substantially improved evidence recall, reduced hallucination, and higher strict attributed accuracy while largely preserving answer quality.
2607.24651.summary_zh: 该论文研究视觉文档理解中的证据归因问题，重点分析基于坐标的证据接口导致的归因幻觉。作者比较坐标输出与基于文本引用和多模态检索的接口，并进一步将后者作为训练脚手架，使用无需区域级标签的 GRPO 方法优化证据引用。结果显示，该方法显著提升证据召回、降低幻觉率，并提高严格归因准确率，同时基本保持回答质量。
2607.24651.title: Evidence Attribution in Visual Document Understanding without Coordinates or Region Labels

2607.24653.summary_en: This paper introduces Kimi K3, a large open Mixture-of-Experts model with native vision support and a million-token context window. The model combines architectural changes, sparse expert activation, refined training recipes, reinforcement learning over general, agentic, and coding domains, and infrastructure improvements for long-context training and deployment. Evaluations claim frontier-level performance across coding, agentic, knowledge, reasoning, and vision tasks, with released weights intended to support further research.
2607.24653.summary_zh: 本文介绍Kimi K3，这是一个开放的大规模混合专家模型，具备原生视觉能力和百万token上下文窗口。模型结合了架构改进、稀疏专家激活、训练配方优化、覆盖通用、代理式和编码领域的强化学习，以及长上下文训练与部署基础设施。评估声称其在编码、代理式、知识、推理和视觉任务上达到前沿水平，并通过发布权重促进后续研究。
2607.24653.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence

2607.24720.summary_en: This paper studies how foundation model agents acquire, shape, and integrate multi-turn long-horizon planning abilities in a controlled environment. It examines pre-training factors, post-training with GRPO and on-policy distillation, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, distinguishing general planning patterns from task-specific planning knowledge. The paper claims that explicit world-model construction improves long-horizon generalization, OPD is more effective than GRPO in certain low-quality or long-horizon settings, and multi-teacher distillation can integrate compatible planning patterns while conflicting patterns cause interference.
2607.24720.summary_zh: 本文在受控环境中研究基础模型代理如何获得、塑造和整合多轮长程规划能力。作者考察预训练中的数据因素、GRPO和在线策略蒸馏后训练，以及多教师在线策略蒸馏，并区分通用规划模式和任务特定规划知识。论文认为显式世界模型构建有助于长程泛化，OPD在低质量或长程设置中比GRPO适用范围更广，而多教师蒸馏可整合兼容规划模式但在冲突模式下会产生干扰。
2607.24720.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation

2607.24731.summary_en: This paper analyzes classifier-free guidance in on-policy distillation for diffusion models and identifies an under-identification issue when matching guided teacher and student velocities. It shows that branch-level errors can compensate in the composed guidance objective, producing a failure mode called Negative Branch Asymmetry when the teacher’s negative branch contains privileged information unavailable to the student. The proposed Positive-Direction Matching objective separately constrains positive prediction and conditional direction, improving robustness in dense-to-sparse video control distillation.
2607.24731.summary_zh: 本文分析扩散模型在带分类器自由引导的在线策略蒸馏中的问题，指出直接匹配教师与学生的引导速度会产生分支层面的欠识别。作者发现，当教师负分支含有学生不可获得的特权信息时，组合目标会导致负分支不对称这一失败模式。论文提出Positive-Direction Matching，分别约束正向预测和条件方向，从而提升稠密到稀疏视频控制蒸馏的鲁棒性。
2607.24731.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation

2607.24743.summary_en: This paper presents ClinFusion, a vision-centric multimodal LLM system for medical image understanding and clinical report generation. It uses a cascaded compositional vision encoder and vision-grounded evaluation framework, reporting state-of-the-art results across 2D and 3D medical benchmarks and noting that the system can be augmented with agentic tool use for clinical workflows.
