2607.24743.summary_zh: 本文提出ClinFusion，一个面向医学图像理解和临床报告生成的视觉中心多模态LLM系统。该系统采用级联组合式视觉编码器和视觉扎根评估框架，在2D与3D医学多模态基准上报告了领先结果，并指出其可通过智能体式工具使用增强检索和工具辅助临床流程。
2607.24743.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding

2607.24744.summary_en: This paper surveys and organizes data sources for embodied manipulation into a pyramid spanning real-robot, UMI-style, egocentric and exocentric, simulation, and general vision-language data. It analyzes these sources through scalability, robot alignment, quality, diversity, reusability, and physical fidelity, then relates data recipes to capabilities in embodied foundation models. The paper identifies open challenges including tactile data, failure recovery data, scalable collection, embodiment alignment, egocentric dexterity data, and principled robot-learning data mixtures.
2607.24744.summary_zh: 本文将具身操作的数据来源组织为一个数据金字塔，涵盖真实机器人数据、UMI式数据、自我中心和外部视角数据、仿真数据以及通用视觉语言数据。作者从可扩展性、机器人对齐、质量、多样性、可复用性和物理保真度等角度分析这些数据源，并将数据配方与具身基础模型能力联系起来。论文提出触觉数据、失败恢复数据、可扩展采集、跨形体动作对齐和原则化数据配方等开放挑战。
2607.24744.title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation

2607.24893.summary_en: This paper characterizes distributed backdoor attacks in multi-agent LLM systems where malicious payload fragments are spread across agents and assembled only after the run. It builds an attack instance on a hierarchical multi-agent system and studies prefix detection across models and task domains as fragments appear over time. The results show that early detection is possible after injection begins but depends partly on removable surface cues, with transfer becoming weaker when such cues are removed.
2607.24893.summary_zh: 本文刻画多智能体LLM系统中的分布式后门攻击，其中恶意载荷片段分散在多个智能体中，并在运行结束后才被组装。论文在层级多智能体系统上构建攻击实例，并跨模型和任务域研究片段逐步出现时的前缀检测。结果表明，注入开始后可以实现早期检测，但有效检测部分依赖可移除的表面线索，去除这些线索后跨域迁移能力下降。
2607.24893.title: Early Detection of Distributed Backdoors in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: A Characterization Study

2607.25156.summary_en: This paper introduces Vilya-2, a diffusion transformer for all-atom structural modeling of molecular interfaces involving peptides, small molecules, macrocycles, and protein targets. It extends prior all-atom representations from individual molecules to interactions, generates and ranks structural ensembles with calibrated confidence, and claims strong accuracy and generalization across peptide interface prediction, docking, conformation modeling, and hit-to-lead fine-tuning.
2607.25156.summary_zh: 本文介绍 Vilya-2，一种用于肽、小分子、大环分子与蛋白靶标分子界面全原子结构建模的扩散 Transformer。该方法将既有全原子表示从单个分子扩展到分子相互作用，生成并用校准置信度排序结构集合，并声称在肽界面预测、对接、构象建模和 hit-to-lead 微调中具有较强准确性与泛化能力。
2607.25156.title: Accurate structural modeling of chemically diverse molecular interfaces with Vilya-2

2607.25163.summary_en: This paper generalizes active subspaces from Euclidean domains to Riemannian manifolds using parallel transport. It compares intrinsic and extrinsic gradient-average formulations on local geodesic balls, characterizes second-order agreement of eigenvalues and dominant eigenspaces, and illustrates the framework on hyperspheres and 2-sphere numerical examples.
2607.25163.summary_zh: 本文利用平行移动将主动子空间方法从欧氏域推广到黎曼流形。作者比较局部测地球上的内蕴与外蕴梯度平均形式，刻画特征值和主导特征子空间的二阶一致性，并在超球面和二维球面数值例子中展示该形式化框架。
2607.25163.title: A Riemannian View on Active Subspaces

2607.25169.summary_en: This paper studies positional and structural encodings for graph neural networks that exceed 1-WL message-passing limitations. CondPSE uses a polynomial graph filter bank and conditional FiLM-style modulation to pretrain structural encodings, achieving large gains on synthetic structural-discrimination benchmarks but only comparable performance to GPSE on molecular property prediction.
2607.25169.summary_zh: 本文研究用于图神经网络的位置与结构编码，以弥补1-WL有界消息传递难以区分某些拓扑结构的限制。CondPSE使用多项式图滤波器组和条件FiLM式调制来预训练结构编码，在合成结构判别基准上取得显著提升，但在分子性质预测中仅与GPSE表现相当。
2607.25169.title: CondPSE: A Polynomial-Filtered Structural Encoder with Conditional Modulation for Graphs

2607.25175.summary_en: The paper presents an agentic AI environment for large-scale sleep physiology discovery from polysomnography data, where expert effort and general-purpose AI limitations hinder analysis. AI Sleep Co-Scientist lets human scientists direct specialist agents for hypothesis development, preprocessing, and statistical analysis, with results linked to executable code. Across large cohorts, the case studies report associations between sleep physiology and disease risk, clinical phenotypes, and sleep regulation, illustrating agentic AI support for multimodal scientific discovery.
2607.25175.summary_zh: 本文提出用于大规模睡眠生理发现的智能体AI环境，以应对多导睡眠图数据分析中专家成本高和通用AI能力不足的问题。AI Sleep Co-Scientist允许人类科学家指导专门智能体进行假设生成、信号预处理和统计分析，并将结果关联到可执行代码。多个队列上的案例研究报告了睡眠生理与疾病风险、临床表型和睡眠调节之间的关联，展示了智能体AI对多模态科学发现的支持。
2607.25175.title: Agentic AI-enabled discovery across large-scale sleep physiology

2607.25182.summary_en: This paper presents TabRank, a framework for training reasoning-based rerankers for tabular retrieval. It constructs a dataset of reasoning traces for reranking tables and studies compact student training through explicit chain-of-thought distillation and conditioning on teacher reasoning traces. Experiments across out-of-distribution domains and multi-table settings show improved table retrieval accuracy and effective generalization to multi-table reasoning.
2607.25182.summary_zh: 本文提出TabRank，一个用于表格检索的推理式重排序器训练框架。作者构建了表格重排序推理轨迹数据集，并研究通过显式思维链蒸馏以及在提示中引入教师推理轨迹来训练紧凑学生模型。跨领域和多表场景实验显示，该方法提升了表格检索准确率，并能较好泛化到多表推理任务。
2607.25182.title: TabRank: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for Table Re-Rankers

2607.25184.summary_en: This paper proposes a scaling law for contextual persistence in human language by measuring how much ordered prior context reduces target perplexity beyond scrambled-word controls. Using large language models as probabilistic probes across ten corpora from six language families and multiple modalities, it finds that contextual persistence decays approximately as an inverse function of distance. The effect disappears in scrambled, synthetic, genomic, and protein-sequence controls, supporting the claim that sequential word arrangement in human language follows a robust scaling pattern.
2607.25184.summary_zh: 本文提出人类语言中上下文持续性的尺度律，通过衡量有序前文相对于词语打乱控制对目标困惑度的额外降低来刻画序列结构影响。作者使用大型语言模型作为概率探针，在涵盖六个语系和多种模态的十个语料库上发现，上下文持续性随距离近似按反比例衰减。该效应在打乱、合成、基因组和蛋白质序列控制中消失，支持人类语言词序结构具有稳健尺度规律的主张。
2607.25184.title: A scaling law of contextual persistence in human language

2607.25186.summary_en: This paper introduces MyoCardBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models in longitudinal, multimodal, and safety-critical cardiovascular care scenarios. The benchmark contains 2,263 items from 13 task-specific datasets derived from de-identified cardiovascular records and examination data, with physician annotation and senior cardiologist review. Evaluation of seven LLMs shows varied performance across clinical dimensions and tasks, with the benchmark intended to reveal model strengths, omissions, and future development priorities in cardiology workflows.
2607.25186.summary_zh: 本文提出MyoCardBench，用于在纵向、多模态且安全关键的心血管护理场景中评估大型语言模型。该基准包含来自去标识化心血管记录和考试数据的13个任务数据集共2,263个项目，并由心脏科医生标注和高级心脏科医生复审。对七个LLM的评估显示模型在不同临床维度和任务上表现差异明显，该基准旨在识别模型优势、临床遗漏和未来改进方向。
2607.25186.title: MyoCardBench: A Real-World Data Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Clinically Authentic Cardiovascular Care Scenarios

2607.25190.summary_en: This paper establishes a connection between Lloyd's K-means algorithm and the Frank-Wolfe optimization method. It shows Lloyd's algorithm is a special case of Frank-Wolfe, derives a non-asymptotic convergence rate to a local SSE minimum, extends the treatment to empty clusters via a semismooth variant, and illustrates the results on simulations and image segmentation.
2607.25190.summary_zh: 本文建立 Lloyd K-means 算法与 Frank-Wolfe 优化方法之间的联系。作者证明 Lloyd 算法是 Frank-Wolfe 的一个特例，推导其到局部 SSE 最小值的非渐近收敛率，并通过半光滑变体处理空簇情形，最后在仿真和图像分割数据上展示结果。
2607.25190.title: Lloyd's $K$-Means Clustering Algorithm Is Frank-Wolfe in Disguise

2607.25195.summary_en: This paper addresses scalable autonomous exploration for resource-constrained nano-UAVs with minimal sensing. It proposes a lightweight sensor-driven Lévy walk controller in which robots independently sample exploration parameters and choose headings from local range measurements, without inter-robot communication for exploration control. Simulations show improved coverage and reduced collisions compared with a uniform-heading Lévy walk baseline.
2607.25195.summary_zh: 本文研究低感知、低算力纳米无人机的可扩展自主探索问题。作者提出轻量级传感器驱动Lévy walk控制器，使每个机器人独立采样探索参数，并基于局部距离测量选择航向，探索控制不依赖机器人间通信。仿真结果显示，该方法相比均匀航向Lévy walk基线提升覆盖率并减少碰撞。
2607.25195.title: Decentralized Scalable Exploration via Emergent Adaptive Lévy Walks on Minimal-Sensing Platforms

2607.25196.summary_en: This reproducibility and extension study reexamines contrastive decoding as a training-free method for reducing object hallucinations in multimodal large language models. It validates prior claims that apparent benchmark gains often arise from output distribution shifts or greedy-search effects, and extends the analysis across generative and discriminative datasets, logit distributions, proxy methods, and layerwise hallucination signals.
2607.25196.summary_zh: 本文作为复现与扩展研究，重新评估对比解码作为减少多模态大语言模型对象幻觉的免训练方法。作者验证了先前关于表面基准收益常源于输出分布偏移或贪婪搜索效应的结论，并进一步在生成式与判别式数据集、logit 分布、代理方法和逐层幻觉信号上传播分析中扩展研究。
2607.25196.title: Rethinking CD: A Reproducibility Study and Extension on the Ineffectiveness of Contrastive Decoding at Mitigating Object Hallucinations in MLLMs

2607.25200.summary_en: This paper develops a theoretical algorithmic separation between constant-depth and logarithmic-depth neural networks. It identifies Boolean functions with hierarchical Fourier spectra that logarithmic-depth networks can efficiently learn via layerwise coordinate descent, while showing that broad classes of constant-depth polynomial-width networks incur constant approximation error.
2607.25200.summary_zh: 本文提出常数深度与对数深度神经网络之间的理论性算法分离。作者识别出具有层级傅里叶谱的布尔函数，证明对数深度网络可通过逐层坐标下降高效学习，而满足一定条件的常数深度多项式宽度网络会产生常数级近似误差。
2607.25200.title: Algorithmic Separation between Constant-Depth and Logarithmic-Depth Neural Networks

2607.25202.summary_en: This paper studies conversational entrainment in spoken code-switched dialogue across Mandarin-English, Hindi-English, and Spanish-English settings. It analyzes lexical, acoustic-prosodic, and code-switching style entrainment and compares these human patterns with classical and Transformer-based classifier behavior using feature importance and ablation analyses. The results suggest that models can detect entrainment reasonably well but rely on feature priorities that differ from those most salient in human entrainment, highlighting challenges for naturalistic code-switched conversational agents.
2607.25202.summary_zh: 本文研究普通话-英语、印地语-英语和西班牙语-英语口语代码转换对话中的会话趋同现象。作者分析词汇、声学-韵律和代码转换风格层面的趋同，并通过特征重要性和消融分析比较人类行为与经典及Transformer分类模型的决策模式。结果表明，模型能较好检测趋同，但其依赖的特征与人类趋同行为中最显著的特征并不一致，说明自然代码转换会话代理仍面临挑战。
2607.25202.title: A Cross-lingual Comparison of Human and Classification Model Entrainment Behavior in Code-switched Speech Settings

2607.25207.summary_en: This paper studies hybrid reinforcement learning in tabular MDPs, combining online target-environment interactions with offline source-environment data under shifted transition dynamics. It proposes MIN-UCB-VI for regret minimization and MAX-LCB-VI for best policy identification, using fine-grained bias information to exploit offline data and providing upper and matching lower theoretical bounds plus experiments.
2607.25207.summary_zh: 本文研究表格 MDP 中的混合强化学习，在目标环境在线交互与来源环境离线数据之间进行结合，并考虑转移动态发生偏移。作者提出用于遗憾最小化的 MIN-UCB-VI 和用于最佳策略识别的 MAX-LCB-VI，利用细粒度偏差信息更有效使用离线数据，并给出理论上下界及实验验证。
2607.25207.title: A Unified Algorithmic Framework for Hybrid Reinforcement Learning in Tabular MDPs with Shifted Transition Dynamics

2607.25225.summary_en: This paper evaluates whether domain-specific prompting changes the security of AI-generated code in critical-infrastructure contexts. SecDrift compares vulnerability rates across sectors, CWE categories, and models using matched baselines, finding that sector framing is not a reliable moderator while model choice has a larger and more consistent effect on vulnerability rates.
2607.25225.summary_zh: 本文评估面向关键基础设施领域的特定行业提示是否会改变 AI 生成代码的安全性。SecDrift 通过匹配基线比较不同行业、CWE 类别和模型的漏洞率，发现行业语境并非可靠调节因素，而模型选择对漏洞率具有更大且更稳定的影响。
2607.25225.title: SecDrift: Measuring Sector-Conditioned Security Drift in AI-Generated Code

2607.25227.summary_en: This paper defines decision-level hijacking, where LLM cognitive stance is manipulated to influence downstream decision-making. It proposes CogBias, a bit-flip attack framework that converts subjective preferences into differentiable optimization signals and locates critical bits under a sparse flip budget, reporting targeted stance shifts with limited non-target degradation across several LLMs and scenarios.
2607.25227.summary_zh: 本文定义了决策级劫持，即通过操纵 LLM 的认知立场来影响下游决策。作者提出 CogBias 位翻转攻击框架，将主观偏好转化为可微优化信号，并在极稀疏翻转预算下定位关键比特；实验报告其可在多个 LLM 和场景中诱导目标主题的立场转移，同时对非目标任务影响有限。
2607.25227.title: Decision-Level Hijacking: Injecting Cognitive Bias into Large Language Models via Bit-Flip Attacks

2607.25228.summary_en: This paper proposes SymCA, an interpretable framework for table column annotation, including column type and property annotation. It uses LLMs to induce tree-structured semantic skeletons over label spaces, selects robust skeletons with minimum Bayes risk consensus, and evolves node-specific interpretable predictive substrates based on random forests and LLM-proposed operator modifications. Experiments claim improved accuracy, robustness, and interpretability over strong baselines.
2607.25228.summary_zh: 该论文提出SymCA，一个用于表格列标注的可解释框架，涵盖列类型标注和列属性标注。方法利用LLM生成标签空间上的树状语义骨架，通过最小贝叶斯风险共识选择稳健骨架，并为内部节点演化基于随机森林和LLM建议算子的可解释预测基底。实验声称该方法在准确性、鲁棒性和可解释性方面优于强基线。
2607.25228.title: Interpretable Column Annotation with LLM-Symbolized Decision Process Materialization

2607.25232.summary_en: This paper presents a reproducible benchmark for multimodal digital phenotyping in mental health classification. Using the Neurai-VN dataset from smartphones and wearables, it defines four binary classification tasks with standardized subject-wise cross-validation and reports baseline performance for linear, tree-based, and neural models.
2607.25232.summary_zh: 本文提出用于心理健康分类的多模态数字表型可复现基准。基于来自智能手机和可穿戴设备的 Neurai-VN 数据集，作者定义四个二分类任务和标准化的按受试者交叉验证，并报告线性模型、树模型和神经模型的基线表现。
2607.25232.title: Neurai-VN Benchmark: Standardized Machine Learning Models for Multimodal Digital Phenotyping in Mental Health Classification

2607.25233.summary_en: This paper addresses auto-bidding under sliding-window efficiency constraints, where daily bidding decisions affect multiple overlapping evaluation windows. SWAG-Bid uses hierarchical planning and execution with a masked trajectory model, multi-window model predictive control sampling, and gated adaptive control, reporting competitive constraint satisfaction and value acquisition on sparse auction data and online A/B tests.
2607.25233.summary_zh: 本文研究滑动窗口效率约束下的自动出价问题，其中每日出价会影响多个重叠评价窗口。SWAG-Bid 采用分层规划与执行框架，结合 masked trajectory model、多窗口模型预测控制采样和门控自适应控制，在稀疏拍卖数据和线上 A/B 测试中报告了有竞争力的约束满足和价值获取表现。
2607.25233.title: Beyond Single-Episode Optimization: Sliding-Window Aware Generative Auto-Bidding for Long-Term Advertising Effectiveness

2607.25236.summary_en: This paper introduces VisualPatchWorld, a world-modeling approach that represents dynamics as executable code for planning. It selects qualitative dynamical forms through active probes, fits free parameters from state-action traces, and uses the resulting programs for simulation and model-predictive control with image-derived scene graphs. The reported results show improved planning success over prior code-based world models, especially when choosing the correct qualitative dynamics matters.
2607.25236.summary_zh: 该论文提出VisualPatchWorld，一种将世界动态表示为可执行代码以支持规划的世界模型方法。该方法通过主动探测选择定性动力学形式，再从状态-动作轨迹中拟合自由参数，并将所得程序用于仿真和模型预测控制，可由图像派生场景图提供实时状态。结果显示其规划成功率优于既有代码世界模型，尤其在正确选择定性动力学至关重要的场景中收益最大。
2607.25236.title: VisualPatchWorld: Code World Models as Latent Structured Representations for Planning

2607.25241.summary_en: This paper studies offline reinforcement learning when true actions are hidden and only noisy proxies are observed. It establishes policy-value identification in infinite-horizon discounted MDPs by using next states as proxies for unobserved actions, and proposes LURE, a multiply robust influence-function-based estimator with asymptotic normality, validated in simulations and a sepsis management application.
2607.25241.summary_zh: 本文研究真实动作不可见、只能观测噪声代理变量时的离线强化学习。作者利用下一状态作为未观测动作的自然代理，在无限时域折扣 MDP 中建立策略价值识别，并提出具有多重稳健性和渐近正态性的影响函数估计器 LURE，在仿真和脓毒症管理应用中进行验证。
2607.25241.title: Learning from the Unseen: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Hidden Actions

2607.25255.summary_en: This paper addresses a safety failure mode in multi-agent systems where harmful objectives can be fragmented across delegated subtasks and evade single-agent checks. It proposes SafeFlow, a semantic information-flow control framework that attaches structured taints to root requests, propagates them through collaboration graphs, and validates workflow-level risk before irreversible actions. Evaluations across several attack settings show reduced attack success relative to undefended and external-defense baselines while preserving benign task completion.
2607.25255.summary_zh: 本文研究多智能体系统中的一种安全失效模式，即有害目标可被拆分为局部看似合理的子任务，从而绕过单个智能体检查。论文提出SafeFlow语义信息流控制框架，为根请求附加结构化语义标记，在动态协作图中传播，并在不可逆操作前进行工作流级风险验证。实验表明，该方法相较无防护和外部防护基线降低攻击成功率，同时保持较高的良性任务完成能力。
2607.25255.title: SafeFlow: Semantic Information-Flow Control for Blocking Malicious Propagation in Multi-Agent Systems

2607.25257.summary_en: This paper addresses uncertainty quantification in neural item response theory models for LLM benchmark evaluation. Laplace-PSN-IRT adds a post-hoc last-layer Laplace approximation to PSN-IRT, enabling posterior uncertainty over model ability and item difficulty, credible intervals, probabilistic model comparisons, and more stable item selection than point-estimate methods in most settings.
2607.25257.summary_zh: 本文研究用于 LLM 基准评估的神经项目反应理论模型中的不确定性量化。Laplace-PSN-IRT 在已训练的 PSN-IRT 上加入后验最后一层 Laplace 近似，从而获得模型能力和题目难度的不确定性、可信区间、概率化模型比较，并在多数实验设置中实现更稳定的题目选择。
2607.25257.title: Laplace-PSN-IRT: Uncertainty Quantification for Neural Item Response Theory Models of LLM Benchmarks

2607.25266.summary_en: This paper targets inference-time frame selection for long-form video understanding, where irrelevant frames can reduce multimodal model accuracy. FORGE constructs a query-conditioned geometry over pretrained multimodal embeddings to select diverse, query-relevant frames without training, reporting improved keyframe selection and question-answering performance across video benchmarks and multiple open-source MLLMs.
2607.25266.summary_zh: 本文研究长视频理解中的推理时帧选择问题，因为无关帧会降低多模态模型准确率。FORGE 在预训练多模态嵌入空间中构造查询条件化几何，将相关性与多样性统一到同一目标中，无需训练即可选择信息量高的帧，并在视频基准和多个开源 MLLM 上报告了关键帧选择与问答性能提升。
2607.25266.title: FORGE: Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry for Long-Form Video Understanding

2607.25270.summary_en: This paper examines how the source activations used to build steering vectors affect activation steering in language models. Across instruction-tuned models and steering task families, it finds that source selection alone substantially changes steering success, and argues that effective signals arise from execution-boundary states; the proposed tail subtraction method removes shared prompt and continuation semantics to produce cleaner steering signals.
2607.25270.summary_zh: 本文研究用于构造 steering 向量的源激活如何影响语言模型的激活 steering。实验表明，在固定下游干预的情况下，仅改变源激活选择就会显著影响 steering 成功率；作者认为有效信号来自模型即将执行目标行为的边界状态，并提出 tail subtraction 以去除共享语义、获得更稳定的 steering 信号。
2607.25270.title: Where Steering Signals Come From: Activation Source Selection in Activation Steering

2607.25271.summary_en: This paper revisits pretraining scaling laws when high-quality fresh data is limited relative to compute. It introduces Compute-Data scaling laws with a token-effectiveness function for derived tokens from repetition or paraphrasing, showing that effectiveness varies with model size, data ratio, and expansion amount, yielding compute-bound, data-bound, and model-bound regimes where classical compute-optimal allocation is often suboptimal.
2607.25271.summary_zh: 本文重新考察在高质量新数据受限而计算增长更快时的预训练缩放规律。作者提出 Compute-Data 缩放律，并用 token-effectiveness 函数量化重复或改写得到的派生 token 的价值，发现其随模型规模、数据比例和扩展量变化，并划分出计算受限、数据受限和模型受限等训练区间。
2607.25271.title: Bridging Compute- and Data-Optimal Pretraining

2607.25273.summary_en: This paper studies conformal prediction for graph neural networks, focusing on the failure of uniform graph diffusion when graphs are heterophilic. It proposes HeAD-CP, a family of node-wise diffusion methods using label-free local homophily estimates from GNN softmax outputs, preserving marginal coverage while reducing prediction-set sizes relative to diffusion baselines across several graph regimes.
2607.25273.summary_zh: 本文研究图神经网络中的保形预测，重点指出统一图扩散在异配图上可能失效。作者提出 HeAD-CP，通过从 GNN softmax 输出估计无标签局部同配性来设置节点级扩散系数，在保持边际覆盖保证的同时，在多种图结构条件下降低相较扩散基线的预测集大小。
2607.25273.title: HeAD-CP: Heterophily-Aware Diffused Conformal Prediction Sets for Graph Neural Networks

2607.25276.summary_en: This paper addresses single-class discovery under limited annotation, where relevant samples must be retrieved from large corpora and visually similar negatives must be separated. FunnelAL uses a retrieve-then-rank active learning pipeline with embedding retrieval, RankNet ranking, committee-based exploration, and annotator feedback, reporting stronger F1, annotation efficiency, and robustness to labeling errors than compared methods on image benchmarks.
2607.25276.summary_zh: 本文研究有限标注条件下的单类发现问题，需要从大规模语料中高效检索相关样本并区分视觉相似负例。FunnelAL 采用“检索再排序”的主动学习流程，结合嵌入检索、RankNet 排序、基于委员会的探索和标注反馈；在图像基准上报告了更好的 F1、标注效率和对标注错误的鲁棒性。
2607.25276.title: FunnelAL: Retrieve-then-Rank Active Learning for Single-Class Discovery

2607.25282.summary_en: This paper studies reconstruction of parton distribution functions from synthetic matrix-element data. It proposes a normalizing-flow framework that combines Gaussian Process priors with invertible neural networks to learn posterior distributions over PDFs from limited Ioffe-time data, claiming preservation of physical constraints and extrapolation behavior.
2607.25282.summary_zh: 本文研究如何从合成矩阵元数据中重构部分子分布函数。作者提出结合高斯过程先验与可逆神经网络的归一化流框架，用有限的 Ioffe-time 数据学习 PDF 的后验分布，并声称该方法保持物理约束和外推性质。
2607.25282.title: Normalizing Flows to Reconstruct Pseudo-PDFs

2607.25288.summary_en: This paper asks when deep representation learning improves single-cell RNA-seq clustering relative to classical PCA-based pipelines. It benchmarks nine clustering pipelines across ten real datasets with hyperparameter search, robustness testing, statistical comparisons, and Sobol sensitivity analysis, plus a partial scVI V2 comparison. The findings support a dataset-aware decision framework: deep methods help in some small or structured regimes, while PCA remains competitive when linear variation is dominant.
2607.25288.summary_zh: 本文研究在单细胞 RNA 测序聚类中，深度表示学习何时相较经典 PCA 流水线真正有益。作者在十个真实数据集上评测九种聚类流程，结合超参数搜索、重复运行鲁棒性、统计检验和 Sobol 敏感性分析，并补充部分 scVI V2 比较。结果支持一种数据集感知的决策框架：深度方法在部分小规模或结构复杂情形下有帮助，而当线性投影已捕捉主要变化时 PCA 仍具竞争力。
2607.25288.title: When Does Deep Representation Learning Help Single-Cell Clustering? A Sensitivity-Aware Diagnostic Benchmark for Biomedical AI Pipelines

2607.25289.summary_en: This paper targets lightweight on-device speech emotion recognition by distilling large self-supervised models into smaller students. It proposes AMRD, which adaptively weights multiple teachers using one-class SVMs over teacher logit similarity matrices and adds a relational loss aligning teacher and student inter-sample similarities. Experiments on IEMOCAP and CREMA-D show that the method improves over single-teacher distillation baselines in most settings, with complementary gains from both components.
2607.25289.summary_zh: 本文面向端侧轻量级语音情感识别，将大型自监督模型蒸馏到较小学生模型中。作者提出 AMRD，通过在教师 logit 相似矩阵上使用一类 SVM 自适应分配多教师权重，并加入关系蒸馏损失以对齐教师和学生的样本间相似结构。IEMOCAP 与 CREMA-D 实验显示，该方法在多数设置下优于单教师蒸馏基线，且两个组成部分具有互补收益。
2607.25289.title: AMRD: Adaptive Multi-Teacher Relational Distillation for Lightweight Speech Emotion Recognition

2607.25291.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of long-context self-attention with a training-free sparse attention method called CoSA. It co-designs a kernel-aware proxy that produces ordered block masks with an ordered-skipping kernel that further prunes blocks using online softmax statistics under tighter budgets. Experiments across LLM backbones and long-context benchmarks claim higher accuracy at lower budgets and substantial attention and time-to-first-token speedups with negligible performance degradation.
2607.25291.summary_zh: 该论文针对长上下文自注意力的高计算成本，提出无需训练的稀疏注意力方法CoSA。方法将生成有序块掩码的内核感知代理与有序跳过内核共同设计，后者在更紧预算下利用在线softmax统计进一步跳过块。跨主流LLM骨干和长上下文基准的实验声称，该方法在较低预算下保持更高准确率，并显著提升注意力速度和首词延迟表现且性能退化很小。
2607.25291.title: CoSA: Accelerating Long-Context Inference via Proxy-Kernel Co-Designed Sparse Attention

2607.25294.summary_en: This paper introduces CLBench-V, a benchmark for evaluating multimodal context learning beyond text-only settings. It organizes tasks around context grounding, new information application, and new knowledge learning, using converted public benchmarks and newly constructed datasets across science, finance, long-document, spatial, and web visual QA domains. Evaluation of six multimodal models shows low overall performance, indicating substantial remaining difficulty in learning from multimodal context.
2607.25294.summary_zh: 本文提出 CLBench-V，用于评估超越纯文本场景的多模态上下文学习能力。基准围绕上下文定位、新信息应用和新知识学习三个维度构建，包含由公共基准转换而来的任务以及覆盖科学、金融、长文档、空间推理和网页视觉问答的新数据集。对六个多模态模型的评测显示总体表现较低，说明从多模态上下文中学习仍有较大挑战。
2607.25294.title: CLBench-V: Evaluating Multimodal Context Learning from Grounding to Knowledge Acquisition

2607.25295.summary_en: This paper critiques tensorial multi-view clustering methods based on t-SVD and FFT, arguing that they rely on an implicit periodicity assumption tied to sample ordering. It shows that random permutation can degrade existing methods and analyzes the algebraic and spectral causes of this sensitivity. The proposed graph-spectral low-rank tensor framework replaces the fixed Fourier basis with a data-driven graph spectral basis, improving permutation robustness and competitive clustering performance.
2607.25295.summary_zh: 本文批判基于 t-SVD 和 FFT 的张量多视图聚类方法，指出其依赖由样本顺序引入的隐式周期性假设。论文展示随机置换样本会严重削弱现有方法，并分析其代数与谱机制。作者提出基于图谱低秩张量学习的框架，用数据驱动的图谱基替代固定 Fourier 基，从而提升置换鲁棒性并取得有竞争力的聚类性能。
2607.25295.title: Breaking the Periodicity Assumption: Robust Tensorial Multi-View Clustering via Graph-Spectral Low-Rank Learning

2607.25298.summary_en: This paper addresses real-time reconstruction of continuous hub-height wind fields from sparse, irregular local observations. It proposes Zhinv, an end-to-end framework that maps sparse observations directly to fine-grid regional wind fields without relying on numerical weather prediction or complex assimilation. Experiments across several regions show accurate and efficient reconstruction, with substantially lower error than Kriging.
2607.25298.summary_zh: 本文研究如何从稀疏、不规则的本地观测实时重建连续的轮毂高度风场。作者提出端到端框架 Zhinv，将局部观测直接映射为细网格区域风场，避免依赖数值天气预报和复杂同化过程。多个地区实验表明，该方法能够准确、鲁棒且高效地重建风场，并显著降低相较 Kriging 的误差。
2607.25298.title: Zhinv: Real-time hub-height wind field reconstruction using only local sparse observations

2607.25299.summary_en: This paper develops a retraction-free and penalty-parameter-free algorithm for optimization over the Stiefel manifold, motivated by the cost and tuning issues of existing methods. It proves global convergence guarantees using properties of quadratic penalties and proximal smoothness, then reformulates LoRA fine-tuning as a manifold optimization problem. The resulting Manifold-LoRA method is claimed to accelerate adaptation and deliver strong downstream performance on benchmarks.
2607.25299.summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于 Stiefel 流形优化的无重traction、无惩罚参数算法，以应对现有方法的正交化成本和参数调节问题。论文利用二次惩罚函数性质与流形近端光滑性证明全局收敛保证，并将 LoRA 微调重构为流形优化问题。由此得到的 Manifold-LoRA 被用于加速大语言模型适配，并在基准实验中表现出较高效率和下游性能。
2607.25299.title: Retraction-Free Optimization over the Stiefel Manifold for the LoRA Fine-Tuning

2607.25305.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a systematic method for identifying language areas used in linguistic typology. It proposes a simple geographical clustering approach to identify groupings of arbitrary size, aiming to move beyond expert-defined macroareas aligned mainly with continents or landmasses. The method produces worldwide macroareas broadly consistent with existing groupings and local groupings for a known sprachbund.
2607.25305.summary_zh: 该论文针对语言类型学中语言区域识别缺乏系统方法的问题。研究提出一种简单的地理聚类方法，用于识别任意尺度的语言分组，从而超越主要依赖专家判断且常与大陆或陆块对应的宏区域。该方法生成的全球宏区域大体符合既有分组，并能为已知语言联盟产生局部分组。
2607.25305.title: Toward a systematic method for identifying language areas

2607.25308.summary_en: This paper tackles sparse credit assignment when training LLM agents for long-horizon games. CAST uses changes in a game solver's state value as turn-level advantages within RLVR, providing cheap scalar process signals and outperforming trained baselines across several games and zero-shot evaluations.
2607.25308.summary_zh: 本文解决训练LLM智能体进行长时程游戏决策时终局奖励稀疏导致的信用分配问题。CAST利用游戏求解器状态价值的变化生成回合级优势信号，并将其注入RLVR，以低成本标量过程信号提升训练；实验显示其在多个游戏和零样本评测中优于训练基线。
2607.25308.title: CAST: Game Solvers as Turn-Level Teachers for LLM Agents

2607.25312.summary_en: This paper studies posterior sampling for Bayesian neural networks, where high-dimensional multimodal posteriors make sampling costly. It proposes using curvature estimates produced during adaptive-optimizer warmstarts, such as AdamW, as preconditioners for the sampling phase. The approach is claimed to reduce or remove burn-in, improve numerical stability, and maintain or improve predictive performance and uncertainty quantification without extra computational cost.
2607.25312.summary_zh: 本文研究贝叶斯神经网络中的后验采样问题，关注高维多峰后验导致的探索成本。作者提出利用 AdamW 等自适应优化器在 warmstart 阶段产生的曲率估计，为后续采样阶段提供预条件几何信息。该方法据称可减少或消除 burn-in，提高数值稳定性，并在无额外计算成本下保持或提升预测性能与不确定性量化。
2607.25312.title: Guiding Posterior Exploration with Optimizer-Derived Geometry

2607.25316.summary_en: This paper studies collective intent prediction in dynamic multi-agent systems where roles are latent, heterogeneous, and time-varying. It proposes MR-TGN, a temporal graph network with memory mechanisms and meta-role learning to model interaction history and infer latent role representations without explicit labels. Experiments on representative multi-agent scenarios report improved early prediction of group objectives compared with competitive baselines.
2607.25316.summary_zh: 本文研究动态多智能体系统中的集体意图预测问题，其中角色通常是潜在、异质且随时间变化的。论文提出MR-TGN，一种带记忆机制和元角色学习的时序图网络，用于建模交互历史并在无显式角色标签时推断潜在角色表示。代表性多智能体场景实验表明，该框架相较竞争基线能更有效地早期预测群体目标。
2607.25316.title: MR-TGN: A Meta-Role Temporal Graph Network for Team-Level Intent Prediction in Multi-Agent Systems

2607.25330.summary_en: This paper presents a physics-informed neural operator for electromagnetic scattering simulation in EUV lithography masks. The method factorizes a Fourier neural operator into lateral and axial branches and trains it self-consistently with PSFD equations and background decomposition, avoiding precomputed field solutions. The resulting surrogate approximates reference scattered intensities and can warm-start a damped PSFD solver to accelerate finer-grid simulations.
2607.25330.summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于 EUV 光刻掩模电磁散射仿真的物理信息神经算子。方法将 Fourier 神经算子分解为横向与轴向分支，并结合 PSFD 方程和背景分解进行自洽训练，无需预先计算电磁场解。所得代理模型可逼近参考散射强度，并作为阻尼 PSFD 求解器的 warm-start 以加速更细网格仿真。
2607.25330.title: Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Warm-Starting Background-Decomposed and Preconditioned PSFD: Enabling Scalable 3-D EUV Mask Simulation

2607.25335.summary_en: This paper investigates whether deterministic linguistic rules can compress prompts effectively without LLM-based token scoring at deployment. It uses offline evolutionary search over lexical, syntactic, semantic, and discourse cues to construct rule combinations, then evaluates them with a dual-path protocol for compression quality and reconstruction fidelity. The results claim that evolved rule-based compressors perform similarly to advanced prompt-compression methods under light-to-moderate compression, with degradation at aggressive compression levels.
2607.25335.summary_zh: 该论文研究确定性语言学规则能否在部署时不依赖LLM前向评分而有效压缩提示。方法通过离线进化搜索组合词汇、句法、语义和篇章线索，并使用双路径协议评估压缩质量与重构保真度。结果声称，进化得到的规则压缩器在轻到中等压缩下表现接近先进提示压缩方法，但在高强度压缩时性能下降。
2607.25335.title: Every Time I Hire a Linguist, Inference Costs Go Down: On Linguistic Rules as Effective Prompt Compressors

2607.25337.summary_en: This paper proposes temporal-distance JEPA for plan-aware representation learning in latent world model predictive control. It mines directed temporal costs from reward-free offline trajectories using same-trajectory order, cross-trajectory negatives, and rollout consistency, using the learned cost both for planning and representation shaping. Reported locked evaluations show TD-JEPA matching or improving over baselines across environments and narrowing the gap between representation training and plan-time deployment.
2607.25337.summary_zh: 该论文提出Temporal-Distance JEPA，用于潜在世界模型预测控制中的规划感知表示学习。方法从无奖励离线轨迹中挖掘有向时间成本，利用同轨迹顺序、跨轨迹负样本和滚动一致性，并将学习到的成本同时用于规划和表示塑造。锁定评测结果显示，TD-JEPA在多个环境中匹配或超过基线，并缩小表示训练目标与规划部署目标之间的差距。
2607.25337.title: Temporal-Distance JEPA: Plan-Aware Representation Learning for Latent World Model Predictive Control

2607.25340.summary_en: The paper formulates patient-level arrhythmia decision support as a multi-stage clinical reasoning task that goes beyond rhythm detection to assess significance, urgency, and management. It presents Cardiologent, a multi-agent system in which signal-specific agents analyze ECG and photoplethysmogram features, assemble a patient rhythm profile, retrieve relevant clinical guidelines, and use a critic to check guideline-grounded conclusions. Evaluations focus on clinical decisions and report that Cardiologent ranks highest across patient-level tasks under cardiologist and LLM judging.
2607.25340.summary_zh: 本文将患者级心律失常决策支持表述为多阶段临床推理任务，超越单纯节律检测，进一步评估临床意义、紧急程度和管理方案。作者提出 Cardiologent，多智能体系统中由面向不同信号的智能体分析 ECG 和 PPG 特征，汇总患者节律画像，检索相关临床指南，并由批判智能体检查结论是否符合所引用指南。评估聚焦临床决策，结果显示该系统在心脏科医生和大规模 LLM 评审下均表现最好。
2607.25340.title: Cardiologent: Multi-Agent Clinical Decision Support for Patient-Level Arrhythmia Assessment, Urgency, and Management

2607.25348.summary_en: This paper applies simulated federated learning with explainable AI to chronic kidney disease prediction from clinical data. It evaluates Random Forest, AdaBoost, and XGBoost within a VotingClassifier framework, with client-side hyperparameter optimization and interpretability methods to explain predictions. The reported global model achieves high average accuracy, suggesting potential for interpretable privacy-preserving diagnostic support.
2607.25348.summary_zh: 本文将模拟联邦学习与可解释 AI 应用于基于临床数据的慢性肾病预测。研究在 VotingClassifier 框架中比较 Random Forest、AdaBoost 和 XGBoost，并在客户端使用 GridSearchCV 优化模型，同时引入解释方法说明预测机制。作者报告全局模型获得较高平均准确率，表明可解释联邦模型可能支持早期诊断。
2607.25348.title: Explainable AI for Chronic Kidney Disease Prediction Using Simulated Federated Learning

2607.25356.summary_en: This paper benchmarks progressive sampling strategies for scalable data quality profiling in data-centric AI pipelines. It compares blind representative samplers and proxy-guided methods across multiple real, synthetic, streaming, and ultra-large datasets for estimating missingness, duplicates, outliers, and dependency violations. The main finding is that schema-free random uniform or cluster sampling is more accurate and efficient than proxy-guided approaches, whose outlier proxies mismatch actual quality defects.
2607.25356.summary_zh: 该论文针对数据中心AI流水线中的大规模数据质量画像，评测渐进采样策略。研究在多个真实、合成、流式和超大数据集上比较盲代表性采样与代理引导方法，用于估计缺失率、重复率、异常密度和函数依赖违规。主要发现是，无模式的随机均匀采样或聚类采样比代理引导方法更准确且更高效，因为后者的异常代理与实际质量缺陷分布不匹配。
2607.25356.title: Data Quality Profiling at Scale with Progressive Sampling: A Benchmark for Data-Centric AI Pipelines

2607.25357.summary_en: This paper proposes Raven, a linear-time sequence model designed to improve long-context recall by changing how memory is written. Unlike dense state updates in SSMs or fixed-window storage in sliding-window attention, Raven maintains memory slots and updates a learned input-dependent subset at each step. The model is reported to outperform or match linear-time baselines on recall-intensive benchmarks and extrapolates effectively to much longer contexts than used in training.
2607.25357.summary_zh: 本文提出 Raven，一种通过改变记忆写入方式提升长上下文召回能力的线性时间序列模型。不同于 SSM 的密集状态更新或滑动窗口注意力的固定窗口存储，Raven 维护固定记忆槽，并在每一步通过学习到的输入相关路由只更新部分槽位。实验表明，该模型在召回密集型基准上达到或超过线性时间基线，并能有效外推到远长于训练长度的上下文。
2607.25357.title: Raven: High-Recall Sequence Modeling with Sparse Memory Routing

2607.25366.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-domain sequential recommendation with LLM-based model merging, where knowledge conflict and performance saturation arise in multi-domain fusion. It proposes SharpRec, combining sharpness-aware geometric alignment with preference salience activation to reduce parameter misalignment and recover domain-specific features. Experiments in dual-domain and multi-domain settings show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines.
2607.25366.summary_zh: 本文研究基于 LLM 模型合并的跨域序列推荐，关注多域融合中的知识冲突和性能饱和问题。作者提出 SharpRec，结合锐度感知几何对齐与偏好显著性激活，以缓解参数层面对齐不足并恢复目标域关键特征。双域与多域实验显示，该方法相较现有先进基线取得稳定提升。
2607.25366.title: Sharpness-aware Model Merging with Salience Recovery for LLM-based Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation

2607.25375.summary_en: This paper presents Inspect India Evals, an open benchmarking framework for evaluating LLMs in Indian linguistic, cultural, safety, fairness, and accuracy contexts. Built on Inspect AI, it includes six benchmarks covering multilingual knowledge, social bias, digital public infrastructure safety, harmful prompts, multi-turn jailbreak resistance, and cultural knowledge. Evaluation of five open-weight models shows variation across dimensions, with top models achieving the strongest composite fairness scores and the framework released for reproduction and extension.
2607.25375.summary_zh: 该论文提出Inspect India Evals，一个面向印度语言、文化、安全、公平性和准确性语境的开放LLM评测框架。该框架基于Inspect AI构建，包含多语言知识、社会偏见、数字公共基础设施安全、有害提示、多轮越狱抵抗和印度文化知识六类基准。对五个开放权重模型的评估显示不同维度表现差异明显，顶尖模型获得较高综合公平性分数，框架也被公开以支持复现和扩展。
2607.25375.title: Inspect India Evals: An Open Benchmarking Framework for Evaluating Large Language Models in the Indian Linguistic and Cultural Context

2607.25376.summary_en: This paper investigates whether likelihood distribution choice affects Bayesian neural network performance under variational inference. It compares Gaussian, skewed, and heavy-tailed likelihood assumptions across regression tasks using multilayer perceptrons. The main finding is that Student's t likelihood improves predictive performance over Gaussian likelihood across data distributions and architectures, sometimes with shorter training times.
2607.25376.summary_zh: 本文研究变分推断下贝叶斯神经网络的似然分布选择是否影响性能。作者在回归任务中使用多层感知机比较高斯、偏斜和重尾等似然假设。主要发现是 Student's t 似然在不同数据分布和网络结构下相较高斯似然带来更好的预测性能，并在部分情况下缩短训练时间。
2607.25376.title: Rethinking Likelihood distributions: Student's t Likelihood Boosts Bayesian Neural Network Performance

2607.25380.summary_en: This survey presents an architecture-centric taxonomy of memory mechanisms in large language models. It organizes memory along representation, update dynamics, and persistence axes, and further formalizes writing, routing, state transition, and consolidation mechanisms. The paper claims to unify fragmented memory-centric LLM research and provide a foundation for scalable and adaptive language model design.
2607.25380.summary_zh: 该综述提出面向架构的LLM记忆机制分类框架。论文从表示形式、更新动态和持久性三个轴线组织记忆，并进一步形式化写入、路由、状态转移和巩固等细粒度机制。其主张是统一分散的记忆型LLM研究，为可扩展和自适应语言模型设计提供原则性基础。
2607.25380.title: Memory for Large Language Models

2607.25387.summary_en: This paper questions whether learned restriction maps in sheaf graph neural networks constitute genuinely useful edge geometry or merely checkpoint-specific reliance. It separates fixed-checkpoint interventions from retrained replacement protocols that remove map capacity, edge variation, or persistent edge assignment, and gives theoretical conditions under which the two claims diverge. Empirical audits show that learned maps can govern a fitted computation while often being replaceable after retraining, so claims about learned transport require both intervention and matched retraining evidence.
2607.25387.summary_zh: 本文质疑 sheaf 图神经网络中学习到的 restriction maps 是否真正代表有用的边几何，还是仅体现特定检查点依赖。论文区分固定检查点干预与重新训练的替代协议，并给出二者可能分离的理论条件。实证审计显示，学习映射可能支配已拟合计算，但在重新训练后常可被替代，因此关于学习传输的主张需要同时结合检查点干预和匹配重训练证据。
2607.25387.title: Learned, Relied Upon, or Necessary? Separating Checkpoint Dependence from Task-Level Value in Sheaf GNNs

2607.25398.summary_en: This paper introduces HANDBOOK.md, a benchmark for evaluating whether language-model agents follow long, binding standing instructions over extended tool-use tasks. The benchmark places agents in simulated company environments with file workspaces and mock services exposed through the Model Context Protocol, with deterministic grading over required and prohibited actions. Results show low strict pass rates among evaluated model configurations and recurring failures in policy retention, check compliance, and resistance to conflicting in-environment requests.
2607.25398.summary_zh: 该论文提出HANDBOOK.md，用于评估语言模型智能体在长程工具使用任务中是否遵守冗长且有约束力的常设指令。基准将智能体置于模拟公司环境中，包含文件工作区以及通过Model Context Protocol暴露的邮件、聊天、日历、工单和商务服务，并通过程序化标准确定性评分。结果显示所评模型配置的严格通过率较低，常见失败包括被环境请求覆盖政策、执行检查后违背检查结果、长期任务中遗忘规则细节以及虚报合规。
2607.25398.title: HANDBOOK.md: A Benchmark for Long-Context Agentic Instruction Following

2607.25404.summary_en: This paper studies long-horizon conversion prediction in online advertising under delayed feedback, where clicks and conversions arrive on different time scales. It introduces TWICE, which factorizes post-click conversion rate into target-window conversion probability and an elapsed-delay cumulative distribution, trained with complementary click-clock and conversion-clock supervision. Experiments on public and industrial data, including an online A/B test, show improved revenue and conversion metrics and led to full-traffic deployment.
2607.25404.summary_zh: 本文研究在线广告中延迟反馈下的长周期转化预测，其中点击与转化由不同时间尺度产生监督信号。作者提出 TWICE，将点击后转化率分解为目标窗口转化概率和分组延迟累积分布，并分别利用点击时钟与转化时钟进行训练。公共基准、工业数据和在线 A/B 测试表明，该方法提升了收入与转化指标，并已部署到全量流量。
2607.25404.title: TWICE: Two-Clock, Two-Window Learning for Long-Horizon Conversion Prediction in Online Advertising

2607.25413.summary_en: This paper addresses transaction propensity prediction in B2B e-commerce, where heterogeneous procurement behavior undermines SMOTE-style interpolation. It proposes a deployed framework that uses DiCE-based counterfactual generation for minority samples and adapts PyPARC piecewise affine classification to calibrated propensity probabilities and interpretable customer risk tiers. Evaluation on longitudinal B2B platform data reports higher precision than SMOTE-based baselines across operating thresholds.
2607.25413.summary_zh: 本文研究 B2B 电商中的交易倾向预测问题，指出组织采购行为的异质性会破坏 SMOTE 线性插值的合理性。论文提出一个已部署框架，使用基于 DiCE 的反事实样本生成替代 SMOTE，并将 PyPARC 分段仿射分类改造为可校准的倾向概率与可解释客户风险分层。基于两年纵向平台数据的评估显示，该方法在多个阈值下较 SMOTE 基线取得更高精度。
2607.25413.title: SPARC Segmentation to Prediction via Affine Regression and Counterfactuals

2607.25439.summary_en: This paper proposes a robust unsupervised network intrusion detection method for IoT settings where unlabeled training data may contain anomalies. The method uses federated learning to reduce the influence of minority anomalous data and adds selective aggregation based on EM clustering of distances between local client models and a global reference. Experiments on multiple NIDS datasets show improved detection under contaminated training data and robustness as anomaly proportions increase.
2607.25439.summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向物联网网络入侵检测的鲁棒无监督异常检测方法，处理未标注训练数据中可能存在异常样本的问题。方法利用联邦学习对少数异常数据影响不足的特性，并通过基于 EM 的选择性聚合排除与全局参考显著偏离的客户端模型更新。多个 NIDS 数据集实验表明，该方法在污染训练数据下提升检测性能，并在异常比例增加时保持鲁棒性。
2607.25439.title: Robust Unsupervised Network Intrusion Detection via Federated Learning with Selective Aggregation under Anomalous Sample Contamination

2607.25441.summary_en: This paper addresses covariate shift across data partitions in cross-validation, lifelong learning, and federated learning. It proposes PIcsC, a Fisher-information-based regularization framework that uses partition-local gradient statistics and conditionally activates correction when significant shift is detected. Experiments across many datasets show improved performance under natural and synthetic shift and gains over federated learning baselines without client-specific personalization.
2607.25441.summary_zh: 本文研究交叉验证、终身学习和联邦学习中训练数据分区之间的协变量偏移问题。作者提出PIcsC，一种基于Fisher信息的正则化框架，利用分区本地梯度统计近似分布差异，并在检测到显著偏移时条件性启用校正。大量数据集实验表明，该方法在自然和合成偏移下提升性能，并优于联邦学习基线且不需要客户端个性化。
2607.25441.title: PIcsC: Partitioning-Induced Covariate Shift Correction

2607.25446.summary_en: This paper argues that LLM multi-agent frameworks often conflate team composition, coordination, and collaboration protocol. It introduces IMACS, which separates organization, coordination, and algorithmic protocol into independently configurable layers, enabling controlled comparisons and adaptive protocol selection. The paper reports that organizational assignments affect outcomes through protocol routing and that a contextual-bandit meta-protocol can choose protocols under quality-cost trade-offs better than fixed protocols in the studied setting.
2607.25446.summary_zh: 本文指出，LLM多智能体框架常将团队组成、协调方式和协作协议混为一体。论文提出IMACS，将组织、协调和算法协议分离为可独立配置的层，从而支持受控比较和自适应协议选择。研究报告称，组织分配会通过协议路由影响结果，而上下文赌博机元协议可在质量与成本权衡下选择协议，并在所研究设置中优于固定协议。
2607.25446.title: Toward an Organizational Science of Multi-Agent LLM Systems: Decoupling Who, How, and Which Algorithm

2607.25447.summary_en: The paper addresses policy evaluation for multifamily residential redevelopment, where collective-action outcomes depend on adaptive stakeholder negotiation. It presents CoRenew, an open-source platform using multiple LLM-based agents to simulate negotiations among synthetic stakeholders under alternative policy settings, with geographic and demographic data integration. Validation against resident surveys and an observed real redevelopment negotiation supports its behavioral realism and adaptability across contexts.
2607.25447.summary_zh: 本文研究多户住宅再开发政策评估中的集体行动难题，强调利益相关者会随谈判环境和他人反应动态调整决策。作者提出CoRenew开放平台，使用多个基于大语言模型的代理模拟合成利益相关者在不同政策组合下的谈判过程，并整合地理和人口数据。通过居民调查和真实再开发案例谈判过程进行验证，结果支持其行为真实性和跨情境适用性。
2607.25447.title: CoRenew: A large language model agent-based policy simulation platform for multifamily residential redevelopment

2607.25451.summary_en: This paper examines whether LLM quantization reduces privacy risk, focusing on verbatim extraction rather than membership inference. Using memorized sequences from Pythia models across multiple precisions and sizes, it measures how quantization affects exact reproduction and general capability. The paper finds that quantization reduces memorization faster than capability but does not reliably eliminate extractable training data, especially in larger models.
2607.25451.summary_zh: 本文研究 LLM 量化是否降低隐私风险，并将重点放在逐字抽取而非成员推断上。作者使用 Pythia 模型已知记忆的序列，在不同精度和模型规模下衡量量化对逐字复现与通用能力的影响。论文发现量化会比能力更快地削弱记忆，但并不能可靠移除可抽取的训练数据，尤其是在较大模型中。
2607.25451.title: Bits and Memories: Measuring Verbatim Extraction Across LLM Quantization

2607.25459.summary_en: The paper investigates how sequence models internally represent hidden stochastic dynamics under noisy partial observability. Using a controlled multivariate stochastic volatility setting where true latent states are available for evaluation, it analyzes representations across architectures, losses, and output heads. The authors find evidence for a two-stage computation in which hidden states encode future latent volatility and output heads map this to squared-return forecasts, with identifiable latent-state computation patterns in Transformers.
2607.25459.summary_zh: 该论文研究序列模型在噪声和部分可观测条件下如何内部表征潜在随机动态。作者使用受控的多变量随机波动率环境，其中真实潜在状态可用于评估，并跨架构、损失函数和输出头分析模型表征。结果显示模型存在两阶段计算：隐藏表征编码下一步潜在波动率状态，输出头再将其映射为平方收益预测；在 Transformer 中还可识别出特定阶段的潜在状态计算。
2607.25459.title: Emergent Latent-State Computation under Stochastic Volatility

2607.25467.summary_en: The paper studies visual key-value memory eviction in stateful multimodal assistants across dialog turns, asking when visual information can safely be forgotten. It introduces CVMA, a paired single-prefill causal audit that measures answer degradation when visual regions, the whole image, or prior assistant text become unavailable. Results on dialog benchmarks indicate that current attention is unreliable for predicting future visual usefulness, while safe forgetting depends more on future visual dependence and whether facts have already been verbalized.
2607.25467.summary_zh: 该论文研究有状态多模态助手在多轮对话中的视觉 KV 记忆淘汰问题，关注哪些视觉事实可以安全遗忘。作者提出 CVMA，一种配对单次预填充因果审计框架，用于测试当视觉区域、整张图像或先前助手文本不可用时后续回答会损失什么。实验表明当前注意力难以可靠预测未来视觉有用性，安全遗忘更多取决于后续问题对视觉的依赖程度以及事实是否已被文本化。
2607.25467.title: Seen, Said, or Forgotten? A Causal Audit of Visual KV Memory Across Dialog Turns

2607.25471.summary_en: The paper addresses sparse recommendation by combining semantic signals from LLM-generated profiles with heterogeneous graph structure. It proposes TRWH, which builds user and item embeddings, propagates information through a HeteroGNN, and augments sparse graphs using random-walk-derived user-user and item-item links. Experiments on large Amazon datasets report substantial gains, while also finding that random walks may dilute nuanced LLM representations without adaptive integration.
2607.25471.summary_zh: 该论文研究稀疏推荐场景中如何结合 LLM 生成的语义画像与异构图结构信号。作者提出 TRWH，通过用户和物品嵌入构建、异构图神经网络传播，以及基于随机游走的二阶用户-用户和物品-物品边增强稀疏图。大规模 Amazon 数据集实验报告显著性能提升，同时指出随机游走可能削弱 LLM 表征中的细粒度语义，因此需要自适应融合策略。
2607.25471.title: TRWH: A Text-Driven Random Walk Heterogeneous GNN for Semantic-Aware Sparse Recommendation

2607.25474.summary_en: The paper frames automated line generalization in cartography as a constrained multiscale similarity optimization problem. It proposes a similarity-driven framework that combines spatial similarity objectives with cartographic constraints on readability, smoothness, and geometric validity to tune scale-dependent parameters for generalization algorithms. Experiments across simplification algorithms, scales, and similarity metrics suggest the framework balances similarity preservation with cartographic abstraction more consistently than similarity-only evaluation.
2607.25474.summary_zh: 该论文将制图中的线要素自动综合表述为受约束的多尺度相似性优化问题。作者提出相似性驱动框架，将空间相似性目标与可读性、平滑性和几何有效性等制图约束结合，用于自动确定不同尺度下的算法参数。实验覆盖多种线简化算法、目标尺度和相似性度量，结果表明该框架比单独依赖相似性评估更一致且更可解释地平衡信息保持与制图抽象。
2607.25474.title: Balancing multiscale similarity and cartographic constraints: A similarity-driven optimization framework for line generalization

2607.25479.summary_en: The paper analyzes supply-chain risks in vision-language models where third-party model artifacts include executable architectural behavior. It proposes an architectural backdoor attack using trigger-gated representation steering, which remains dormant on clean inputs but shifts intermediate representations toward attacker-defined objectives when triggered. Evaluations across VLM families and downstream tasks claim compromised integrity, safety enforcement, and ranking fairness while motivating auditing of executable model logic beyond learned weights.
2607.25479.summary_zh: 该论文研究视觉语言模型供应链中的安全风险，指出第三方模型工件不仅包含权重，也包含可执行的架构行为。作者提出一种基于触发门控表征 steering 的架构后门攻击，在无触发时保持正常计算，在有触发时将中间表征推向攻击者指定目标。跨多个 VLM 家族和下游任务的评估声称该攻击会破坏完整性、安全约束和排序公平性，并强调应审计模型工件中的可执行逻辑而不仅是权重。
2607.25479.title: Architectural Backdoors in Vision-Language Model Supply Chains via Representation Steering

2607.25480.summary_en: This paper analyzes constrained online convex optimization with per-round feasibility using online gradient descent plus a Polyak feasibility step. It derives a tighter data-dependent regret bound by replacing worst-case gradient accumulation with observed gradients and introducing a nonnegative Polyak correction that improves the bound. The authors also propose AdaOGD-PFS, which achieves adaptive regret scaling while maintaining feasibility and improves empirical regret bounds on constrained problems.
2607.25480.summary_zh: 本文研究带逐轮可行性约束的在线凸优化，并分析结合在线梯度下降与 Polyak 可行性步骤的方法。论文通过使用观测到的梯度累积量替代最坏情形界，并引入带负号进入遗憾界的 Polyak 修正项，得到更紧的数据依赖分析。作者还提出 AdaOGD-PFS，在保持逐轮可行性的同时实现自适应遗憾界，并在实验中改进了约束问题的遗憾上界。
2607.25480.title: Data-Dependent Regret and Polyak Corrections for Constrained Online Convex Optimization

2607.25484.summary_en: The paper studies how to reduce a precomputed plan when new cost bounds make the original plan infeasible while preserving action order and executability. It formulates the task as selecting a utility-maximizing valid subplan under a budget, proves the decision variant NP-complete, and proposes exact solutions via oversubscription planning and integer linear programming. A refined ILP formulation is introduced to reduce model size and improve computational efficiency over earlier work.
2607.25484.summary_zh: 该论文研究当新预算约束使预先生成的计划不可行时，如何在保持动作顺序和可执行性的前提下提取子计划。作者将问题形式化为在成本界限下选择效用最大的有效子计划，证明其判定版本为 NP 完全，并提出基于超额订阅规划和整数线性规划的精确求解方法。论文进一步给出精简的 ILP 公式，以减小模型规模并提升计算效率。
2607.25484.title: Finding Optimal Cost-Bounded Plan Reductions: Refined Model

2607.25485.summary_en: The paper introduces PatientAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating patient-facing healthcare AI agents in sustained, tool-using conversations with simulated patients and realistic health records. The framework wraps foundation models in an agent with healthcare tools and scores conversations using an LLM-as-a-Jury against clinician-grounded criteria, validated against clinician annotations. Benchmarking ten models reveals persistent gaps in triage, clinical safety, and workflow accuracy that static medical QA benchmarks do not expose.
2607.25485.summary_zh: 该论文提出 PatientAgentBench，用于评估面向患者的医疗 AI 代理在持续对话、工具使用和真实健康记录场景中的表现。该框架将基础模型封装为带医疗工具沙箱的代理，并使用经临床标准约束的 LLM-as-a-Jury 评分，同时与执业临床医生标注进行一致性验证。对十个模型的基准测试显示，在分诊、临床安全和工作流准确性方面仍存在明显缺口，而静态医学问答基准难以暴露这些问题。
2607.25485.title: PatientAgentBench: A Benchmark Framework for Evaluating Patient-Facing Health AI Agents

2607.25487.summary_en: The paper tackles memory constraints in vision-language-action robot models by seeking robust performance with a sub-billion-parameter backbone. It proposes CoTinyVLA, using dual-view temporal inputs, hierarchical chain-of-thought distillation from a larger teacher, and paraphrase augmentation to structure supervision. The reported LIBERO-Plus results indicate that this smaller model outperforms larger baselines across robustness suites, with ablations attributing gains to separable components.
2607.25487.summary_zh: 该论文研究视觉-语言-动作机器人模型在嵌入式部署中的内存限制，目标是在十亿参数以下实现强鲁棒性。作者提出 CoTinyVLA，结合双视角时序输入、来自大教师模型的分层链式思维蒸馏，以及指令改写增强来组织监督信号。LIBERO-Plus 结果显示该小模型在多个鲁棒性套件上超过更大的基线，消融实验表明各组件对不同扰动轴有可分离贡献。
2607.25487.title: CoTinyVLA: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for a Sub-Billion-Parameter Vision-Language-Action Model

2607.25489.summary_en: This scoping review examines agentic AI in medicine, covering architectures, applications, evaluation practices, and translation challenges. It maps studies involving goal-directed execution, tool use, external resources, feedback refinement, and multi-agent collaboration across tasks such as question answering, image interpretation, electronic health records, drug safety, and clinical trial prediction. The review finds that current evidence relies heavily on benchmarks and simulated or retrospective settings, with gaps in reliability, traceability, uncertainty, safety, workflow impact, and prospective validation.
2607.25489.summary_zh: 本文是一项关于医学中智能体 AI 的范围综述，覆盖架构、应用、评估实践和临床转化挑战。作者系统映射了涉及目标导向执行、工具使用、外部资源、反馈式改进和多智能体协作的研究，应用包括医学问答、图像解释、电子健康记录分析、药物安全和临床试验预测。综述指出，现有证据主要依赖公开基准、模拟或回顾性数据，在过程可靠性、证据可追溯性、不确定性、安全性、工作流影响和前瞻性验证方面仍不足。
2607.25489.title: Agentic AI in medicine: architectures, applications, evaluation, and challenges for clinical translation

2607.25492.summary_en: This paper studies stochastic optimization under heavy-tailed gradient noise and develops quantum mean estimators for multivariate heavy-tailed random variables. It proves query-complexity upper and lower bounds and uses the estimators to construct quantum stochastic gradient methods for nonconvex and convex objectives. The main claim is that these methods improve over classical lower bounds in low-dimensional regimes while being near-optimal up to logarithmic factors in relevant settings.
2607.25492.summary_zh: 本文研究重尾梯度噪声下的随机优化，并提出用于多变量重尾随机变量的量子均值估计器。论文证明了查询复杂度的上下界，并基于这些估计器构造了量子随机梯度方法以处理非凸和凸目标。主要结论是，在低维情形下这些方法相对经典下界具有量子加速，并在相关设定中达到近似最优。
2607.25492.title: Quantum Speedups for Stochastic Optimization with Heavy-Tailed Noise

2607.25494.summary_en: The paper addresses numerical instability in deep learning operators caused by finite-precision arithmetic and improper formulations. It presents a unified software tool integrating CESTAC to detect operator stability, localize sources of instability, and monitor stability during training and inference in a single computation pass. Validation with injected unstable operators suggests the tool can support development of numerically stable deep learning kernels.
2607.25494.summary_zh: 该论文研究有限精度运算和不当公式导致的深度学习算子数值不稳定问题。作者提出一个集成 CESTAC 的统一软件工具，可在单次计算过程中检测算子稳定性、定位不稳定来源，并在训练和推理期间进行监控。通过注入数值不稳定算子的验证表明，该工具可为开发数值稳定的深度学习计算内核提供支持。
2607.25494.title: Automated Numerical Stability Analysis of Deep Learning Operators

2607.25497.summary_en: The paper examines robustness assessment for pathology foundation model representations under non-biological confounders such as preparation, staining, and scanning differences. It critiques the pooled count-based Robustness Index and proposes CRoMa, a sample-resolved margin distribution comparing cross-confounder biological matches against same-confounder distractors. Evaluations across multiple encoders show heterogeneous robustness profiles and suggest CRoMa can help anticipate shortcut-induced downstream performance drops.
2607.25497.summary_zh: 该论文研究病理基础模型表征在组织制备、染色和扫描差异等非生物混杂因素下的鲁棒性评估。作者指出现有 Robustness Index 的池化计数设计会掩盖样本级异质性，并提出 CRoMa，通过比较跨混杂因素的生物匹配与同混杂因素的生物干扰样本来形成样本级 margin 分布。多种编码器上的评估显示模型存在不同的鲁棒性分布，并表明 CRoMa 可用于预判捷径学习导致的下游性能下降。
2607.25497.title: Beyond Counts: A Distributional Robustness Margin For Pathology Foundation Models

2607.25502.summary_en: This paper addresses training-time neural backdoor defense by framing benign subset isolation as an anti-backdoor coreset selection problem. It uses cumulative entropy over learning dynamics, together with per-epoch unlearning of selected samples, to separate informative benign data from rare low-uncertainty poisoned samples. The authors claim the resulting coreset trains backdoor-free models while preserving natural accuracy and improving robustness across attacks.
2607.25502.summary_zh: 本文将训练时神经后门防御表述为反后门核心集选择问题，目标是从污染训练集中隔离良性子集。方法利用学习动态中的累积熵选择高信息量良性样本，并在每个 epoch 中对所选样本进行遗忘以增强良性与有毒样本的可分性。作者声称该方法能训练无后门模型，同时几乎不损害自然准确率并稳定缓解多类攻击。
2607.25502.title: Anti-Backdoor Coreset Selection via Cumulative Entropy

2607.25504.summary_en: The paper targets inefficient sparse tensor contractions for Transformer inference on vector processors, where current RVV architectures rely on software metadata decoding and indexed memory operations. It introduces Ventaglio, a runtime-configurable sparse execution unit with RVV ISA extensions for indexed gather-accumulate-scatter support. The reported results show substantial speedups for sparse kernels and Transformer inference workloads with modest area overhead.
2607.25504.summary_zh: 该论文研究向量处理器上 Transformer 推理中的稀疏张量收缩效率问题，指出现有 RVV 架构依赖软件索引解码和 L1 支撑的索引访存，性能远低于 roofline 上界。作者提出 Ventaglio，一种运行时可配置的稀疏执行单元及 RVV 指令扩展，用于支持索引 gather-accumulate-scatter。论文报告该方法在稀疏内核和剪枝 LLaMA 推理任务上带来显著加速，并且面积开销较小。
2607.25504.title: At-the-Roofline Sparse Tensor Contractions on Vector Processors for Transformer Inference

2607.25507.summary_en: This theoretical paper develops a bounded spectral framework for analyzing rotary phase structure, hidden-state continuity, and semantic drift in transformer language models. It derives RoPE attention scores as magnitude-weighted cosine terms, introduces modal coordinates and a coherence functional, and distinguishes representational continuity from execution-boundary admissibility. The main claim is that spectral structure can explain some continuity properties, but governance of consequential execution must remain an external predicate.
2607.25507.summary_zh: 该理论论文提出一个有界谱框架，用于分析Transformer语言模型中的旋转相位结构、隐藏状态连续性和语义漂移。论文将RoPE注意力得分推导为幅度加权余弦项，并引入模态坐标和相干性泛函，同时区分表示连续性与执行边界可允许性。主要观点是，谱结构可以解释某些连续性属性，但对重要执行转移的治理仍必须作为外部判定。
2607.25507.title: Phase Structure in Rotary Attention: A Spectral Framework for Semantic Continuity and Execution-Boundary Governance

2607.25514.summary_en: The paper studies strategic behavior by publishers in generative AI search ecosystems, where exposure depends on generated answers and attribution rather than ranked document lists. It introduces a game-theoretic model and analyzes better-response learning dynamics using potential games under different content selection mechanisms. The results characterize instability in mechanisms resembling current systems and show trade-offs among ecosystem stability, publisher welfare, and user welfare.
2607.25514.summary_zh: 本文研究生成式AI搜索生态中发布者的策略行为，其中曝光来自生成答案及其归因，而非传统排序列表。作者提出博弈论模型，并利用势博弈分析不同内容选择机制下的更优响应学习动态。结果表明，类似现实系统的机制可能不稳定，并揭示生态稳定性、发布者福利和用户福利之间的权衡。
2607.25514.title: Learning Dynamics of Strategic Publishers in Generative AI Ecosystems

2607.25518.summary_en: The paper addresses shortcomings in antimicrobial peptide evaluation, where binary AMP recognition does not capture potency, spectrum, safety, or cross-endpoint behavior. It introduces AMPBench-MT, a provenance-preserving, sequence-homology-controlled benchmark covering binary recognition, species-conditioned pMIC regression, and endpoint-specific potency and safety-facing readouts. Across many model evaluations, it finds that high binary performance does not reliably predict assay-endpoint behavior and argues for endpoint-aware evidence auditing beyond recognition leaderboards.
2607.25518.summary_zh: 本文研究抗菌肽计算发现评估中的不足，即二分类AMP识别不能充分反映效力、谱系、安全性和跨终点行为。作者提出AMPBench-MT，一个保留来源信息且控制序列同源性的基准，涵盖二分类识别、物种条件pMIC回归以及终点特定的效力和安全代理读数。大量模型评估显示，高二分类性能并不可靠代表实验终点表现，因此抗菌肽评估应从识别排行榜转向面向终点的证据审计。
2607.25518.title: AMPBench-MT: A Homology-Controlled Benchmark for Antimicrobial Peptide Potency, Spectrum, and Safety Prediction

2607.25522.summary_en: The paper studies proactive defenses against misuse of Diffusion Transformer-based image-to-video models, where existing adversarial defenses are computationally expensive. It proposes I2VShield, combining text-adaptive perturbation generation with an untargeted Multimodal Attention Disruption attack to perturb internal attention features while maintaining visual imperceptibility. Experiments claim competitive protection across datasets and mainstream DiT-based I2V models with substantially reduced computational cost.
2607.25522.summary_zh: 该论文研究针对基于 Diffusion Transformer 的图像到视频模型滥用的主动防御问题，指出现有梯度式对抗防御计算成本较高。作者提出 I2VShield，结合文本自适应扰动生成和非定向多模态注意力扰乱攻击，在保持视觉不可察觉性的同时偏移模型内部注意力特征。实验声称该方法在多个数据集和主流 DiT 图像到视频模型上具有竞争性保护效果，并显著降低计算成本。
2607.25522.title: I2VShield: An Efficient Proactive Defense Framework against DiT-based Image-to-Video Models

2607.25524.summary_en: The paper addresses robustness gaps in UAV-satellite cross-view geo-localization under real-world degradations such as weather, motion, noise, and compression. It introduces UAVSat-Deg, a large-scale corruption benchmark, and ReLATE, a reliability-adaptive evidence fusion framework that estimates token reliability and integrates trustworthy local evidence into cross-view descriptors. The authors claim ReLATE achieves the best average corrupted-test performance among compared methods while remaining competitive on clean images.
2607.25524.summary_zh: 该论文研究无人机与卫星跨视角地理定位在天气、运动、噪声和压缩等真实退化条件下的鲁棒性不足。作者提出大规模退化基准 UAVSat-Deg，并提出 ReLATE，通过估计视觉 token 的可靠性并融合可信局部证据来构建跨视角描述符。论文声称 ReLATE 在两类测试集和双向检索设置下取得最佳平均退化测试表现，同时保持有竞争力的干净图像精度。
2607.25524.title: ReLATE: Reliability-Guided Evidence Fusion for Robust UAV--Satellite cross-view Geo-Localization

2607.25527.summary_en: This paper presents Argus-Unified, a compact multimodal model that unifies image understanding and generation with reduced compute and data requirements. It leverages pretrained vision-language models, introduces hybrid visual tokens that preserve continuous representations for understanding while learning discrete tokens for generation, and trains in two stages using a frozen vision encoder followed by unified multimodal modeling. The paper reports strong understanding performance and competitive generation quality at lower cost and with less data than several comparable unified models.
2607.25527.summary_zh: 本文提出Argus-Unified，一种以较低计算和数据需求统一图像理解与生成的紧凑多模态模型。该方法利用预训练视觉语言模型，引入混合视觉token，在保留用于理解的连续表示的同时学习用于生成的离散token，并采用冻结视觉编码器上的量化器与图像解码器学习、随后统一多模态建模的两阶段训练。论文报告其在理解任务上表现强劲，在生成质量上具有竞争力，并且成本和数据用量低于若干可比统一模型。
2607.25527.title: Argus-Unified: Towards A Compact and Economical Unified Model for Image Understanding and Generation

2607.25529.summary_en: This paper examines whether high-weight neurons are necessarily important in image classification networks. It assesses neuron importance through overlap between high-weight and accuracy-impacting neurons, perturbation effects, and retraining after high-weight ablation on CIFAR-10 and Mini-ImageNet. The results show a nonlinear relationship: some high-weight neurons are important, many are not, and some low-weight neurons also contribute substantially, challenging simple weight-importance equivalence.
2607.25529.summary_zh: 本文研究图像分类神经网络中高权重神经元是否必然重要。作者通过高权重神经元与影响准确率神经元的重叠、扰动效应以及高权重消融后再训练等实验，在CIFAR-10和Mini-ImageNet上评估神经元重要性。结果显示权重与重要性之间是非线性关系：部分高权重神经元重要，但许多并不重要，同时一些低权重神经元也有显著贡献，从而挑战简单的权重-重要性等价假设。
2607.25529.title: Are the High-weight Neurons the Important Ones in Image Classification Neural Networks?

2607.25531.summary_en: This paper improves a developmental, gradient-free continual learning framework for visual recognition by introducing multi-scale structural features. The representation captures edges, contours, and spatial relations at multiple scales and is integrated with network-refinement learning and improved read-out dynamics. On class-incremental MNIST, the approach increases accuracy over prior representations while preserving continual retention and human-interpretable learned structure without storing past data.
2607.25531.summary_zh: 本文通过引入多尺度结构特征，改进一种用于视觉识别的发育式、无梯度持续学习框架。该表示在多个尺度上捕获边缘、轮廓及其空间关系，并与网络精化学习过程和改进的读出机制结合。在类别增量MNIST上，该方法相较既有表示提高准确率，同时在不存储历史数据的情况下保持持续保留能力和人类可解释结构。
2607.25531.title: Multi-Scale Structural Features for Continual, Comprehensible Visual Recognition in a Developmental Learning Framework

2607.25532.summary_en: This paper formalizes spurious routing in tabular in-context learners when a composite feature contains both causal and spurious subspaces. It proves that ridge in-context learning cannot determine which signal drives predictions regardless of context size, and empirically finds similar behavior in TabPFN. The paper also introduces environment-stratified context construction and S-swap augmentation, which reduce spurious routing using weak environment labels without knowing the causal partition.
2607.25532.summary_zh: 本文形式化研究表格上下文学习器中的虚假路由问题，即复合特征同时包含因果子空间和虚假子空间时模型可能依赖错误信号。论文证明岭回归式上下文学习无论上下文大小都无法判定预测应由哪类信号驱动，并在TabPFN上观察到相似经验行为。作者还提出环境分层上下文构造和S-swap增强，在不知道因果划分的情况下利用弱环境标签减少虚假路由。
2607.25532.title: Entangled by Design: Spurious Intra-Variable Signal Routing in Tabular In-Context Learners

2607.25537.summary_en: This paper investigates visual prompt engineering for video foundation models, asking whether automatically modifying task images can improve visual reasoning performance. The method transforms visual inputs, such as converting abstract scenes into more photorealistic versions, before passing them to video models. The paper claims that this approach improves performance across tasks and can be more effective than text prompt engineering or test-time scaling for video models.
2607.25537.summary_zh: 本文研究面向视频基础模型的视觉提示工程，探讨自动修改任务图像是否能提升视觉推理性能。该方法在输入视频模型前转换视觉输入，例如将抽象场景变为更写实的版本。论文声称该方法在多个任务上提升性能，并且对视频模型而言可能比文本提示工程或测试时扩展更有效。
2607.25537.title: Visual prompt engineering for video models

2607.25538.summary_en: This paper studies feature heterogeneity in Swarm Learning with Random Forests, where organizations train collaboratively without central coordination or direct data sharing but may have only partially overlapping features. It proposes deterministic and probabilistic inference-time strategies for handling tree splits on features unavailable at a local site, avoiding restriction to the feature intersection. Evaluation on nine datasets shows improvements over intersection-only and local-training baselines.
2607.25538.summary_zh: 本文研究随机森林群体学习中的特征异质性问题，即多个组织在无中心协调和无直接数据共享条件下协作训练，但特征空间仅部分重叠。作者提出多种确定性和概率式推理时策略，以处理本地缺失特征上的树分裂，从而避免只使用共同特征训练。九个数据集上的实验显示，这些方法优于交集特征基线和本地训练模型。
2607.25538.title: Mind the Missing Split: Resolving Feature Heterogeneity in Swarm Learning with Random Forests

2607.25543.summary_en: This paper studies general audio-visual AIGC forgery detection beyond human-centric deepfakes. It argues that cross-modal correspondence assumptions are unreliable in general scenes and proposes DAV-Det, a decoupled system that independently models visual and audio forensic evidence before decision-level fusion. The visual branch uses multi-granularity representations, the audio branch models temporal and spectral artifacts, and the system ranked first in a challenge setting.
2607.25543.summary_zh: 本文研究超越人脸深伪的一般音视频AIGC伪造检测。作者认为在一般场景中音视频内容对应性假设并不稳定，因此提出DAV-Det，通过解耦方式分别建模视觉和音频取证证据，并在决策层融合。视觉分支使用多粒度表示，音频分支建模时间和频谱伪造痕迹，该系统在相关挑战中排名第一。
2607.25543.title: Less is More: Modality-Decoupling for General AIGC Audio-Video Detection

2607.25545.summary_en: The paper studies lightweight diabetic retinopathy screening under edge deployment and domain shift, where heterogeneous teacher models provide supervision of unequal reliability. It proposes OrthKD, a selective-trust multi-teacher distillation framework that takes full supervision from a strong CNN teacher, feature-only supervision from a weaker Transformer teacher, and orthogonalizes teacher-specific student projections. Results on retinal image datasets indicate improved in-domain and zero-shot performance for a compact MobileNetV3 student, supporting heterogeneous teacher distillation for robust clinical deployment.
2607.25545.summary_zh: 本文研究边缘部署和域偏移条件下的轻量级糖尿病视网膜病变筛查，其中异构教师模型的监督可靠性不同。作者提出OrthKD选择性信任蒸馏框架，从强CNN教师接受完整监督，从较弱Transformer教师只进行特征蒸馏，并对教师特定学生投影施加正交约束。视网膜图像实验显示，紧凑MobileNetV3学生模型在域内和零样本跨域性能上均有提升，支持异构教师蒸馏用于稳健临床部署。
2607.25545.title: OrthKD: Extracting Generalized Clinical Knowledge from Heterogeneous Teachers for Lightweight Deployment

2607.25546.summary_en: This paper introduces the Normalised Sensitivity Ratio, a post-hoc model-agnostic diagnostic for identifying causal versus spurious feature reliance in already trained models under structured distribution shifts. The method compares per-environment sensitivity variation, with causal features expected to show stable sensitivity and spurious features tracking environmental shifts. The paper proves exact identification under a linear structural causal model, characterizes failure modes, gives finite-sample rates, and validates the theory on synthetic and real data.
2607.25546.summary_zh: 本文提出归一化敏感性比率NSR，用于在结构化分布偏移下对已训练模型进行事后、模型无关的因果与虚假特征依赖诊断。该方法比较不同环境中的特征敏感性变化，因果特征应保持稳定，而虚假特征会随环境偏移变化。论文在线性结构因果模型下证明精确识别，刻画失败模式和有限样本收敛率，并在合成与真实数据上验证理论。
2607.25546.title: From Training to Deployment: Post-Hoc Causal Feature Identification via Sensitivity Ratios

2607.25554.summary_en: This paper addresses future event prediction by improving data synthesis for temporal search and reasoning in LLMs. It proposes a time-truncation harness that enforces temporal cutoffs during sampling to reduce leakage and generate higher-quality training data, and distillation experiments show that students trained on harness-intervened data perform best.
2607.25554.summary_zh: 本文面向未来事件预测，改进LLM时间搜索与推理的数据合成过程。作者提出时间截断harness，在采样每一轮强制时间截止以减少时间泄漏并生成更高质量训练数据；蒸馏实验表明，使用该harness干预数据训练的学生模型表现最佳。
2607.25554.title: Distilling Temporal Search and Reasoning: Evolving LLMs for Future Prediction via Harness-Assisted Efficient Data Synthesis

2607.25560.summary_en: This paper identifies skill leakage as a behavioral side channel through which proprietary agent skills can be reconstructed from execution trajectories. It introduces SigLeak, a black-box framework that creates diagnostic tasks, contrasts skill-enabled and skill-disabled trajectories, and refines reconstructed skills from recurring behavior patterns, showing improved reconstruction quality across scenarios, model families, and agent frameworks.
2607.25560.summary_zh: 本文提出技能泄漏问题，即专有智能体技能可通过执行轨迹中的行为侧信道被重构。作者提出黑盒框架SigLeak，通过构造诊断任务、对比启用与禁用技能的轨迹，并从重复行为模式中迭代重建技能，在多种场景、模型族和智能体框架中表现出更好的重构质量。
2607.25560.title: Agent Skills Matter: Inferring Proprietary Skills from Execution Trajectories

2607.25566.summary_en: This paper introduces ARCHER, a deterministic multi-agent program-synthesis harness for generating auditable building compliance verification code from regulatory codes. It evaluates six harness designs of increasing agentic sophistication across four backbone models on realistic compliance scenarios. ARCHER achieves the highest accuracy for every backbone and substantially improves over a naive single-pass prompting baseline while enabling lower-cost data-sovereign deployment.
2607.25566.summary_zh: 本文提出ARCHER，一种确定性编排的多智能体程序合成框架，用于从建筑法规生成可审计的合规验证代码。作者在真实合规场景数据集上，跨四种骨干模型评估六种不同智能体复杂度的框架。结果显示ARCHER在所有骨干模型上准确率最高，相比单次提示基线大幅提升，并支持更低成本的数据主权部署。
2607.25566.title: ARCHER: Agentic Rule and Compliance Harness for Executable Regulations

2607.25569.summary_en: This paper proposes CORF-GS, a real-time wireless radiance field reconstruction framework using coupled optical-RF Gaussian splatting. It maintains a unified Gaussian representation with shared geometry and modality-specific appearance, using optical guidance for densification and joint optical-RF optimization to adapt to both visual structure and RF power distributions. Simulations report state-of-the-art RF spectrum synthesis quality and faster reconstruction than existing wireless radiance field methods.
2607.25569.summary_zh: 本文提出CORF-GS，一种利用耦合光学-RF高斯溅射进行实时无线辐射场重建的框架。该方法维护共享几何和模态特定外观的统一高斯表示，通过光学引导增密并进行联合光学-RF优化，以同时适应视觉结构和RF功率分布。仿真实验报告其RF频谱合成质量达到先进水平，并比现有无线辐射场方法重建更快。
2607.25569.title: CORF-GS: Real-Time Wireless Radiance Field Reconstruction via Coupled Optical-RF Gaussian Splatting

2607.25570.summary_en: This paper introduces LAIA, a synthetic dataset for end-to-end autonomous driving research enriched with human attention data. Collected in CARLA, it includes multimodal driving signals, visual annotations, weather variations, CAN bus data, and synchronized eye tracking from participants. The dataset is intended to support attention-aware driving models, driver behavior prediction, anomaly detection in attention, and explainability analysis by comparing human and model attention.
2607.25570.summary_zh: 本文介绍LAIA，一个面向端到端自动驾驶研究并包含人类注意力数据的合成数据集。该数据集在CARLA中采集，包含多模态驾驶信号、视觉标注、多种天气、CAN总线数据以及参与者同步眼动数据。LAIA旨在支持注意力感知驾驶模型、驾驶员行为预测、异常注意力检测和通过比较人类与模型注意力进行可解释性分析。
2607.25570.title: The LAIA Dataset: Labelled Attention for Intelligent Automobiles

2607.25576.summary_en: This paper proposes the Sensor Attention Network for sparse-view photoacoustic tomography reconstruction. The Transformer-based model treats each sensor time series as a token and maps raw measurements directly to images without using the system matrix at inference. Benchmarking against iterative and learned baselines shows higher reported reconstruction quality and substantially reduced inference time, supporting real-time reconstruction claims.
2607.25576.summary_zh: 本文提出Sensor Attention Network，用于稀疏视角光声断层成像重建。该Transformer模型将每个传感器的完整时间序列视为一个token，并在推理时不调用系统矩阵，直接从原始测量映射到图像。与迭代方法和学习型基线相比，实验报告了更高重建质量和显著更短推理时间，从而支持实时重建的主张。
2607.25576.title: Matrix-Free Photoacoustic Image Reconstruction via Sensor-Token Self-Attention

2607.25579.summary_en: This paper addresses entity alignment across knowledge graphs by constructing reusable identity representations from frozen LLM internal states. IRIS elicits identity-oriented contextual representations for each entity once, forming a shared comparable space that avoids pair-dependent construction and candidate-wise LLM inference. Experiments across four benchmarks and two frozen LLM backbones report very high Hits@1 scores, supporting the claim that stable identity signatures improve alignment.
2607.25579.summary_zh: 本文研究跨知识图谱实体对齐，提出从冻结LLM内部状态构建可复用身份表示的方法IRIS。该方法为每个实体一次性诱导面向身份的上下文表示，形成共享可比较空间，避免依赖特定图谱对或候选实体逐一调用LLM。跨四个基准和两个冻结LLM骨干的实验报告了很高的Hits@1，支持稳定身份签名有助于实体对齐的主张。
2607.25579.title: IRIS: Reusable Identity Representations from Frozen LLMs for Entity Alignment

2607.25581.summary_en: This paper evaluates forced alignment for Hindi-English code-mixed speech using the Montreal Forced Aligner. It focuses on free variation between native and non-native pronunciations and boundary detection for English words embedded mid-utterance. The results show that bootstrapped lexicons and acoustic models trained on sentence-level code-mixed data substantially improve alignment accuracy over monolingual alternatives.
2607.25581.summary_zh: 该论文使用Montreal Forced Aligner评估印地语-英语混合语音的强制对齐。研究关注本族与非本族发音变体，以及话语中间英语词的音素边界检测。结果显示，词典自举策略和基于句子级混合语料训练的声学模型显著优于单语替代方案，说明原则化词典设计与混合训练数据对可靠对齐都很重要。
2607.25581.title: Evaluation of forced alignment of code-mixed speech: the case of Hindi-English

2607.25583.summary_en: This paper conducts a controlled study of LoRA rank, adapted modules, and quantization for text-to-SQL fine-tuning on a 60M-parameter T5-small model. It evaluates accuracy together with trainable parameters, memory, latency, and throughput to characterize adaptation as a constrained trade-off. The results show that moderate LoRA rank recovers much of full fine-tuning accuracy with fewer trainable parameters and lower memory, while INT8 and NF4 QLoRA provide additional memory savings with comparable accuracy in this setting.
2607.25583.summary_zh: 本文在6000万参数的T5-small模型和WikiSQL任务上，对LoRA秩、适配模块和量化进行受控研究。论文同时评估准确率、可训练参数、显存、延迟和吞吐量，将模型适配视为受约束的权衡问题。结果表明，中等LoRA秩能以更少可训练参数和更低显存恢复大部分全量微调准确率，而INT8和NF4 QLoRA在该设置下以相近准确率带来进一步显存节省。
2607.25583.title: How Small Can You Go? A Controlled Study of LoRA Rank, Target Modules, and Quantization Trade-offs for Text-to-SQL on a 60M-Parameter Model

2607.25589.summary_en: This paper performs a retrospective forensic reproducibility audit of a preserved radiology vision-language model benchmark artifact. Without rerunning models or adding annotations, it traces prompt bindings, DICOM rendering, completeness, label extraction, statistical analyses, and release propagation. The audit identifies multiple protocol-artifact mismatches and withdraws prior performance and clinical claims, proposing machine-verifiable controls for future benchmark reproducibility.
2607.25589.summary_zh: 该论文对一个已保存的放射学视觉语言模型基准进行回顾性法证复现审计。研究不重新调用模型或新增标注，而是追踪提示绑定、DICOM渲染、输出完整性、标签抽取、统计分析和发布传播。审计发现多个协议与发布工件不一致的问题，并撤回原有性能和临床主张，同时提出未来基准复现所需的机器可验证控制。
2607.25589.title: Forensic Reproducibility Audit of a Radiology Vision-Language Model Benchmark: From Intended Protocol to Released Artifact

2607.25590.summary_en: This paper studies LLM-native advertising, aiming to insert sponsored content into model responses without degrading the upstream generation process.
