PILA reformulates ad insertion as conditional response rewriting and implements it as a lightweight, model-agnostic sidecar module separated from the base LLM service. Experiments across upstream models claim improved advertising effectiveness while preserving response quality and offering controllable trade-offs between naturalness and exposure.
2607.25590.summary_zh: 该论文研究LLM原生广告，即在模型回复中自然插入赞助内容而不破坏上游生成流程。PILA将广告插入重述为条件化回复改写任务，并作为与基础LLM服务解耦的轻量、模型无关侧车模块实现。实验声称该方法在多种上游模型上提高广告效果，同时保持回复质量，并提供自然性与曝光之间的可控权衡。
2607.25590.title: PILA: Plug-and-Play Insertion for LLM-native Advertising

2607.25597.summary_en: This paper presents EMolStudio, a density-matrix-centered AI platform for electronic-structure prediction and analysis in lithium-metal electrolytes. The workflow combines molecular functionalization, explicit lithium first-shell assembly, density-matrix prediction with idempotency projection, and electronic readouts such as frontier orbitals and bond order. Applying it to large libraries of functionalized molecules and lithium clusters, the paper derives hypotheses about how functional groups and salt anions affect solvation, desolvation, and interphase-relevant reactivity.
2607.25597.summary_zh: 本文提出EMolStudio，一种以密度矩阵为中心的AI平台，用于锂金属电解液的电子结构预测与分析。其流程结合分子官能化、显式锂离子第一溶剂化壳层组装、带幂等投影的密度矩阵预测，以及前线轨道、键级等电子结构读出。作者将其应用于大规模官能化分子和锂簇库，提出官能团与盐阴离子如何影响溶剂化、去溶剂化和界面反应的电子结构假设。
2607.25597.title: A Density-Matrix Framework for Electronic-Structure Analysis of Functional-Group and Salt Effects in Lithium-Metal Electrolytes

2607.25600.summary_en: This paper studies whether verbalized confidence from black-box LLMs can guide retrieval routing in retrieval-augmented question answering. The proposed BeyondUncertainty method elicits a provisional answer and confidence estimate, routes low-confidence questions to TF-IDF retrieval, and directly returns high-confidence answers. Across multiple benchmarks, model families, and policies, it improves mean F1 over always-retrieve and no-retrieval baselines while reducing retrieved passages, though the extra probe increases total token usage.
2607.25600.summary_zh: 本文研究黑盒LLM的语言化置信度是否可用于检索增强问答中的检索路由。所提出的BeyondUncertainty先生成临时答案和置信度估计，将低置信问题交给TF-IDF检索，高置信问题则直接返回答案。跨多个基准、模型族和策略的实验显示，该方法相较总是检索和不检索基线提高平均F1并减少检索段落，但额外探测会增加总体token消耗。
2607.25600.title: Beyond Self-Knowledge: Propagating Uncertainty Across Reasoning and Retrieval in LLMs

2607.25605.summary_en: This paper formalizes the classical usuli method of al-Sabr wa al-Taqsim for extracting legal causes in closed jurisprudential chapters using set theory. It introduces an algorithm that takes a complete truth table of juristic verdicts and computes minimal operational rules by eliminating logically redundant attributes. The resulting structures are presented as admissible candidate causes for later juristic evaluation, under assumptions of a finite concept vocabulary and complete ruling table.
2607.25605.summary_zh: 本文用集合论形式化经典法理方法al-Sabr wa al-Taqsim，以在封闭法学章节中提取法律原因。论文提出一种算法，从完整裁判真值表中计算最小操作规则，并消除逻辑冗余属性。所得结构被视为后续法学评估的候选原因，但依赖有限概念词汇和完整裁判表等条件。
2607.25605.title: Computational Extraction of Legal Causes via al-Sabr wa al-Taqsim: A Set-Theoretic Formalization for Closed Fiqh Chapters

2607.25608.summary_en: This paper introduces PI-BLS, a physics-informed broad learning system for solving partial differential equations without iterative backpropagation. The method embeds differential operators and initial or boundary constraints into a linear output-layer optimization solved by pseudoinverse. Experiments on forward PDE benchmarks claim competitive or superior performance with reduced training time and fewer parameters compared with conventional PINNs.
2607.25608.summary_zh: 本文提出PI-BLS，一种无需迭代反向传播的物理信息宽度学习系统，用于求解偏微分方程。该方法将微分算子及初始或边界约束嵌入线性输出层优化问题，并通过伪逆求解。实验声称在代表性正向PDE基准上，相比传统PINN具有竞争性或更优性能，同时减少训练时间和模型参数。
2607.25608.title: Physics-Informed Broad Learning System: An Efficient Backpropagation-Free Framework for Solving Partial Differential Equations

2607.25609.summary_en: This paper proposes a contrastive representation learning framework for longitudinal clinical data modeled as temporal graphs. Patient observations are represented as nodes, with edges encoding temporal continuity and structural similarity, while structure-aware random walks support contrastive graph neural network training. The learned embeddings support clustering of similar disease progression patterns and reveal latent trajectory structure.
2607.25609.summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于纵向临床数据的对比表示学习框架，将多变量疾病轨迹建模为时间图。患者随时间变化的观测被表示为节点，边刻画时间连续性和轨迹结构相似性，并通过结构感知随机游走训练对比图神经网络。学习到的嵌入可用于聚类相似疾病进展模式并揭示纵向数据中的潜在结构。
2607.25609.title: Contrastive Representation Learning of Longitudinal Disease Trajectories on Temporal Graphs

2607.25612.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for weather simulations whose characteristics are aligned across sensors for autonomous-vehicle perception. It proposes ReDAM for fog intensity alignment and Unified-weather-edit for rain and snow particle-position alignment, validating them with statistical and geometrical tests. The results indicate that non-aligned simulations can make 3D detection models appear overly optimistic, while aligned multi-sensor simulations improve robustness through finetuning.
2607.25612.summary_zh: 本文针对自动驾驶感知中多传感器恶劣天气仿真需要一致天气特征的问题展开研究。作者提出用于雾强度对齐的ReDAM，以及用于雨雪粒子位置对齐的Unified-weather-edit，并通过统计和几何测试验证。结果表明，未对齐仿真会使3D检测模型表现过于乐观，而对齐后的多传感器仿真可通过微调提升鲁棒性。
2607.25612.title: Multi-Sensor Alignment for Weather Simulations

2607.25614.summary_en: The paper addresses the alignment tax in domain-specializing large language models, where fine-tuning can degrade general-task performance. It proposes MemSFT, a plug-and-play external parametric memory trained to imitate a non-parametric domain retriever, with a learned router that fuses memory and backbone output distributions during generation. Evaluations across biology, geoscience, and law claim improved domain performance with negligible general-performance degradation compared with full supervised fine-tuning.
2607.25614.summary_zh: 本文研究大语言模型领域适配中的 alignment tax，即领域微调可能导致通用任务性能退化。作者提出MemSFT，通过外部可插拔参数记忆来模仿非参数领域检索器，并在生成时用学习到的路由器动态融合记忆与骨干模型的输出分布。生物、地学和法律领域评估表明，相较完整监督微调，该方法可提升领域性能且几乎不损害通用性能。
2607.25614.title: MemSFT: Mitigating Alignment Tax with an External Parametric Memory

2607.25620.summary_en: This article critiques accounts of LLM epistemic risk that locate legitimacy in capacities internal to autonomous agents. It reframes LLMs as techno-semiotic machines that automate phases of written semiosis, arguing that epistemic problems arise from a broader socio-technical cleavage between plausible signs and practices of interpretation, verification, and responsibility. The paper proposes a design orientation emphasizing genealogy, contestability, distributed responsibility, and evaluation of hybrid human-AI practices.
2607.25620.summary_zh: 本文批判将LLM认识论风险归因于自主主体内部能力的解释框架。论文将LLM重新理解为自动化书写符号过程的技术-符号机器，认为相关问题源于可信语言符号与解释、验证和责任实践之间的社会技术断裂。作者据此提出面向可追溯谱系、可争议性、分布式责任和人机混合实践评估的设计方案。
2607.25620.title: Beyond Epistemia: Epistemic Schizologia and Large Language Models as Techno-Semiotic Machines

2607.25624.summary_en: This paper studies positive quadratic networks through their quotient structure, where factor matrices represent the same low-rank positive semidefinite predictor up to orthogonal transformations. It shows that factor gradient flow projects to quotient Riemannian gradient flow, derives curvature and convergence properties for quadratic regression, and characterizes implicit bias in underdetermined commuting regimes via entropy mirror flow and Bregman projections.
2607.25624.summary_zh: 本文研究正二次网络的商空间结构，其中因子矩阵在正交变换下表示同一个低秩半正定预测器。论文证明因子梯度流可投影为商黎曼梯度流，推导二次回归中的曲率与收敛性质，并在欠定可交换情形中用熵镜像流和Bregman投影刻画隐式偏置。
2607.25624.title: Quotient Dynamics, Effective Curvature, and Implicit Bias in Positive Quadratic Networks

2607.25626.summary_en: This paper addresses non-invasive EEG-to-text decoding for large-vocabulary Chinese sentence production and perception. EEGAlign jointly aligns EEG signals with text embeddings and speech features via contrastive learning followed by CTC decoding, achieving strong closed-set sentence classification and showing that text and audio alignment axes are complementary.
2607.25626.summary_zh: 本文研究面向中文大词汇句子的非侵入式 EEG 到文本解码，覆盖发声生产和感知场景。作者提出 EEGAlign，通过对比学习将 EEG 同文本嵌入和语音特征联合对齐，再进行 CTC 字符序列解码，并显示文本与音频两种对齐轴具有互补性。
2607.25626.title: Joint Text-Audio Alignment for EEG-to-Text Decoding in Chinese Speech Production and Perception

2607.25630.summary_en: This paper introduces a human-in-the-loop corpus for simplifying scientific summaries for non-specialist readers. Starting from SciSummNet and GPT-4o-mini simplifications, it collects reader judgments and expert edits, finding that GPT outputs are preferred for comprehensibility and simplicity while expert revisions help preserve terminology and scientific claim strength.
2607.25630.summary_zh: 本文构建一个面向非专业读者的科学摘要简化人机协同语料。作者以 SciSummNet 和 GPT-4o-mini 生成的简化文本为起点，收集读者判断和专家编辑，发现 GPT 输出在易懂性和简单性上更受偏好，而专家修订有助于保留领域术语和科学论断强度。
2607.25630.title: A Human-in-the-Loop Corpus for LLM-Based Simplification of Scientific Summaries

2607.25633.summary_en: This paper studies black-box-verifiable ownership fingerprints for large language models. It proposes LCF for linguistically grounded code-mixing fingerprint construction and LCFEdit for construction-aware injection using null-space projection and cross-lingual alignment, aiming to preserve utility while enabling persistent ownership verification.
2607.25633.summary_zh: 本文研究用于大语言模型所有权验证的黑盒可验证指纹。作者提出 LCF 构造基于语言学的代码混合触发指纹，并提出 LCFEdit 通过零空间投影和跨语言对齐进行构造感知注入，以在保持模型效用的同时实现持久所有权验证。
2607.25633.title: Construction-Driven Injection: Linguistically-Grounded Edit-Based Code-Mixing Fingerprints for Large Language Models

2607.25634.summary_en: This paper presents AIriskEval-edu Demo, a platform for auditing pedagogical risks in instructional explanations. It evaluates explanations across five rubric dimensions with binary decisions, confidence scores, rationales, and localized evidence spans, combining an external GPT-5.5 API with a self-hosted fine-tuned Llama evaluator that performs well on reported metrics.
2607.25634.summary_zh: 本文提出 AIriskEval-edu Demo，一个用于审计教学解释中教育风险的平台。系统依据五个规则维度输出二元判断、置信度、理由和局部证据片段，并结合外部 GPT-5.5 API 与本地微调的 Llama 评估器；后者在多数报告指标上表现更好。
2607.25634.title: AIriskEval-edu Demo: Auditing of Pedagogical Risks in Educational Explanations

2607.25636.summary_en: The paper investigates whether measurable properties of near-infrared spectral datasets can guide CNN architecture choices for chemometric regression. It computes descriptors such as spectral length, entropy, intrinsic rank, autocorrelation, and wavelet structure across 25 tasks, then analyzes near-optimal Bayesian hyperparameter optimization trials to derive warm-start heuristics. The results show dataset-derived priors, especially for receptive fields, can guide shallow CNNs toward competitive configurations before task-specific tuning.
2607.25636.summary_zh: 本文研究近红外光谱数据集的可测属性是否能指导化学计量回归中的CNN架构设计。作者在25个任务上计算光谱长度、熵、内在秩、自相关和小波结构等描述符，并从贝叶斯超参数优化的近优试验中提取 warm-start 启发式规则。结果表明，数据导出的先验尤其能指导卷积感受野选择，使浅层CNN在目标任务调优前接近有竞争力的配置。
2607.25636.title: Using Data-Derived Priors to Guide CNN Architecture Design for NIR Chemometrics

2607.25637.summary_en: This paper proposes F(AI)2R, a provenance framework for AI-assisted research artifacts that records AI contributions in machine-auditable form. It extends PROV-O with aiprov and packages the method as an executable skill operated by an AI agent, with continuous integration checks and provenance invariants demonstrated through the paper’s own production process.
2607.25637.summary_zh: 本文提出 F(AI)2R，用于以机器可审计形式记录 AI 参与研究工件生产的溯源框架。作者用 aiprov 扩展 PROV-O，并将方法封装为由 AI agent 操作的可执行技能，通过持续集成检查和溯源不变量在论文自身生产过程中进行案例展示。
2607.25637.title: F(AI)2R: Who Did What, and Who Checked? Verifiable AI Provenance as an Executable Skill

2607.25641.summary_en: This paper addresses physical commonsense failures in text-to-image generation. It introduces OmniPhys, a knowledge-graph-grounded benchmark, and OmniPrompt, an iterative prompt optimization framework that aggregates stochastic image feedback to reduce noise, reporting improved physical consistency across diverse text-to-image models.
2607.25641.summary_zh: 本文关注文生图模型违反物理常识的问题。作者提出基于物理知识图谱的 OmniPhys 基准，以及通过聚合随机图像反馈来降低噪声的迭代提示优化框架 OmniPrompt，并报告其能提升多种文生图模型的物理一致性。
2607.25641.title: OmniPhys: Knowledge-Graph-Driven Benchmarking and Collective Optimization for Physical Commonsense in Text-to-Image Generation

2607.25642.summary_en: This survey reviews instruction-based image editing, where a source image is transformed according to textual instructions. It organizes the field around task definitions, data construction, model architectures, evaluation benchmarks, and applications, covering the shift from GAN-based methods to diffusion and autoregressive paradigms. The paper also proposes CDD-IIE Bench and compares open-source systems to identify current capabilities, limitations, and future directions.
2607.25642.summary_zh: 该综述讨论基于指令的图像编辑，即根据文本指令转换给定图像。论文从任务定义、训练数据构建、模型架构、评估指标与基准、以及应用方案五个维度组织相关研究，并覆盖从GAN到扩散和自回归范式的发展。论文还提出CDD-IIE Bench，并通过开源方案比较总结现有能力、局限和未来方向。
2607.25642.title: Instruction-based Image Editing: A Survey on Data, Models, Evaluation, and Applications

2607.25647.summary_en: The paper addresses reliability testing for quantum libraries, where existing LLM-based fuzzers are limited by low flexibility and efficiency. It proposes KQFuzz, a knowledge-guided fuzzer that grounds LLM test generation in codebase knowledge and combines fitness-guided evaluation with two-level mutations to explore execution paths. Experiments on Qiskit, PennyLane, and Cirq report higher coverage than prior methods and identify confirmed bugs.
2607.25647.summary_zh: 本文研究量子库可靠性测试问题，指出现有基于大语言模型的模糊测试方法在灵活性和效率上存在不足。作者提出KQFuzz，利用代码库知识约束测试生成，并结合适应度引导评估和两级变异来探索复杂执行路径。实验在Qiskit、PennyLane和Cirq上显示其覆盖率优于已有方法，并发现了多个已确认缺陷。
2607.25647.title: KQFuzz: Knowledge-Guided Fuzzing for Quantum Libraries via Large Language Models

2607.25648.summary_en: This paper argues that public service AI governance frameworks designed for narrow AI may fail for general-purpose AI, using policing as the central case. It claims that GPAI undermines assumptions behind accuracy, bias, explainability, accountability, expert evaluation, and human oversight, and recommends taxonomic separation, technological parsimony, deployment pauses in policing, and national safety infrastructure.
2607.25648.summary_zh: 本文认为，面向窄域 AI 设计的公共服务 AI 治理框架在通用 AI 时代可能失效，并以警务为核心案例展开论证。作者指出 GPAI 破坏了准确性、偏见、可解释性、问责、专家评估和人在回路监督等治理假设，并建议区分窄域与通用 AI、保持技术节制、暂停警务部署并建立国家级安全证据基础设施。
2607.25648.title: Why Public Service AI Governance Frameworks Risk Failing in the Age of General-Purpose AI: Lessons from Policing

2607.25655.summary_en: This paper studies chess positions that engines judge approximately equal but humans play with reproducible outcome skews. Using large-scale Lichess data, it finds that position-specific advantages for White or Black replicate across account splits, time, rating bands, and later out-of-sample data, implying that engine evaluation is not sufficient to predict human outcomes.
2607.25655.summary_zh: 本文研究强棋引擎认为近似均势、但人类实际对局结果存在可复现偏斜的国际象棋局面。作者基于大规模 Lichess 数据发现，特定局面对白方或黑方的优势在账号划分、时间、等级区间和后续样本中均可复现，说明引擎评估不足以预测人类结果。
2607.25655.title: Engine-Equal, Human-Unequal: A Reproducible Outcome Skew in Engine-Assessed Equal Chess Positions

2607.25656.summary_en: The paper studies evaluation of multi-agent orchestration plans independently from worker skill, tool reliability, and execution noise. It introduces OrchBench, a deterministic simulation benchmark that represents real-world tasks as dependency DAGs and evaluates planner choices about agent assignment, cross-agent information transfer, and retention under budget and context constraints. Results show simulated scores correlate with execution-based quality while using far fewer tokens and less time, and suggest that preserving task-critical information matters more than simply adding agents.
2607.25656.summary_zh: 本文研究如何在不混入工作智能体能力、工具可靠性和执行噪声的情况下评估多智能体编排计划。作者提出 OrchBench，将真实任务表示为依赖 DAG，并用确定性仿真评估规划器在智能体分配、跨智能体信息传递和保留比例方面的选择。结果显示，仿真分数与真实执行质量高度相关且成本更低，并表明保留任务关键信息比单纯增加智能体数量更重要。
2607.25656.title: OrchBench: Evaluating Multi-Agent Orchestration Plans in Isolation via Deterministic Simulation

2607.25659.summary_en: This paper addresses token-level credit assignment in rubric-guided GRPO training, where response-level rewards are usually broadcast uniformly across all tokens. CoRT uses counterfactual replay under rubric-conditioned and criteria-free prompts to derive tokenwise likelihood contrasts, redistributing advantages across tokens and improving over response-level GRPO in most comparisons.
2607.25659.summary_zh: 本文研究基于规则的 GRPO 训练中的 token 级信用分配问题，因为传统方法通常将响应级奖励均匀分配给所有生成 token。作者提出 CoRT，通过在带规则和不带准则的提示下进行反事实重放，计算 token 级似然差异并重新分配优势，在多数比较中优于响应级 GRPO。
2607.25659.title: CoRT: Counterfactual Replay for Token-Level Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization

2607.25663.summary_en: This paper investigates how the location of LoRA adaptation in transformer layers affects learning, transfer, and selectivity. Across five controlled objectives, it identifies distinct adaptation geometries, showing that different tasks favor early, middle, late, or full-stack adaptation and that these patterns replicate across model families.
2607.25663.summary_zh: 本文研究 Transformer 中 LoRA 适配位置如何影响学习、迁移和选择性。作者在五类受控目标上定义并比较“适配几何”，发现不同任务分别偏好早层、中层、晚层或全栈适配，且这些模式在多个模型家族中大体复现。
2607.25663.title: Localized Adaptation Reveals Distinct Learning Signatures in Transformers

2607.25664.summary_en: The paper addresses demand forecasting systems that achieve statistical accuracy but create operational volatility in retail inventory. It introduces Contextual Deconvolution, a two-stage convex decomposition that separates promotion-driven shocks from structural baseline demand using kernel-modulated banded operators and hierarchical partial pooling. Out-of-sample evaluations on M5 and Favorita datasets suggest the method improves stability, safety stock, holding cost, and error reliability, but reduces total expected cost only under sufficiently high holding-cost regimes.
2607.25664.summary_zh: 本文研究零售需求预测中统计精度较高但运营波动过大的问题。作者提出Contextual Deconvolution，通过核调制带状算子和层级部分池化，将促销冲击与平滑结构性需求基线进行两阶段凸分解。M5和Favorita数据集的严格样本外评估表明，该方法可改善预测稳定性、安全库存、持有成本和误差可靠性，但只有在持有成本相对缺货成本足够高时才降低总期望成本。
2607.25664.title: Contextual Deconvolution for Variance-Stable Demand Sensing: Kernel-Modulated Operators in Promotional Retail

2607.25667.summary_en: This paper presents MyMentorLLM, a multimodal voice/text simulation environment for scalable CBT training and supervision. It generates sessions linking simulated patients, trainee therapists, and expert supervisors, finding disorder-congruent emotional patterns and that supervisor feedback can improve simulated diagnostic performance, while emphasizing the need to evaluate fidelity, calibration, and harmful feedback.
2607.25667.summary_zh: 本文提出 MyMentorLLM，一个用于 CBT 训练和督导的多模态语音/文本模拟环境。系统生成包含模拟患者、受训治疗师和专家督导的完整会话，发现患者情绪模式与障碍类型一致，督导反馈可改善部分模拟治疗师的诊断表现，同时指出需共同评估患者逼真度、督导校准和有害反馈。
2607.25667.title: MyMentorLLM: A psychotherapy GenAI environment with multimodal voice/text patients, trainees and experts for deliberate practice

2607.25668.summary_en: The paper addresses thermal ranking of low-cost wall materials for hot-dry rural housing. It proposes a two-stage framework using Crank-Nicolson finite difference simulations to generate heat-equation solutions and a physics-informed neural operator with a Fourier Neural Operator backbone to learn the parameter-to-temperature-field map. Results report accurate reproduction of finite-difference rankings and thermal metrics, identifying clay-straw adobe as the best nominal cost-performance choice and showing climate-dependent ranking inversion regimes.
2607.25668.summary_zh: 本文研究炎热干燥气候下低成本乡村住房墙体材料的热性能排序问题。作者提出两阶段框架，先用Crank-Nicolson有限差分方法生成一维瞬态传热方程解，再用带Fourier Neural Operator骨干的物理信息神经算子学习参数到温度场的映射。结果显示该方法能准确复现有限差分材料排序和热指标，指出标称条件下 clay-straw adobe 成本性能最佳，并揭示不同气候条件下排序反转的机制区域。
2607.25668.title: A Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Thermal Ranking of Low-Cost Wall Materials in Hot-Dry Climates

2607.25669.summary_en: This paper targets the memory and inference cost of OmniLLMs caused by long audio-video token sequences. OmniDelta is a training-free framework that allocates token budgets across modalities and within audio/video streams according to query intent, local complexity, and redundancy, improving the accuracy-efficiency tradeoff on audio-video benchmarks.
2607.25669.summary_zh: 本文针对全模态大语言模型中长音视频 token 序列带来的显存和推理成本问题。作者提出无需训练的 OmniDelta，根据查询意图、局部复杂度和时间冗余在模态间及模态内分配 token 预算，从而在音视频基准上改善准确率与效率的权衡。
2607.25669.title: OmniDelta: Skill-Driven Budget Allocation for Token Compression in OmniLLMs

2607.25672.summary_en: This controlled study examines how well LLMs assist scientific literature reviews for expert-conceived projects in physics, astrophysics, and cosmology. It compares references selected by human experts and AI systems, and audits AI-generated references for fabrication and metadata errors. The paper finds low overlap with expert selections and substantial metadata mismatch rates for mid-2025 models, while a limited test of a newer model shows improved reference reliability.
2607.25672.summary_zh: 该受控研究考察LLM在物理、天体物理和宇宙学科研文献综述中的辅助能力。研究比较人类专家与AI系统所选参考文献，并审查AI生成候选文献中的虚构和元数据错误。论文发现中期2025模型与专家选择重合度很低且元数据错误较多，而对更新模型的单项目测试显示参考文献可靠性有所改善。
2607.25672.title: AI's Capability in Assisting Scientific Research in Physics, Astrophysics, and Cosmology I: Literature Review

2607.25675.summary_en: This paper addresses text-space optimization for LLMs where both solver artifacts and evaluation rubrics may need improvement. DecoEvo co-evolves a solver skill and a rubric-generator skill under decoupled objectives, using criterion-level feedback for the solver and independent coverage and discrimination audits for the rubric generator, yielding gains across benchmarks and backbones.
2607.25675.summary_zh: 本文研究 LLM 的文本空间优化问题，其中求解器工件和评价规则都可能成为性能瓶颈。作者提出 DecoEvo，在解耦目标下共同演化求解器技能和规则生成器技能：求解器依据准则级反馈更新，规则生成器依据覆盖度和区分度审计更新，并在多个基准和模型骨干上取得提升。
2607.25675.title: DecoEvo: Score-Decoupled Co-Evolution of Solver and Rubric-Generator Skills in Text Space

2607.25679.summary_en: This paper presents DynaBridge, a multimodal framework for depression, anxiety, and stress assessment that incorporates the psychometric structure of DASS-21. It combines acoustic, visual, textual, and frozen-LLM-generated semantic summaries with item-level ordinal prediction and confidence-aware refinement, outperforming baseline multimodal methods on the AdoDAS validation split.
2607.25679.summary_zh: 本文提出 DynaBridge，一种用于抑郁、焦虑和压力评估的多模态框架，并显式利用 DASS-21 的心理测量结构。该方法融合声学、视觉、文本特征和冻结 LLM 生成的语义摘要，进行条目级有序预测与置信度感知修正，并在 AdoDAS 验证集上优于基线方法。
2607.25679.title: DynaBridge: Dynamic Summary-Guided Cross-Task Multimodal Fusion for DASS-Structured Mental Health Assessment

2607.25680.summary_en: This paper introduces Rashomon Alignment, a measure of functional similarity between models that evaluates decision-boundary alignment beyond observed data distributions. By sampling uniformly from the instance space, the proposed geometric alignment complements distributional similarity and is analyzed across more than 90 datasets for model comparison, selection, ensembles, and interpretability.
2607.25680.summary_zh: 本文提出 Rashomon Alignment，用于衡量模型之间的功能相似性，重点考察超出观测数据分布的决策边界对齐。作者通过在实例空间中均匀采样计算几何相似性，并在 90 多个数据集上表明其与分布式相似性互补，可用于模型选择、集成和可解释性。
2607.25680.title: Rashomon Alignment

2607.25681.summary_en: This paper proposes Cognivia, an AI therapist framework for identifying cognitive distortions and generating rational CBT responses. It builds an augmented CBT dataset from authoritative texts and mental health Q&A data, fine-tunes a lightweight LLM, and evaluates it with lexical, LLM-judge, and expert human assessments showing improvements over baselines.
2607.25681.summary_zh: 本文提出 Cognivia，一种用于识别认知扭曲并生成 CBT 理性回应的 AI 治疗师框架。作者基于权威 CBT 文本和心理健康问答数据构建增强数据集，微调轻量级 LLM，并通过词汇指标、LLM 评审和专家评估证明其优于基线方法。
2607.25681.title: Cognivia: A Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Copilot for Evidence-Based Mental Healthcare

2607.25687.summary_en: This paper tackles full-field urban air pollution reconstruction from sparse monitoring observations. It introduces a diffusion-based generative framework for multi-pollutant reconstruction, benchmarks it against deterministic deep learning models, and reports realistic spatial patterns on Paris observations with augmentation methods that support transfer without retraining.
2607.25687.summary_zh: 本文研究如何从稀疏监测站观测重建城市空气污染全场分布。作者提出用于多污染物重建的扩散式生成框架，并与确定性深度学习模型比较；在巴黎真实观测上，模型生成了较真实的空间模式，且数据增强支持无需重新训练的迁移。
2607.25687.title: From Deterministic to Generative Deep Learning for Urban Air Quality Reconstruction from Sparse Observations

2607.25716.summary_en: This paper presents a systematic study of federated training for SpeechLLM-based end-to-end automatic speech recognition. It designs a communication-efficient federated optimization strategy for high-dimensional SpeechLLM architectures under distributed computational constraints. English and Italian ASR experiments and ablations show competitive word error rates, stable training, and reduced communication costs relative to centralized and configuration baselines.
2607.25716.summary_zh: 本文系统研究基于SpeechLLM的端到端自动语音识别的联邦训练。作者针对SpeechLLM高维参数、梯度通信开销和分布式计算约束，设计通信高效的联邦优化策略。英语和意大利语ASR实验及消融表明，该方法获得有竞争力的词错误率、稳定训练表现，并降低通信成本。
2607.25716.title: SpeechLLM Meets Federated Learning for End-to-End ASR: English and Italian Case Studies

2607.25718.summary_en: This paper studies tool retrieval for LLM agents, arguing that tools should be selected as jointly useful sets rather than independently scored items. HYSET formulates retrieval as query-conditioned hyperedge prediction over a tool co-invocation hypergraph, captures set compatibility, and improves retrieval and downstream task success on ToolBench while supporting transfer to unseen tools and domains.
2607.25718.summary_zh: 本文研究LLM智能体的工具检索，指出工具选择应评估候选集合的联合效用，而不是孤立地给单个工具打分。HYSET将检索表述为工具共调用超图上的查询条件超边预测，建模集合兼容性，并在ToolBench上提升工具检索和端到端任务成功率，同时支持向未见工具和领域迁移。
2607.25718.title: Tools Are Not Islands: Set-Level Tool Retrieval for LLM Agents via Query-Conditioned Hyperedge Prediction

2607.25719.summary_en: The paper studies constrained optimization when constraint functions are unknown and unavailable for querying during optimization. It proposes Dynamic Constraint Learning, which learns local surrogate constraints from nearby data at each iteration and solves subproblems inside data-supported trust regions. Synthetic and literature case studies indicate that local adaptive surrogates can achieve solution quality comparable to global constraint models while using simpler models and smaller subproblems.
2607.25719.summary_zh: 本文研究约束函数未知且优化过程中无法查询约束的约束优化问题。作者提出Dynamic Constraint Learning，在每次迭代中用邻近数据学习局部约束代理，并在数据支持的信赖域内求解子问题。合成问题和两个文献案例显示，局部自适应代理可在使用更简单模型和更小子问题的同时，达到接近全局约束学习模型的解质量。
2607.25719.title: Optimization with Dynamic Constraint Learning (DCL)

2607.25726.summary_en: This paper studies whether LLM-generated recommendation explanations can nudge users toward more sustainable choices. It generates sustainability-aware explanations grounded in nudge theory and tests them in randomized studies, finding that framed sustainability information and descriptive social norms increase sustainable selections while plain disclosure improves perceptions without changing behavior.
2607.25726.summary_zh: 本文研究由 LLM 生成的推荐解释能否推动用户做出更可持续的选择。作者基于助推理论生成可持续性解释并进行随机实验，发现带有行为框架或描述性社会规范的解释会增加可持续选择，而单纯披露信息只改善解释评价却不改变选择行为。
2607.25726.title: Nudging Sustainable Choices through LLM-Generated Recommendation Explanations

2607.25728.summary_en: This paper presents a cooperative indoor UAV guidance framework using a shared voxel-map world model and a multi-agent Soft Actor-Critic controller. Multiple drones fuse LiDAR observations into a common occupancy map, convert it to ego-aligned BEV crops, and use centralized training with decentralized execution for continuous control. Simulation and real-world experiments show effective cooperative navigation, with the shared voxel map serving as a scalable spatial representation.
2607.25728.summary_zh: 本文提出一种协作室内无人机导航框架，结合共享体素地图世界模型和多智能体Soft Actor-Critic控制器。多架无人机将LiDAR观测融合到公共占据地图中，再转换为自我对齐的BEV局部表示，并在集中训练、分散执行框架下进行连续控制。仿真和真实实验表明，共享体素地图是有效且可扩展的协作空间表征。
2607.25728.title: Shared Voxel-Map-Based Cooperative Indoor UAV Guidance with a Multi-Agent Soft Actor-Critic Controller

2607.25736.summary_en: This paper addresses degradation of perception AI systems under poor image quality, especially in automated driving where false negatives can be more critical than false positives. It proposes estimating incoming image quality with normalizing flows and adapting the detector confidence threshold to create a fail-degraded system that behaves more cautiously under uncertainty.
2607.25736.summary_zh: 本文关注自动驾驶等感知 AI 系统在低质量图像输入下的性能退化问题，尤其强调漏检行人等关键错误的风险。作者提出用归一化流估计输入图像质量，并根据质量动态降低检测置信度阈值，使系统在不确定场景下更谨慎地工作。
2607.25736.title: Image Quality Dependent Degradation for AI Systems

2607.25748.summary_en: This paper examines whether prediction accuracy is sufficient to validate concept bottleneck models in echocardiographic ejection fraction estimation. Using a video transformer with ventricular volumes as the concept layer, it shows that optimizing only ejection fraction can preserve output accuracy while collapsing the physical scale of predicted volumes due to ratio invariance; adding volume supervision restores meaningful scale with a small ejection-fraction tradeoff.
2607.25748.summary_zh: 本文研究在超声心动图射血分数估计中，仅凭预测准确率是否足以验证概念瓶颈模型。作者使用以心室容积为概念层的视频 Transformer，发现只优化射血分数会因比值不变性而使预测容积的物理尺度坍缩；加入容积监督可恢复有意义的尺度，但射血分数误差略有代价。
2607.25748.title: Loss Invariance Determines What Concept Layers Encode: Volume Grounding in Echocardiography

2607.25750.summary_en: The paper addresses safer detection of harmful text-to-image LoRA fine-tunes without relying on metadata or generating potentially illegal outputs. It proposes using the top-left singular vectors of LoRA weight updates as a compact inference-free fingerprint of the strongest learned change. Experiments using human-subject age as a benign proxy suggest the fingerprint identifies training content, generalizes across base models, abstains on unrelated benign content, and is robust to several weight perturbations.
2607.25750.summary_zh: 本文研究如何在不依赖元数据且不生成潜在违法图像的情况下，更安全地检测有害文本到图像LoRA微调模型。作者提出使用LoRA权重更新的左奇异向量作为紧凑且无需推理的指纹，用以表征最强学习变化。以人物年龄作为良性代理的实验表明，该指纹可识别训练内容、跨基模型泛化、对无关良性内容 abstain，并对权重噪声、缩放和精度降低具有鲁棒性。
2607.25750.title: Detecting CSAM Text-to-Image LoRAs From Weights

2607.25751.summary_en: The paper tackles trip destination prediction in a target metropolitan area where no destination labels are available during training. It proposes Rule-based Visiting Circulation, a non-learning method that uses origin information, revisiting behavior, and origin-destination relationships inferred from trip patterns. Offline and leaderboard evaluations indicate the simple rule-based approach outperforms supervised learning methods and other heuristics in the competition setting.
2607.25751.summary_zh: 本文研究目标都市区训练阶段完全没有目的地标签时的出行目的地预测问题。作者提出Rule-based Visiting Circulation，一种无需从训练城市学习的规则方法，直接利用起点信息、个体重复访问行为以及起点与目的地关系来推断目的地。离线评估和排行榜提交结果显示，该简单规则方法在竞赛设置中优于监督学习方法和其他启发式方法。
2607.25751.title: An Embarrassingly Simple Rule-based Visiting Circulation Approach to Trip Destination Prediction

2607.25763.summary_en: The paper addresses the limitations of task-specific deep learning models and scarce labeled data in 6G wireless physical-layer tasks. It proposes WALoMA, a multitask wireless foundation model based on masked autoencoding of channel state information, with 2D positional encoding and LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Experiments across five downstream wireless tasks report strong composite performance and reduced trainable-parameter requirements compared with a large wireless model baseline.
2607.25763.summary_zh: 本文针对6G无线物理层中任务专用深度模型和标注数据稀缺的问题。作者提出WALoMA，将信道状态信息视为通用模态，通过掩码自编码进行自监督重建，并结合二维位置编码和LoRA进行参数高效微调。五个下游无线任务实验显示，该模型相较大型无线模型基线具有更高综合表现，并显著减少需要训练的参数比例。
2607.25763.title: WALoMA: A Multitask Wireless Foundation Model via Adaptive Low-Rank Masked Autoencoders

2607.25765.summary_en: This paper introduces WorkSurface-Bench to evaluate whether enterprise agents can route questions to appropriate heterogeneous knowledge surfaces such as documents, tables, and graphs. The benchmark provides auditable answers and controlled agent settings, showing that high routing accuracy under constrained tools does not guarantee answer correctness and that hints or removal of irrelevant tools affect performance and efficiency.
2607.25765.summary_zh: 本文提出WorkSurface-Bench，用于评估企业智能体能否将问题路由到文档、表格和图等异构知识表面。该基准提供可审计答案和受控智能体设置，结果表明即使在受限工具下路由准确率很高，也不能保证答案正确；表面提示和移除无关工具会影响性能与效率。
2607.25765.title: WorkSurface-Bench: Benchmarking Enterprise Agents on Multi-Surface Knowledge Routing

2607.25785.summary_en: The paper studies stochastic nonconvex composite optimization over compact convex sets when gradients are sampled along one ergodic Markov-chain trajectory. It proposes MC-ALFCG, a momentum conditional-gradient method using coupled capped multilevel Monte Carlo estimation and clipping to control Markovian bias and variance under the generalized Frank-Wolfe gap. Theoretical results provide expected sample-complexity guarantees under mixing-time dependence, with numerical studies examining dependence sensitivity, composite instances, and clipping behavior.
2607.25785.summary_zh: 本文研究在紧凸集合上进行随机非凸复合优化时，梯度样本来自单条遍历马尔可夫链轨迹的情形。作者提出MC-ALFCG，将动量条件梯度方法与耦合截断多层蒙特卡洛估计和逐步裁剪结合，以在广义Frank-Wolfe gap下控制马尔可夫偏差和方差。理论给出带混合时间依赖的期望样本复杂度保证，并通过数值实验考察依赖敏感性、复合优化实例和裁剪行为。
2607.25785.title: Variance-Reduced Conditional Gradient Methods under Markovian Sampling for Nonconvex Composite Optimization

2607.25790.summary_en: This paper proposes SpectONet, a physics-guided spectral DeepONet for Euler-Bernoulli beam vibration problems. It combines operator learning with physics-informed constraints and Chebyshev-Gauss-Lobatto sensor placement, reporting lower prediction errors than several baselines on synthetic beam problems and a real-world bridge vibration dataset.
2607.25790.summary_zh: 本文提出 SpectONet，一种用于 Euler-Bernoulli 梁振动问题的物理引导谱 DeepONet。该方法结合算子学习、物理约束和 Chebyshev-Gauss-Lobatto 传感器布置，并在合成梁问题和真实桥梁振动数据集上报告了相较多个基线更低的预测误差。
2607.25790.title: SpectONet: A Physics-Guided Spectral Deep Operator Network for Euler-Bernoulli Beam Dynamics

2607.25814.summary_en: This study evaluates the adversarial robustness of five Arabic language models under character-, word-, and sentence-level attacks. It applies diverse Arabic adversarial generation strategies and tests adversarial training as a defense. The findings show substantial performance degradation from diacritics, conjunction manipulation, and paraphrasing, while adversarial training improves resilience but leaves persistent weaknesses, especially to character-level noise.
2607.25814.summary_zh: 该研究评估五个阿拉伯语语言模型在字符、词和句子层级对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。研究使用多种阿拉伯语对抗样本生成策略，并考察基于对抗训练的防御方法。结果显示，变音符号插入、连词操纵和释义都会显著降低模型性能，而对抗训练虽能提升整体韧性，但尤其在字符级噪声下仍存在局限。
2607.25814.title: Evaluation of Adversarial Robustness in Arabic Language Models

2607.25816.summary_en: This paper addresses latency in tool-using LLM agents by predicting and pre-executing the agent's next tool call. It proposes a self-speculating agent that uses the same model for task solving and next-call speculation, trained with joint agent-speculator reinforcement learning from its own rollouts, improving next tool-call prediction while preserving task success.
2607.25816.summary_zh: 本文研究工具使用型大语言模型智能体因等待工具调用结果而产生的延迟问题。作者提出自推测智能体，用同一模型同时执行任务求解和下一次工具调用预测，并通过基于自身轨迹的联合智能体-推测器强化学习训练，在保持任务成功率的同时提升下一工具调用命中率。
2607.25816.title: Speculate While You Reason: Teaching Agents to Predict Their Next Tool Call via Joint Agent-Speculator RL

2607.25825.summary_en: This paper studies adaptive orchestration in long-horizon LLM agent harnesses. CHILL-Harness frames harness control as causal intervention learning, estimating workflow advantages from execution evidence and authorizing only beneficial adaptations, with experiments showing preserved or improved task success while reducing token use and execution time.
2607.25825.summary_zh: 本文研究长时程LLM智能体harness中的自适应编排问题。CHILL-Harness将harness控制表述为因果干预学习，从执行证据中估计工作流优势，并只实现具有足够预期收益的调整；实验显示其在保持或提升任务成功率的同时减少令牌消耗和执行时间。
2607.25825.title: CHILL-Harness: Counterfactual Harness Learning for Efficient Reasoning in Long-Horizon Agents

2607.25826.summary_en: The paper addresses zero-shot classification of unseen combined upper-limb movements from sEMG for prosthesis control. It proposes Compositional Prototype Interpolation and Synthetic Adaptation for Prototypes, which adapt prototype-network representations using an assumed linear structure in embedding space after training only on basic movements. Experiments on multiple datasets and online user-study inference report improved recognition of combined movements over prior zero-shot methods.
2607.25826.summary_zh: 本文研究用于假肢控制的sEMG未见组合上肢动作零样本分类问题。作者提出CPI和SAP两种方法，在仅用基础动作训练原型网络后，基于嵌入空间中的线性组合假设来适配组合动作原型。多个数据集和在线用户研究实验表明，所提方法在组合动作识别上优于既有零样本方法。
2607.25826.title: Prototype Adaptation for Zero-Shot sEMG Movement Classification

2607.25834.summary_en: This paper presents an agentic workflow for translating theoretical neutral-atom quantum protocols into cloud-accessible hardware experiments while retaining expert validation. Through case studies, the workflow moves from papers or patents to QPU campaigns, reveals failures requiring human review, and uses a second agent to classify a corpus of Rydberg-array papers for present-day implementability and hardware needs.
2607.25834.summary_zh: 本文提出一种智能体工作流，用于将中性原子量子计算理论协议转化为可在云端量子处理器上执行的硬件实验，同时保留专家验证环节。通过案例研究，该流程从论文或专利推进到 QPU 实验，并揭示了需要人类审查的失败；另一个智能体还用于分类 Rydberg 阵列论文语料以评估当前可实现性和硬件需求。
2607.25834.title: Lowering the implementation barrier of neutral-atom quantum computing with agentic workflows

2607.25835.summary_en: This paper studies distributed constraint optimization under limited communication, motivated by large-scale decentralized satellite scheduling. It adapts online learning algorithms for equilibrium finding in DCOPs and proposes a decomposition framework with a meta-DCOP for task allocation, local scheduling optimizers, and iterative pricing to couple the levels. The combined approach obtains near-optimal performance on real-world satellite scheduling instances and outperforms representative baselines.
2607.25835.summary_zh: 本文研究有限通信条件下的分布式约束优化，动机来自大规模去中心化卫星调度。作者将在线学习均衡求解方法适配到DCOP，并提出由任务分配元DCOP、局部调度优化器和迭代定价耦合机制组成的分解框架。该组合方法在真实卫星调度实例上达到近最优表现，并优于代表性基线。
2607.25835.title: Distributed Constraint Optimization via Online Learning and Iterative Pricing with Application to Large-Scale Satellite Scheduling

2607.25852.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a universally best drafting strategy for speculative decoding across real-world LLM inference workloads. AngelSpec provides a unified framework that co-specializes drafting structure and data, introduces the DFly block-diffusion architecture, and adaptively allocates verification compute across requests using utility and cost modeling. The reported results claim higher accepted lengths and throughput over autoregressive decoding and prior speculative decoding systems across tested concurrency settings.
2607.25852.summary_zh: 该论文研究现实LLM推理负载中没有单一最佳推测解码草稿结构的问题。AngelSpec通过统一训练框架将草稿结构与数据共同专门化，提出DFly块扩散架构，并基于效用与成本模型在线分配跨请求验证计算。结果声称该方法提升平均接受长度，并在不同并发设置下相较自回归解码和既有方法获得更高吞吐。
2607.25852.title: AngelSpec: Towards Real-World High Performance Inference with Speculative Decoding

2607.25853.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap between reusable high-level skills and executable actions in LLM agents. HiSkill converts interaction trajectories into hierarchical skill graphs containing skills, atomic operations, and typed relations, then retrieves task-relevant subgraphs for guided execution; experiments in interactive environments report stronger performance and lower token use than baselines.
2607.25853.summary_zh: 本文解决LLM智能体中高层可复用技能与可执行动作之间脱节的问题。HiSkill将交互轨迹组织为包含技能、原子操作和类型化关系的层次技能图，并在推理时检索任务相关子图来指导执行；交互环境实验显示其性能优于基线且减少推理令牌消耗。
2607.25853.title: HiSkill: Empowering LLM Agents with Hierarchical Skill Graphs

2607.25857.summary_en: This paper introduces Shieldstral, a 3B-parameter policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier for content moderation. It casts heterogeneous moderation datasets as a unified binary question-answering task and describes a large-scale data construction and evaluation recipe for policy adaptability. The main claim is that this small adaptive model matches or exceeds much larger models on text safety benchmarks and reaches state-of-the-art multimodal safety classification.
2607.25857.summary_zh: 该论文提出Shieldstral，一个30亿参数的政策自适应多模态安全分类器，用于内容审核。方法将不同分类体系的审核任务统一为二元问答问题，并构建大规模训练数据和细粒度评测集以评估政策适配能力。论文声称该小型自适应模型在文本安全基准上可匹配或超过更大模型，并在多模态安全分类上达到新的先进水平。
2607.25857.title: Shieldstral

2607.25864.summary_en: The paper studies ICU time-series forecasting where future observations depend on planned interventions such as vasopressors. It proposes DRIFT, a hybrid framework combining a direct forecaster with constrained corrections from a recursive action-conditioned model to better use supplied treatment sequences while limiting autoregressive error accumulation. Evaluations on MIMIC-IV and eICU-CRD show modest overall improvements in mean arterial pressure forecasting and greater sensitivity to altered treatment paths in targeted audits.
2607.25864.summary_zh: 本文研究ICU时间序列预测，其中未来生命体征和实验室指标会受到血管升压药等干预序列影响。作者提出DRIFT，将直接预测模型与递归的动作条件模型所给出的受约束修正相结合，以利用未来治疗路径并减少自回归误差累积。MIMIC-IV和eICU-CRD评估显示，该方法对平均动脉压预测有较小但一致的改进，并在治疗路径被改变的审计中表现出更强的干预敏感性。
2607.25864.title: DRIFT: Direct-Recursive Intervention-Conditioned Forecasting of ICU Physiological Trajectories

2607.25865.summary_en: This paper introduces OmniQEC, an AI scientist for discovering practical quantum error-correcting codes. An LLM orchestrator coordinates code generation, screening, syndrome-extraction synthesis, and decoder-based circuit evaluation through fast proxy exploration and slower physically grounded evaluation, leading to discovered codes with improving logical-error suppression and competitive performance under implementation budgets.
2607.25865.summary_zh: 本文提出OmniQEC，一个用于发现实用量子纠错码的AI科学家系统。该系统由LLM编排器协调代码生成、代码级筛选、综合征提取合成和基于解码器的电路评估，并通过快速代理探索与较慢的物理扎根评估相结合，发现了逻辑错误抑制随物理量子比特预算提升而改进且具有竞争力的编码。
2607.25865.title: OmniQEC: discovering practical quantum error-correcting codes by an AI scientist

2607.25870.summary_en: The paper focuses on voice activity detection for always-on edge systems with strict latency, memory, and compute limits. It introduces kiloVAD, a causal CNN-only model using standard Mel features, structured pruning with self-distillation, and angle-based quantization-aware training. The reported per-frame evaluations show strong causal VAD performance with very small parameter count, supporting deployment-ready speech activity detection on embedded devices.
2607.25870.summary_zh: 本文关注在内存、延迟和计算受限的常开边缘设备上进行语音活动检测。作者提出kiloVAD，采用标准Mel特征和仅CNN结构，并结合逐层结构化剪枝、自蒸馏与基于角度的量化感知训练。逐帧因果评估显示，该模型在极小参数量下取得较强性能，支持嵌入式部署场景中的语音活动检测。
2607.25870.title: VAD to the Bone: Ultra-Tiny Speech Activity Detection for Edge Deployment

2607.25873.summary_en: This paper empirically studies how LLM-based automated program repair systems attend to bug reports and how attention relates to repair success. Analyzing real Python and Java bugs, it finds that successful repairs show more distributed attention over diagnostic components, while failures often over-focus on metadata, suggesting attention misallocation as a factor in repair failures.
2607.25873.summary_zh: 本文实证研究基于大语言模型的自动程序修复系统如何关注缺陷报告，以及注意力模式与修复成功之间的关系。作者分析真实 Python 和 Java 缺陷，发现成功修复通常在缺陷描述、堆栈和测试等诊断信息上注意力更分散，而失败案例常过度关注版本等元数据，表明注意力错配可能导致修复失败。
2607.25873.title: How Do LLMs Read Bug Reports? An Empirical Study of Attention in LLMs for Automated Program Repair

2607.25875.summary_en: This paper addresses traffic forecasting under evolving sensor networks, where topology expansion and temporal shifts degrade pretrained models. It proposes A2TTA, a test-time adaptation framework that handles topology-induced errors through expandable output calibration and separates persistent global correction from context-specific specialization, reporting consistent forecasting gains across real-world datasets and backbones.
2607.25875.summary_zh: 本文研究交通传感器网络持续演化条件下的交通预测问题，指出拓扑扩展和时间分布变化会削弱预训练模型性能。作者提出 A2TTA 测试时自适应框架，将拓扑导致的误差转化为可扩展输出校准，并区分持久全局校正与情境特化，在多个真实数据集和模型骨干上报告了稳定改进。
2607.25875.title: A2TTA: Anchored-and-Agile Test-Time Adaptation for Evolving Traffic Sensor Networks

2607.25877.summary_en: The paper investigates uncertainty monitoring in LLM-based multi-agent systems for actuarial risk modelling. It proposes a hub-and-specialist multi-agent workflow for data preparation, modelling, review, and explanation, with runtime uncertainty propagated through calibrated task-level confidence estimates derived from token-level log-probability summaries and incorporated into a Bayesian Network. Results claim the framework preserves baseline actuarial performance while adding insight into workflow stability and uncertainty propagation.
2607.25877.summary_zh: 本文研究用于精算风险建模的基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中的运行时不确定性监测。作者提出由中心枢纽和专门智能体组成的工作流，覆盖数据准备、建模、审查和解释，并将由 token 级对数概率摘要校准得到的任务级置信度纳入贝叶斯网络进行不确定性传播。结果表明，该框架在保持基线精算性能的同时，提供了关于工作流稳定性和运行时不确定性传播的额外洞见。
2607.25877.title: Runtime Uncertainty Monitoring for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems Using Bayesian Networks

2607.25880.summary_en: This paper studies black-box LLM provenance testing, where the goal is to determine whether a suspect model shares lineage with a source model. It introduces induced decision regions to abstract open-ended outputs into finite decisions and proposes Stemma, a fingerprinting method based on stability, robustness, and specificity of probes, reporting strong discrimination across model transformations and deployments.
2607.25880.summary_zh: 本文研究黑盒大语言模型来源判定，即判断可疑模型是否与源模型具有相同谱系。作者提出诱导决策区域，将开放式输出映射到有限决策空间以弱化表面形式变化，并提出 Stemma 指纹方法，通过稳定性、鲁棒性和特异性探针选择在模型变换和部署设置下实现较强区分能力。
2607.25880.title: Stemma: Induced Decision Regions Reveal LLM Provenance

2607.25881.summary_en: This study evaluates how well large language models assist with scientific project planning and proposal evaluation in physics, astrophysics, and cosmology. Human researchers and three LLMs generated one-page plans for expert-conceived projects, which were blindly assessed by human and AI reviewers using a rubric and authorship-identification task. The results claim that LLM-generated plans are comparable to human-written ones for human reviewers, while AI reviewers systematically favor AI-written proposals, motivating caution in proposal workflows.
2607.25881.summary_zh: 该研究评估大型语言模型在物理、天体物理和宇宙学科研项目规划与提案评审中的辅助能力。研究让人类研究者和三个LLM为专家构想的项目生成一页计划，并由人类与AI评审者进行盲评和作者身份识别。结果表明，人类评审者总体上认为AI与人类提案相近，但AI评审者明显偏好AI生成提案，因此在提案准备和评审中部署LLM需要谨慎。
2607.25881.title: AI's Capability in Assisting Scientific Research in Physics, Astrophysics, and Cosmology II: Project Planning and Proposal Evaluation

2607.25883.summary_en: This paper argues that agentic cloud management needs a systems substrate for safe coordination among agents and with human operators. It presents CloudWeaver, which scopes individual agent sessions through local cloud-resource views and coordinates concurrent operations on shared resources, providing safety guarantees and attributable feedback on a representative Azure API workload.
2607.25883.summary_zh: 本文认为，智能体式云管理需要一个系统基础，以支持多个智能体之间以及智能体与人类操作者之间的安全协同。作者提出CloudWeaver，通过云资源局部视图限定单个智能体会话，并协调共享资源上的并发操作，在代表性Azure API工作负载上提供安全保证和可归因反馈。
2607.25883.title: Towards a Systems Foundation for Agentic Cloud Management

2607.25885.summary_en: This paper presents an automated machine-learning workflow for gas lift optimization in unconventional oil fields. The workflow forecasts gas lift performance curves from historical production time series and uses Bayesian optimization to allocate injection rates under facility constraints, reporting production uplift in a pilot and deployment across many wells.
2607.25885.summary_zh: 本文提出用于非常规油田气举优化的自动化机器学习工作流。该方法利用历史生产时间序列预测气举性能曲线，并通过贝叶斯优化在设施能力约束下求解最优注气率，报告了试点中的产量提升以及在更多井上的部署。
2607.25885.title: A Machine-Learning-Based Gas Lift Optimization Workflow for Unconventional Fields

2607.25886.summary_en: This paper evaluates whether LLM agents can automate data-centric post-training research for recursive self-improvement. RSIBench-Data fixes the training and evaluation stack while agents iteratively revise data strategies, showing that agents can sometimes improve from feedback but often fail to preserve or build on the best observed checkpoint.
2607.25886.summary_zh: 本文评估LLM智能体能否自动化递归自我改进中的数据中心化后训练研究。RSIBench-Data固定训练与评估栈，让智能体迭代修改训练数据策略；结果显示智能体有时能从反馈中改进，但经常无法保持或继续提升已观察到的最佳检查点。
2607.25886.title: RSIBench-Data: Benchmarking Data-Centric Research for Recursive Self-Improvement

2607.25887.summary_en: This paper evaluates domain adaptation methods for acoustic scene classification using CNN-based and transformer-based feature representations under device shifts. It compares DANN and CDAN, finding that DANN is more consistently effective across feature extractors while CDAN is effective mainly with CNN features, suggesting adaptation methods should be matched to representation type.
2607.25887.summary_zh: 本文评估设备迁移条件下声学场景分类中领域自适应方法对 CNN 和 Transformer 特征表示的效果。研究比较 DANN 与 CDAN，发现 DANN 在两类特征上较为稳定有效，而 CDAN 主要适用于 CNN 特征，说明领域自适应方法需要结合底层表示进行选择。
2607.25887.title: Device Invariance using Domain Adaptation on Acoustic Scene Classification

2607.25888.summary_en: This study proposes speech-based depression biomarkers derived from the dynamics of tract variables that describe articulator geometry. It characterizes predictability, complexity, and randomness using nonlinear dynamical measures and reports that these biomarkers discriminate depressed and control speakers in the Androids Corpus.
2607.25888.summary_zh: 本文提出基于语音发音道变量动力学特性的抑郁症生物标志物，这些变量描述发音器官的几何配置。研究使用最大 Lyapunov 指数、关联维数和样本熵刻画可预测性、复杂性和随机性，并报告这些指标能区分 Androids Corpus 中的抑郁组与对照组说话人。
2607.25888.title: Depression Markers in Speech: An Approach based on Tract Variables Dynamics

2607.25890.summary_en: This paper investigates how security controls for commercial AI coding agents can be distributed through a custom harness rather than vendor-specific configurations. It evaluates controlled and uncontrolled agent configurations using an OWASP-derived test suite and presents SHarD, a harness that embeds sandboxing, skill scanning, and tool restrictions while maintaining security efficacy in the reported tests.
2607.25890.summary_zh: 本文研究如何通过自定义 harness 向商业 AI 编码智能体分发安全控制，而不是依赖厂商原生配置。作者基于 OWASP Agentic Applications 派生测试套件比较多种智能体配置，并提出 SHarD，将操作系统沙箱、技能扫描和工具限制嵌入可分发 harness，在报告的测试中保持了安全控制效果。
2607.25890.title: Distributing Security Controls Through Harness Engineering

2607.25891.summary_en: This paper addresses fragmentation in AI agent evaluation across tasks, scaffolds, verifiers, and scoring rules. It introduces Messier, a standardized corpus spanning many benchmarks, agents, tasks, and verifiers, and uses it to analyze uneven progress, effects of aggregation rules, and reusable capability scales for fine-grained agent evaluation.
2607.25891.summary_zh: 本文研究 AI 智能体评测中任务、脚手架、验证器和评分规则碎片化导致的不可比问题。作者提出 Messier 标准化语料库，覆盖大量基准、智能体、任务和验证器，并用其分析不同基准类型的进展差异、聚合规则影响以及可复用的智能体能力尺度。
2607.25891.title: Messier: A High-Resolution Corpus for Cross-Benchmark Agent Evaluation

2607.25895.summary_en: The paper addresses the need for scalable yet high-fidelity data for deployable robotic manipulation policies. It presents HiFi-UMI, a portable robot-free demonstration capture system designed around accurate trajectories, relative pose, synchronization, and wide field of view, then uses the resulting data for post-training without real-robot anchor data. Experiments claim policies trained solely on HiFi-UMI demonstrations deploy directly on real robots and match in-domain teleoperation across several backbones, while the released corpus improves unseen-task action error and robot success.
2607.25895.summary_zh: 本文研究可部署机器人操作策略所需的高保真且可扩展数据瓶颈。作者提出HiFi-UMI，一种无机器人便携示教采集系统，围绕轨迹精度、夹爪相对位姿、同步和宽视场进行设计，并使用其数据在没有真实机器人锚定数据的情况下进行后训练。实验声称，仅用HiFi-UMI示教训练的策略可直接部署到真实机器人，并在多个骨干模型上接近场景内遥操作基线，同时发布的数据集可降低未见任务动作误差并提升真实机器人成功率。
2607.25895.title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone

2607.25904.summary_en: This paper addresses automated evaluation of GUI agents, where screenshots alone may not reveal whether a task was completed. It proposes Interactive Reward Agent, a propose-then-verify evaluator that inspects post-execution environment state through system, application, and GUI tools, and reports improved benchmark accuracy and useful reward signals for training GUI agents.
2607.25904.summary_zh: 本文研究 GUI 智能体任务完成情况的自动评估问题，指出仅凭截图轨迹往往无法判断系统配置、文件数据或应用设置是否满足要求。作者提出 Interactive Reward Agent，通过先提出完成条件再调用系统、应用和 GUI 工具验证执行后环境状态，并报告其在基准评测和 GUI 智能体强化学习奖励信号方面的有效性。
2607.25904.title: Interactive Reward Agent: GUI Task Evaluation via Environment-State Verification

2607.25907.summary_en: This paper studies input-only suppression of internal evaluation-awareness latents in large language models, framing it as the dual of activation steering. Using fluent prompt optimization across several latent constructions and two Llama models, it finds that internal latents can be suppressed but that activation readability does not reliably imply behavioral controllability, with placebo directions and contextual tests revealing important limitations.
2607.25907.summary_zh: 本文研究在不进行推理时激活编辑的情况下，仅通过输入优化来抑制大语言模型内部的评估感知潜变量，并将其视为激活引导的对偶问题。作者在多个潜变量构造和两个 Llama 模型上使用流畅提示优化，发现内部潜变量可被抑制，但激活可读性并不可靠等同于行为可控性，安慰剂方向和上下文实验揭示了关键限制。
2607.25907.title: Minimizing Targeted Activations: Input-Only Suppression of Evaluation-Awareness Latents in Large Language Models

2607.25911.summary_en: This paper introduces AnnoBench, a benchmark for automated visualization annotation generation, motivated by the need to satisfy visual, semantic, and stylistic constraints simultaneously. The benchmark pairs professional visualizations with annotation tasks across multiple representations, context conditions, and prompt levels, and evaluates systems using VLM-as-a-judge aligned with human assessment.
2607.25911.summary_zh: 本文提出 AnnoBench，用于评估自动化可视化标注生成，因为该任务需要同时满足视觉、语义和风格约束。该基准将专业可视化作品与多种表示格式、语义上下文条件和提示具体程度下的标注任务配对，并使用与人工评估对齐的 VLM-as-a-judge 进行评测。
2607.25911.title: AnnoBench: A Benchmark for Visualization Annotation Generation

2607.25912.summary_en: This paper targets the limited 3D object understanding of vision-language-action models for robot manipulation under occlusion, pose variation, and spatial interaction demands. It proposes an object-centric alignment framework that uses frozen SAM3D representations as training-time 3D priors for a VLA policy while preserving RGB-language-to-action inference at test time, reporting improved simulation and real-world long-horizon manipulation performance.
2607.25912.summary_zh: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作模型在遮挡、姿态变化和精细空间交互下缺乏目标物体三维理解的问题。作者提出以冻结的 SAM3D 作为训练期三维教师的物体中心表示对齐框架，使策略在测试时仍保持 RGB-语言到动作流程，并在仿真与真实长程操作任务中表现出改进。
2607.25912.title: SAM3D-Guided Object-Centric Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models

2607.25914.summary_en: This paper addresses trust management for autonomous network agents that invoke tools across vendor boundaries without human oversight. It proposes AgentToolMO, a 3GPP NRM information model with trust-state transitions, cascade propagation, cross-vendor notifications, and dependency-graph impact assessment, claiming simulation-based reductions in undetected propagation and bounded convergence within existing management infrastructure.
2607.25914.summary_zh: 本文研究自治网络中跨厂商工具调用的智能体信任管理问题，尤其是某厂商工具受损后其他厂商智能体仍继续调用所带来的级联风险。作者提出 AgentToolMO 这一 3GPP NRM 信息模型，包含信任状态机、级联传播、跨厂商通知和依赖图影响评估，并通过仿真声称可在现有管理基础设施中实现更快遏制与有界收敛。
2607.25914.title: Toward Standardized Cross-Vendor Agent Tool Trust Management in Autonomous Networks

2607.25915.summary_en: This paper addresses the cost of structured reasoning in decoder-only Transformers, where additional computation is usually obtained through model scaling or long chain-of-thought outputs. It proposes Penelope, a localized latent-reasoning framework that recurrently refines a selected decoder interval using boundary memory and GRU dynamics, achieving competitive structured-reasoning accuracy with reduced inference latency.
2607.25915.summary_zh: 本文关注解码器式 Transformer 在结构化推理中获取额外计算的成本问题，指出现有方法通常依赖参数扩展或生成较长思维链。作者提出 Penelope，通过边界记忆和 GRU 动态在选定解码器区间内进行局部潜在递归推理，在减少推理延迟的同时达到与既有潜在推理模型相当的准确性。
2607.25915.title: Penelope: Localized Latent Recurrence for Efficient Structured Reasoning

2607.25921.summary_en: This work evaluates vision-language models for detecting geometry clipping anomalies in an agent-driven video game QA pipeline. A custom exploration agent collects visual observations and an automatic pipeline supplies frame-level labels; six VLM families are tested zero-shot under prompt variants, showing sensitivity to ambiguous frames and suggesting VLMs are better used as high-recall filters than standalone detectors.
2607.25921.summary_zh: 本文评估视觉语言模型在由探索智能体驱动的视频游戏 QA 流程中检测几何穿模异常的能力。系统使用自定义探索智能体采集视觉观察，并通过自动标注流程提供帧级标签；对六类 VLM 的零样本提示实验表明，模型在视觉歧义帧上误报较多，更适合作为多阶段 QA 流程中的高召回候选过滤器。
2607.25921.title: Evaluating VLMs for Autonomous Agent-Driven Geometry Clipping Detection in Video Game QA

2607.25925.summary_en: This paper studies explainable controller representation for Markov decision processes, where exact decision-tree policies can become too large for human comprehension. It extends dtControl2 with an epsilon-imprecision mechanism that constructs smaller decision trees while guaranteeing epsilon-optimality, yielding tunably simpler explanations and much smaller trees than prior tools.
2607.25925.summary_zh: 本文研究马尔可夫决策过程中的可解释控制器表示问题，指出精确决策树策略在大规模或边界情况较多的系统中往往难以理解。作者为 dtControl2 引入 ε 近似功能，在保证 ε 最优性的同时生成更小的决策树，从而提供可调节的简化解释，并显著缩小树规模。
2607.25925.title: dtControl2+$\varepsilon$: Trading Optimality for Explainability in MDPs via Decision Trees

2607.25926.summary_en: This survey addresses face de-identification methods that remove or conceal identity-revealing facial information while preserving downstream utility. It organizes work across the physical, sensor, and digital domains from capture through processing, reviews evaluation protocols, and highlights the need for standardized benchmarks and open research directions.
2607.25926.summary_zh: 该综述研究人脸去标识化方法，目标是在保持下游任务效用的同时移除或遮蔽可识别身份的人脸信息。文章从物理域、传感器域和数字域统一梳理从采集到处理的完整流程，并总结评测协议、标准化基准需求与未来研究方向。
2607.25926.title: Face De-Identification: A Domain-Centric Survey from Capture to Processing

2607.25929.summary_en: The paper examines whether deep generative models can recover known non-stationary spatial processes rather than only produce plausible samples. It evaluates flow matching, DDPM, score-SDE, and VAE models on a non-stationary Gaussian random field using metrics for ground-truth mean and covariance recovery, with oracle and stationary controls. The results indicate all models recover the mean, while covariance recovery varies by model family, with diffusion and score-based methods performing better than VAE in this setup.
2607.25929.summary_zh: 本文研究深度生成模型是否能够恢复已知的非平稳空间过程，而不仅是生成表面上合理的样本。作者在非平稳高斯随机场上评估flow matching、DDPM、score-SDE和VAE，并用均值与协方差结构恢复指标、oracle样本及平稳对照进行比较。结果表明四类模型都能恢复均值，但协方差恢复能力存在差异，其中扩散和score-based方法在该设置下优于VAE。
2607.25929.title: Can Deep Generative Models Reproduce Non-Stationary Gaussian Random Fields?

2607.25933.summary_en: The paper evaluates multimodal large language models on realistic multi-turn clinical diagnostic reasoning, where information is progressively disclosed and hypotheses must be updated. It introduces ClinMM-Bench, containing challenging clinical cases and medical images, and uses a two-level framework for diagnostic accuracy and reasoning quality. Evaluation of representative models shows limited fully correct diagnoses and recurring failures in synthesis, knowledge mapping, perception, premature closure, and visual hallucination.
2607.25933.summary_zh: 本文评估多模态大语言模型在真实多轮临床诊断推理中的能力，其中信息逐步披露，诊断假设需要动态更新。作者提出ClinMM-Bench，包含具有挑战性的真实临床病例和医学图像，并用两级框架评估诊断准确性和推理质量。对多个代表模型的评测显示，完全正确诊断比例仍有限，并存在信息综合失败、知识映射错误、感知错误、过早闭合和视觉幻觉等问题。
2607.25933.title: Evaluating Multi-Turn Multimodal Diagnostic Reasoning on Challenging Real-World Clinical Cases

2607.25947.summary_en: The paper addresses question answering over irregular clinical time series, where sparsity, asynchrony, and irregular sampling challenge existing multimodal time-series LLMs. It proposes ClinPRISM, combining an irregularity-aware multi-scale encoder, temporal evidence distillation into compact LLM-compatible tokens, and progressive alignment with textual embeddings. Training on constructed clinical time-series descriptions and instruction data yields state-of-the-art benchmark performance with low token usage and latency.
2607.25947.summary_zh: 本文研究不规则临床时间序列问答问题，指出稀疏性、异步性和不规则采样使现有多模态时间序列大语言模型难以处理。作者提出ClinPRISM，结合不规则性感知的多尺度编码器、将时间证据压缩为少量LLM兼容令牌的蒸馏模块，以及与文本嵌入空间的渐进对齐策略。基于构建的临床时间序列描述和指令数据训练后，该方法在保留评测基准上达到先进性能，并具有较低令牌使用量和推理延迟。
2607.25947.title: A Cost-Effective Multimodal LLM Reasoning Framework for Question Answering over Irregular Clinical Time Series

2607.25948.summary_en: The paper investigates decoder-only any-to-any multimodal modeling, aiming to predict any modality from any combination of modalities within a single symmetric model. It introduces Modus, which avoids modality-specific heads, losses, and task pipelines while enabling chained generation and cross-modal self-verification. Experiments show strong out-of-the-box performance competitive with specialist and multitask baselines across benchmarks.
2607.25948.summary_zh: 本文研究仅解码器的任意到任意多模态建模，目标是在单一对称模型中从任意模态组合预测任意模态。作者提出Modus，避免使用模态特定的输出头、损失函数和任务流水线，并支持通过中间模态链式生成及跨模态自验证。实验显示，该模型在多个基准上具有较强的开箱性能，并能与专用模型和多任务基线竞争。
2607.25948.title: MODUS: Decoder-Only Any-to-Any Modeling of Diverse Modalities

2607.25953.summary_en: This paper introduces Polistemics, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs as mediators of political information in elections. Grounded in epistemic modesty, it tests models under varying information clarity, noise, and consistency, finding that aggregate scores hide failures under absent, vague, or contradictory evidence and that no evaluated model mediates political information reliably across conditions.
2607.25953.summary_zh: 本文提出 Polistemics，用于评估 LLM 在选举政治信息中作为信息中介的表现。该基准以认识论谦逊为规范基础，在信息清晰度、噪声和一致性不同的受控条件下测试模型，发现总体分数会掩盖模型在缺失、模糊或矛盾证据下的系统性失败，且没有被评估模型能在所有条件下稳定可靠地进行政治信息中介。
2607.25953.title: Polistemics: Evaluating LLMs as Information Mediators in Politics & Elections

2607.25956.summary_en: The paper studies instance-wise operations research formulation selection for multi-warehouse inventory allocation, where no single MIP formulation performs best across heterogeneous regimes. It proposes a solver-guided LLM framework that selects among OR expert formulations using supervised fine-tuning, solver-derived preference optimization, and GRPO with reward lookup. Experiments on real inventory allocation instances report improved expert-selection accuracy and realized allocation quality over preference-trained and fixed-formulation baselines.
2607.25956.summary_zh: 本文研究多仓库存分配中的实例级运筹优化建模选择问题，指出没有单一MIP模型能在异质实例条件下始终最优。作者提出求解器引导的大语言模型框架，在多个OR专家公式之间选择，并结合监督微调、基于求解器评价的偏好优化和带奖励查找的GRPO。真实库存分配实例实验显示，该方法提升了专家选择准确率和实际分配质量，优于偏好训练选择器和固定公式基线。
2607.25956.title: Large Language Model for Operations Research Formulation Selection in Multi-Warehouse Inventory Allocation

2607.25959.summary_en: The paper studies modality-level inconsistency detection across Wikipedia text, tables, and Wikidata knowledge graphs. It introduces a taxonomy of cross-modal knowledge inconsistencies and presents Kontrast, which uses Text-to-SPARQL and LLM reasoning to compare table-based answers with knowledge-graph evidence. Experiments show such inconsistencies are common and useful for identifying conflicts, missing KG structure, and temporal mismatches, despite errors from parsing and noise.
2607.25959.summary_zh: 本文研究维基百科文本、表格和Wikidata知识图谱之间的模态级知识不一致检测。作者提出跨模态知识不一致分类体系，并开发Kontrast框架，利用Text-to-SPARQL和大语言模型推理比较表格答案与知识图谱证据。实验表明，此类不一致普遍存在，可用于发现真实冲突、知识图谱结构缺失和时间错配，但也受解析错误和噪声限制。
2607.25959.title: Detecting Knowledge Inconsistencies Across Text, Tables, and Knowledge Graphs

2607.25961.summary_en: The paper addresses video-level recognition of ambivalence and hesitancy in health behavior change, where signals emerge from temporal and cross-modal conflict. It proposes PRISM-AH, aligning frozen vision, audio, and text encoders into time windows, modeling cross-modal dissonance and hesitation surprise, discovering behavior prototypes, and using metadata conditioning. A knowledge-guided LLM reasons over structured evidence and is fused when beneficial, yielding improved macro F1 over a zero-shot baseline.
2607.25961.summary_zh: 本文研究健康行为改变中视频级矛盾和犹豫状态识别问题，这类信号来自多模态之间和内部随时间发展的冲突。作者提出PRISM-AH，将冻结的视觉、音频和文本编码器对齐到短时间窗口，建模跨模态不协调与犹豫惊讶信号，并发现行为原型、结合参与者元数据。知识引导的大语言模型进一步基于结构化证据推理，并在有效时进行后期融合，显著优于零样本基线。
2607.25961.title: Knowledge-Guided Multimodal Reasoning over Interacting Streams for Video-Level Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition

2607.25967.summary_en: The paper targets the sequential bottlenecks of SVD in real-time computational and medical imaging pipelines. It proposes Quasi-SVD, a differentiable GPU-parallel matrix factorization method that enforces exact orthogonality on one Lie-parameterized factor and uses soft constraints for the remaining components. Evaluations on ultrasound localization microscopy and Mueller matrix polarimetry report high reconstruction fidelity and substantially faster throughput than classical solvers, enabling live imaging workflows at clinical scales.
2607.25967.summary_zh: 本文针对实时计算成像和医学成像中SVD算法顺序执行导致的吞吐瓶颈。作者提出Quasi-SVD，一种可微且完全GPU并行的矩阵分解框架，只对一个Lie参数化因子施加精确正交约束，并用软约束恢复其余部分。超声定位显微和Mueller矩阵偏振成像实验显示，该方法在保持较高重建保真度的同时显著加速计算，使临床尺度的实时成像流程更可行。
2607.25967.title: Quasi-SVD: Learning a Lie-constrained matrix factorisation for real-time imaging

2607.25970.summary_en: The paper studies reinforcement learning for code optimization, where incorporating execution time into rewards introduces measurement noise, sparsity, and training instability. It proposes a three-stage approach involving an optimization benchmark and calibrated sandbox, reward design with offline simulation, and GRPO adaptations for timed execution. Experiments report improved speed-aware pass rates and stronger optimization behavior while preserving correctness.
2607.25970.summary_zh: 本文研究用于代码优化的强化学习，指出将执行时间纳入奖励会带来测量噪声、奖励稀疏和训练不稳定等问题。作者提出三阶段方法，包括构建优化测试与校准沙箱、设计结合正确性和速度的奖励并用离线模拟选择配置，以及针对计时执行调整GRPO。实验显示，该方法提高了速度感知的通过率和优化能力，同时保持代码正确性。
2607.25970.title: Reinforcement Learning for Code Optimization

2607.25984.summary_en: The paper addresses future scene prediction from partial observations, where multiple possible kinematic futures must be represented rather than a single trajectory. It introduces GARFIELD, a probabilistic latent model of scene kinematics that supports both joint trajectory sampling and deterministic density decoding under optional sparse constraints. Experiments claim competitive motion-planning performance with much faster trajectory sampling and density estimation than large video or Monte Carlo motion generation alternatives.
2607.25984.summary_zh: 本文研究从部分观测预测场景未来演化的问题，重点是表示多个可能的运动未来而非单一轨迹。作者提出GARFIELD，一种场景运动学的概率潜在表示模型，可在可选稀疏约束下同时进行联合轨迹采样和确定性密度解码。实验声称该方法在运动规划中具有竞争力，并相较大型视频生成或蒙特卡洛运动生成方法显著加快轨迹采样和密度估计。
2607.25984.title: Schrödinger's Cat: Probabilistic Representation and Prediction of Potential Scene Kinematics

2607.25985.summary_en: The paper studies autonomous quadcopter control under underactuated dynamics and realistic actuator behavior. It proposes a physics-aware end-to-end deep reinforcement learning setup that acts on low-level thrust and body torques within a high-fidelity Simulink simulator including rigid-body dynamics, allocation, actuator lag, and gyroscopic coupling. Evaluations of DDPG, TD3, PPO, and SAC show SAC and TD3 provide stronger stability and exploration efficiency, highlighting the importance of actuator and aerodynamic modeling for low-level control benchmarks.
2607.25985.summary_zh: 本文研究欠驱动四旋翼在真实执行器动态下的自主控制问题。作者构建物理感知的端到端深度强化学习框架，直接输出总推力和机体系力矩，并在包含刚体动力学、分配矩阵、执行器滞后和陀螺耦合的高保真Simulink环境中闭环训练。对DDPG、TD3、PPO和SAC的比较显示，SAC和TD3在稳定性和探索效率上更优，强调了执行器滞后和气动力矩建模的重要性。
2607.25985.title: Physics-Aware End-to-End Deep Reinforcement Learning for Quadcopter Control with Actuator Dynamics

2607.25988.summary_en: The paper addresses the difficulty of reusing exact-equivariant architectures with generic sequence backbones and across modalities. It introduces GARI, a representation-level interface that exposes transformation generators through aligned canonical and generator-induced views, formalizes soft equivariance with diagnostic residuals, and instantiates the idea as GARI-Net with Direct Equivariance Error diagnostics. Experiments across genomic sequences, images, and 3D point clouds suggest the interface supports transformation consistency and held-out probe generalization without group-specific backbone redesign, while remaining distinct from exact equivariance certification.
2607.25988.summary_zh: 本文研究精确等变架构难以与通用序列骨干和跨模态任务复用的问题。作者提出GARI表示接口，通过对齐的规范视图和生成元诱导视图向通用骨干暴露变换生成元，并用软等变残差和DEE诊断来刻画表示关系。基因序列、图像和三维点云实验表明，该接口可支持任务相关的变换一致性和留出探针泛化，但不能等同于连续群上的精确等变证明。
2607.25988.title: Generator-Aligned Representation Interfaces for Diagnostic Soft Equivariance

2607.25989.summary_en: The paper studies proactive assurance for self-driving networks where telemetry, analytics, and actuation intents are causally coupled, causing faults to propagate as co-drift and obscure root causes. It introduces MILD, a teacher-augmented Mixture-of-Experts framework with a hybrid objective for multi-intent failure prediction and root-cause attribution, plus SHAP-based diagnostics and multi-horizon urgency estimation. Evaluations across increasingly realistic environments claim strong failure detection, remediation lead time, and intent-level root-cause disambiguation for closed-loop autonomous networks.
2607.25989.summary_zh: 该论文研究自驱动网络中的主动保障问题，其中遥测、分析和执行三个宏观意图相互因果耦合，单点故障会传播为 co-drift 并掩盖真实根因。作者提出 MILD，一种教师增强的 Mixture-of-Experts 框架，通过混合目标联合优化多意图失败预测和根因归因，并结合 SHAP 诊断与多时域紧迫度估计。跨统计基准、微服务应用和 SDN 边云测试床的评估声称，该方法在故障检测、提前修复时间和意图级根因区分方面表现较强。
2607.25989.title: Untangling Co-Drift: Proactive Multi-Intent Failure Prediction and Root-Cause Disambiguation for Self-Driving Networks

2607.25992.summary_en: The paper addresses long-term memory management for LLM-based agents, where existing systems often store heterogeneous interaction records without evaluating their utility. It presents MemLens, a value-aware memory management system with an interactive analytics dashboard covering memory evaluation, storage, and memory-assisted response. A study-copilot application demonstrates inspection of memory values, hierarchical memory visualization, and comparison of memory strategies by quality, latency, and token cost.
2607.25992.summary_zh: 本文研究大语言模型智能体的长期记忆管理问题，指出现有系统往往不区分交互记录价值而统一存储。作者提出MemLens，这是一种价值感知的记忆管理系统，配有交互式分析仪表盘，覆盖记忆评估、存储和辅助响应全过程。学习副驾驶应用展示了记忆价值检查、层次化记忆可视化，以及按响应质量、检索延迟和令牌消耗比较不同策略的能力。
2607.25992.title: MemLens: A Value-Aware Memory Management System with Interactive Analytics for LLM-based Agents

2607.25995.summary_en: The paper studies whether runtime topology context improves LLM-generated Kubernetes security patches, especially when patches must preserve live service dependencies. It introduces KuTIE, which builds cluster context from service call edges, security findings, and service-account bindings, then conditions patch generation on this information. Controlled experiments show that topology context substantially improves correctness for topology-dependent findings while not affecting topology-independent controls.
2607.25995.summary_zh: 本文研究运行时拓扑上下文是否能提升大语言模型生成Kubernetes安全补丁的正确性，尤其是在补丁必须保持实时服务依赖时。作者提出KuTIE，从服务调用边、安全发现和服务账户绑定构建集群上下文，并将其用于补丁生成条件。受控实验表明，拓扑上下文显著提升拓扑依赖型问题的修复正确性，而对拓扑无关对照没有影响。
2607.25995.title: Does Runtime Topology Context Improve LLM-Generated Kubernetes Security Patches?

2607.26000.summary_en: The paper empirically evaluates tabular foundation models under out-of-distribution shifts, a setting where standard independent and identically distributed evaluation may overstate robustness. It compares nine TFMs across real-world datasets with label, socioeconomic, and geographic shifts. Results show systematic degradation under distribution shift and identify deployment challenges from memory and compute demands.
2607.26000.summary_zh: 本文对表格基础模型在分布外迁移下的表现进行实证评估，指出标准独立同分布评测可能高估其鲁棒性。作者比较了九种表格基础模型在包含标签、社会经济和地理迁移的真实数据集上的表现。结果显示，所有模型在分布迁移下均系统性退化，并暴露出内存和计算资源方面的部署挑战。
2607.26000.title: Empirical Evaluation of Out-Of-Distribution Performance of Tabular Foundation Models

2607.26001.summary_en: The paper investigates which perturbation geometries are effective for Sharpness-Aware Minimization, motivated by matrix-aware optimization such as Muon. It introduces a layerwise spectral inner perturbation for matrix-valued hidden-layer weights and combines it with AdamW, SGDW, or Muon outer updates. ImageNet experiments on ViT-Small/16 and ResNet-50 report that spectral inner steps paired with Muon perform consistently strongly and achieve the best validation accuracy among evaluated methods.
2607.26001.summary_zh: 该论文研究 Sharpness-Aware Minimization 中何种扰动几何更有效，并受到 Muon 等矩阵感知优化方法启发。作者为矩阵形式的隐藏层权重引入逐层谱范数内层扰动，并将其与 AdamW、SGDW 或 Muon 外层更新结合。ImageNet 上的 ViT-Small/16 和 ResNet-50 实验表明，谱内层步骤配合 Muon 表现稳定，并在所评估方法中取得最佳验证精度。
2607.26001.title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization and Muon: Robustness under the Spectral Norm

2607.26004.summary_en: The paper addresses slow iterative sampling in image and video diffusion or flow models. It proposes Parallel Decoding Distillation, a trajectory-based distillation method that accelerates generation by predicting multiple denoising steps per network evaluation and supports variable numbers of function evaluations. The authors claim state-of-the-art few-step performance on text-to-video, text-to-video/audio, and text-to-image models, with improved generated video diversity.
2607.26004.summary_zh: 该论文研究图像和视频扩散或 flow 模型因迭代采样而导致的高计算成本问题。作者提出 Parallel Decoding Distillation，一种基于轨迹的蒸馏方法，通过每次网络评估预测多个去噪步骤来加速生成，并支持可变函数评估次数。论文声称该方法在文本到视频、文本到视频/音频和文本到图像模型上达到少步生成的先进性能，同时提升生成视频多样性。
2607.26004.title: Parallel Decoding Distillation for Fast Image and Video Generation

2607.26005.summary_en: This paper addresses the representation gap in driving self-play caused by training with privileged vectorized observations rather than deployable egocentric camera views. It introduces Pictura, a GPU-accelerated multi-agent driving simulator that renders each agent's perspective view at every step, and uses it to train a PPO self-play policy directly from images. The resulting policy approaches privileged-observation performance and transfers zero-shot to re-rendered Waymo layouts, where it outperforms privileged vectorized agents.
2607.26005.summary_zh: 本文研究驾驶自博弈中由特权向量观测与部署时自车相机视角之间差异导致的表征鸿沟。作者提出Pictura，一个GPU加速的多智能体驾驶模拟器，可在每一步渲染各智能体的自车视角，并用PPO直接从图像训练自博弈策略。所得策略接近特权观测策略表现，并能零样本迁移到重渲染的Waymo布局且优于特权向量智能体。
2607.26005.title: Pictura: Perspective-View Self-Play at Scale for Driving

2607.26015.summary_en: This paper studies whether language models exhibit syntactic convergence toward human dialogue context. Using substitution-paradigm dialogue data and CFG-rule overlap across Llama and Gemma models, it finds that models locally reuse human syntax more than unrelated primes, instruction-tuned models often exceed the replaced human responses in prime overlap, and tuning changes both related and unrelated syntactic overlap patterns.
2607.26015.summary_zh: 本文研究语言模型是否会在对话中向人类上下文表现出句法趋同。作者使用替代范式对话数据和 CFG 规则重叠来分析 Llama 与 Gemma 模型，发现模型相较无关引导更会局部复用前一人类话轮的句法，指令微调模型在与实际引导的重叠上常超过被替换的人类回复，同时微调也改变了相关和无关句法重叠模式。
2607.26015.title: Instruction-Tuned Models Locally Reuse Human Syntax More Than Humans Do

2607.26016.summary_en: The paper addresses inefficiencies in photonic transformer accelerators that rely on multi-wavelength light generation and large active dot-product units. It proposes MDTransformer, a hardware-software co-design using mode-division optical dataflow, inverse-designed multimode components, and coherent detection for compact photonic tensor computation. Experimental results report area, power, and energy savings with comparable latency across transformer workloads.
2607.26016.summary_zh: 本文研究光子Transformer加速器中多波长光源和大型有源点积单元带来的低效问题。作者提出MDTransformer，采用模分复用光数据流、逆向设计的多模器件和相干检测，实现紧凑的光子张量计算。实验结果显示，在多种Transformer工作负载上，该方案降低了面积、功耗和能耗，并保持相近延迟。
2607.26016.title: MDTransformer: A Hardware-Software Co-Design of Mode-Division Photonic Transformer Accelerator with Inverse-Designed Coherent Crossbar

2607.26017.summary_en: This paper addresses memory management for LLM agents operating on evolving task streams without explicit task boundaries. UniMem uses learnable routing tokens to coordinate episodic retrieval and expandable parametric memory, consolidating recurring patterns while retaining sparse tasks externally; experiments on long-horizon streams report consistent improvements over baselines.
2607.26017.summary_zh: 本文研究LLM智能体在无明确任务边界的动态任务流中的记忆管理问题。UniMem使用可学习路由令牌协调情景检索记忆与可扩展参数记忆，将重复可靠模式逐步固化，同时保留稀疏新任务；长时程任务流实验显示其稳定优于基线。
2607.26017.title: UniMem: Complementary Episodic-to-Parametric Memory for Boundary-Agnostic Task Streams

2607.26023.summary_en: The paper addresses zero-shot transfer for multimodal graph foundation models, where nodes may include text, images, and other modalities. It proposes CHARM, which constructs hierarchical graph contexts to capture multimodal semantics and cross-modal relations, then encodes them as graph tokens for a large language model. Experiments report consistent improvements on zero-shot multimodal graph tasks.
2607.26023.summary_zh: 本文研究多模态图基础模型的零样本迁移问题，其中图节点可能关联文本、图像等多种模态。作者提出CHARM，通过层次化图上下文建模多模态语义和跨模态关系，并将表示转换为供大语言模型使用的图令牌。实验显示，该方法在零样本多模态图任务上取得稳定改进。
2607.26023.title: CHARM: A Multimodal Graph Foundation Model with Hierarchical Context Modeling for Zero-Shot Transfer

2607.26034.summary_en: The paper investigates how competitive pressure affects unsafe choices in an idealized AI development race. It uses a framed behavioral experiment where paired participants repeatedly choose safe or unsafe development under varying maximum risk, and complements the findings with a reduced evolutionary model. The results suggest unsafe behavior is driven more by race state, opponent behavior, and falling behind than by individual risk preferences alone.
2607.26034.summary_zh: 本文研究竞争压力如何影响理想化AI开发竞赛中的不安全选择。作者设计行为实验，让成对参与者在不同最大风险条件下反复选择安全或不安全开发，并用简化演化模型解释结果。研究表明，不安全行为更多受竞赛状态、对手行为和落后压力驱动，而不仅由个人风险偏好决定。
2607.26034.title: Falling Behind Drives Unsafe Development in an Idealised AI Race Experiment

2607.26040.summary_en: The paper studies asymmetric reinforcement learning for model-based agents that can use privileged or refined state information during training. It identifies a limitation in representations learned by Informed Dreamer and proposes Reinformed Dreamer, which adds a latent-guidance objective for asymmetric representation learning. Experiments across several benchmarks show more consistent improvements over Dreamer than prior asymmetric approaches.
2607.26040.summary_zh: 该论文研究模型式强化学习中的非对称学习，即训练时利用额外的特权或更精细状态信息来改进表征和行为。作者指出 Informed Dreamer 学到的特权信息表征存在局限，并提出 Reinformed Dreamer，通过潜在指导目标改进非对称表征学习。多个基准实验显示，相比先前非对称方法，该算法相对于 Dreamer 带来更一致的提升。
2607.26040.title: Reinformed Dreamer: An Asymmetric World Model Efficiently Trained through Latent Guidance
