2607.26041.summary_en: The paper evaluates whether computer-use agents understand causal desktop GUI transitions rather than only final task success or single-frame grounding. It introduces Desktop-Delta Bench, an offline step-level benchmark with human-verified Linux GUI trajectories testing temporal ordering and before-after action inference. Evaluations across multiple model families reveal substantial gaps in state verification, source tracking, and context-aware control.
2607.26041.summary_zh: 本文评估计算机使用智能体是否理解桌面GUI动作导致的因果状态转移，而不仅是最终任务成功或单帧定位。作者提出Desktop-Delta Bench，这是一个离线步骤级基准，包含人工验证的Linux多应用轨迹，用于测试时间排序和动作前后变化推断。多个模型族的评测显示，当前模型在状态验证、来源追踪和上下文感知控制方面仍存在明显不足。
2607.26041.title: Desktop-Delta Bench: Do Computer-Use Models Understand Desktop GUI Transitions?

2607.26042.summary_en: The paper presents VetClaw, an edge-cloud multimodal agentic system for early veterinary disease screening. The system separates edge-side interaction and services from a LangGraph-managed stateful workflow that validates inputs, transmits images, invokes a vision-language model, applies safety checks, handles failures, and logs structured outputs. Results suggest image-only prediction is limited, while symptom-guided multimodal inputs improve zero-shot classification and enable a coordinated safety-aware workflow beyond static classification.
2607.26042.summary_zh: 该论文提出 VetClaw，一个用于早期兽医疾病筛查的边缘-云多模态代理系统。系统将边缘设备上的交互、调度、工具访问和通知服务，与由 LangGraph 管理的有状态工作流分离，后者负责输入验证、图像传输、模型调用、安全检查、失败处理和结构化日志。结果表明单独使用图像的 VLM 预测能力有限，而症状引导的多模态输入可提升零样本分类，并使系统从静态分类器转变为协调的安全感知工作流。
2607.26042.title: VetClaw: An Edge-Cloud Multimodal Agentic System for Veterinary Disease Screening

2607.26043.summary_en: The paper revisits transfer learning for mammography classification, arguing that conventional methods underuse dataset-specific difficulty information. It proposes DITL, combining adaptive difficulty-weighted cross-entropy based on k-nearest-neighbor label purity with an adaptive neighborhood triplet objective using a learnable margin. Experiments on large whole-image and small ROI mammography datasets report state-of-the-art and statistically significant improvements across screening and lesion diagnosis tasks.
2607.26043.summary_zh: 该论文重新审视乳腺摄影分类中的迁移学习，指出传统方法未充分利用数据集特定的样本难度信息。作者提出 DITL，将基于 k 近邻标签纯度的自适应难度加权交叉熵与带可学习 margin 的自适应邻域三元组目标结合。大规模整图和小规模 ROI 乳腺摄影数据集实验报告了在筛查和病灶诊断任务上的先进且统计显著的性能提升。
2607.26043.title: Re-thinking Mammography Transfer Learning: The Dataset-Informed Transfer Learning (DITL) Framework for Breast Cancer Screening and Lesion Diagnosis

2607.26052.summary_en: The paper addresses inefficiency in MoE-LoRA systems that route every token to a fixed number of experts despite varying uncertainty. It proposes CARE, a confidence-adaptive expert routing rule that activates experts by cumulative router mass and extends activation when admitted experts disagree, while a budget thermostat matches a target average expert count. Experiments across language benchmarks claim improved performance over fixed top-k routing at matched compute and better out-of-distribution detection from confidence and disagreement signals.
2607.26052.summary_zh: 该论文研究 MoE-LoRA 中固定 top-k 路由对不同不确定性 token 分配相同专家数量所造成的效率问题。作者提出 CARE，根据路由器概率质量以 nucleus 方式激活专家，并在已选专家分歧时适度扩展，同时用预算调节器匹配目标平均专家数。多类语言任务实验声称 CARE 在相同计算量下优于固定 top-k 路由，并且其置信度与分歧信号还能改进分布外检测。
2607.26052.title: Spend Experts Where You Are Unsure: Confidence-Adaptive Routing for Mixture-of-Experts LoRA

2607.26055.summary_en: The paper addresses reactivity and latency limitations in action-chunking flow policies for robotic manipulation. It proposes πR², which separates fast proprioceptive conditioning from asynchronously updated vision-language features and uses a latency-adaptive flow schedule to emit actions with one denoising step per call. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot show faster closed-loop replanning and improved manipulation success over baselines.
2607.26055.summary_zh: 本文研究机器人操作中动作分块流策略的反应性和延迟问题。作者提出πR²，将快速本体感知条件与异步更新的视觉语言特征分离，并使用延迟自适应流调度，使每次调用仅需一步去噪即可输出动作。仿真和真实机器人实验显示，该方法实现更快的闭环重规划，并提高任务成功率。
2607.26055.title: $π\mathbf{R}^2$: Reactive Real-time Flow Policies

2607.26057.summary_en: The paper studies on-policy distillation for reasoning models, focusing on prefix failure when a student model follows an incorrect trajectory and receives unreliable supervision. Relay-OPD detects teacher-student continuation asymmetry as a label-free handoff trigger, temporarily lets the teacher continue the trajectory, and then returns control to the student for optimization. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show improved performance over standard OPD and FastOPD while reducing training trajectory length.
2607.26057.summary_zh: 本文研究推理模型的在线策略蒸馏问题，重点关注学生模型在错误前缀上持续偏离而导致监督不可靠的前缀失败。Relay-OPD利用教师与学生在失败前缀后的延续差异作为无标签交接触发信号，让教师短暂接管生成轨迹后再交还学生进行优化。数学推理基准实验表明，该方法优于标准OPD和FastOPD，并减少训练轨迹长度。
2607.26057.title: Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation
